prs.title: feat(managed-agent): park and recover image-only approval waits
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This is the first half of Stage 1 (slice S1) of the proposal in #18149. An approval wait whose Prompt carries only an image or other attachments can now park, and the same wait now also survives a Harness crash.

Until now, park eligibility and both cold-recovery entry points (the takeover load and the resident redrive) required the original Prompt to have text, because a resumed Turn restarts from that text. An image-only Prompt failed that check. While it waited for an approval it stayed resident, and if its Harness crashed during the wait, cold recovery refused to resume it.

The requirement was stricter than needed. A resumed Turn reads the full original input, attachments included, back from its durable input resource. On resume the text is only used to start the Turn's budget, and the live Turn of an image-only Prompt already runs with empty text.

The shared check now falls back when the Prompt has no text: it reads the original input back, and if the input carries attachments, the Turn restarts from empty text, exactly as its live Turn ran. Prompts with text are unchanged. Inputs from other sources still need text, because they have no attachments to read back.

Every place in cold recovery that required the original Prompt text now uses this one check: the approval continuation, the saved model request, and the memory and skill results, in both entry points. Two of them used to carry their own copies of the check. As a result, an image-only Turn that crashed during a model request or a memory or skill step now also resumes instead of being refused.

The park refusal reason for a Prompt that still cannot be resumed is renamed from "Prompt text missing" to "original Prompt missing", matching the recovery error.

## Why it's needed

An image-only Prompt, such as a screenshot sent without words, is one of the wait shapes the first increment of Action parking keeps resident. Stage 0 (#18157) made parking and cold recovery share one set of Session-shape checks; this is the first relaxation built on it, and it relaxes park eligibility and cold recovery in the same change, as the design requires.

The pre-start check in #18151 confirmed that a cold-recovered Turn still hands the model its original image. So the text-plus-image Prompts that park today need no tightening, and this slice did not grow.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- An image-only Prompt that waits for a write approval parks after one idle period, with no park refusal counted. After a cold load and Allow, the tool runs exactly once, the resumed model call starts from empty text, and its history still holds the original image as inline data.
- The same image-only wait, when its Harness dies inside the wait, is taken over by a fresh Harness through a drive load. After Allow, the tool runs exactly once, with the same empty text and the same image.
- Both new cases fail against the previous check: the first never parks, and the second's takeover load is refused with a 503.
- Every existing park, resume, deny, expiry, re-park and recovery case passes unchanged.

Two points deserve scrutiny:

- The saved-model-request and memory or skill recovery paths now accept an image-only Turn too, because they share the check under test. They are covered only indirectly: existing recovery tests show that a saved model request restores inline images from a cold owner, but no route-level test drives an image-only crash in those phases.
- A Prompt with text still restarts from all text parts of its user record, attachment text included, as before. Only a Prompt without text reads its input back. The coverage design in #18151 proposed reading the input back for every Hosted Prompt; this PR keeps Prompts with text unchanged instead, and #18151 is updated to match.

Locally green on Linux:

- the full Hosted Harness Session suite (886 cases), with its idle-suspension group re-run on the final code;
- the recovery and Action parking suites (48 cases);
- ESLint and Prettier on the changed files;
- a narrow typecheck rooted at the changed files, which reports only the baseline's errors (see below).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change (Harness park eligibility and cold recovery).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit and integration tests only, no live deployment.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff:** cold recovery of an image-only Turn now resumes it instead of refusing it. It goes through the same mechanisms that already resume text-plus-image Turns.
- **Not validated / out of scope:**
  - The tests replace the model function, so the real request builder's eviction of earlier images is not exercised.
  - The full workspace typecheck could not run on the test machine, because the CLI package's typecheck runs out of memory. A narrower typecheck rooted at the changed files reports only the same 14 errors as the unmodified baseline, all in unrelated files. CI's typecheck is the authoritative check.
  - The second half of Stage 1, extension command-step approvals, comes in a separate PR.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** none. No wire, schema or configuration change. One key of the in-process suspension counts is renamed; only tests read those counts.

Design: S1 (§4.1) of the coverage design in #18151 (English and Chinese versions).

## Linked Issues

Part of #18149 (Stage 1, S1). Builds on #18157: this branch contains #18157's commit, so please review only the last commit until #18157 merges, after which this branch is rebased onto `main`.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

这是 #18149 提案阶段 1 的前一半（切片 S1）。只带图片或其他附件的 Prompt，在等待审批时现在可以停靠；同样的等待在 Harness 崩溃后也能恢复了。

在此之前，停靠资格和两个冷恢复入口（接管加载与常驻 redrive）都要求原始 Prompt 带文字，因为恢复后的 Turn 要从这段文字重新开始。纯图片 Prompt 过不了这一关：等待审批期间它一直常驻；如果 Harness 在等待中崩溃，冷恢复也会拒绝恢复它。

这个要求比实际需要的更严。恢复后的 Turn 会从持久化的输入资源里读回完整的原始输入，包括附件。恢复时这段文字只用来开启该 Turn 的预算，而纯图片 Prompt 的线上 Turn 本来就是以空文字运行的。

现在，共享的检查在 Prompt 没有文字时会退一步：读回原始输入，只要它带附件，Turn 就从空文字重新开始，和它线上运行时完全一样。带文字的 Prompt 不受影响。其他来源的输入仍然要求有文字，因为它们没有附件可读回。

冷恢复里所有要求原始 Prompt 文字的地方，现在都用这同一个检查：审批 continuation、保存的模型请求、memory 与 skill 结果，两个入口都是如此。其中两处原来各自带着一份副本。因此，纯图片 Turn 如果在模型请求或 memory、skill 步骤中崩溃，现在也会恢复，而不是被拒绝。

对仍然无法恢复的 Prompt，停靠拒绝原因从"缺少 Prompt 文字"改名为"缺少原始 Prompt"，与恢复时的错误一致。

## 为什么需要

纯图片 Prompt（比如只发一张截图、不带文字）是审批停靠首个增量仍保持常驻的等待形态之一。阶段 0（#18157）让停靠和冷恢复共用一套 Session 形态检查；这是在它之上的第一次放宽，并且按设计要求，在同一个改动里同时放宽停靠资格和冷恢复。

#18151 中的开工前检查已经确认：冷恢复后的 Turn 交给 model 的仍是原图。所以今天已允许停靠的"文字 + 图片"Prompt 不需要收紧，本切片的范围也没有变大。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 一个等待写入审批的纯图片 Prompt，在一个空闲周期后停靠，不记任何停靠拒绝。冷加载并 Allow 之后，工具恰好执行一次，恢复后的模型调用从空文字开始，历史里仍以 inline 数据保留着原图。
- 同样的纯图片等待，如果 Harness 在等待中死掉，会由新的 Harness 通过 drive 加载接管。Allow 之后工具恰好执行一次，文字同样为空，图片也相同。
- 两个新用例在旧的检查下都会失败：第一个永远不会停靠，第二个的接管加载会被以 503 拒绝。
- 既有的停靠、恢复、拒绝、到期、再次停靠与恢复用例都照常通过。

有两点值得仔细审查：

- 保存的模型请求、memory 与 skill 结果这几条恢复路径，因为共用被测的检查，现在也接受纯图片 Turn。它们只有间接覆盖：既有的恢复测试表明，保存的模型请求在冷 owner 上能还原 inline 图片；但没有路由级测试去驱动纯图片 Turn 在这些阶段崩溃。
- 带文字的 Prompt 仍然和以前一样，从其 user 记录的全部文字 part（包括附件文字）重新开始；只有没有文字的 Prompt 才会读回输入。#18151 中的覆盖面设计原本提议对所有 Hosted Prompt 都读回输入；本 PR 选择保持带文字的 Prompt 不变，#18151 也已同步更新。

本地在 Linux 上通过：

- Hosted Harness Session 全套（886 例），其中 idle-suspension 组在最终代码上又跑了一遍；
- 恢复与审批停靠的测试（48 例）；
- 改动文件上的 ESLint 和 Prettier；
- 以改动文件为入口的窄范围类型检查，只报出基线已有的错误（见下文）。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A —— 非 UI 改动（Harness 停靠资格与冷恢复）。

### 测试平台

🍏 macOS ⚠️ 未测；🪟 Windows ⚠️ 未测；🐧 Linux ✅。

### 环境

仅单元与集成测试，没有在实际部署中运行。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险/取舍：** 纯图片 Turn 的冷恢复现在会恢复它，而不是拒绝。走的是已经在恢复"文字 + 图片"Turn 的同一套机制。
- **未验证/范围外：**
  - 测试替换了 model 函数，所以真实请求构建时对旧图片的驱逐没有被执行。
  - 测试机器上跑不了完整的 workspace 类型检查，CLI 包的类型检查会内存溢出。以改动文件为入口的窄范围类型检查只报出与未改动基线相同的 14 个错误，都在无关文件里。以 CI 的类型检查为准。
  - 阶段 1 的另一半，extension command-step 审批，放在单独的 PR 里。
- **破坏性改动/迁移：** 无。没有 wire、schema 或配置改动。进程内挂起计数里有一个键改了名，这些计数只有测试读取。

设计：#18151 中覆盖面设计的 S1（§4.1），中英两版。

## 关联 Issue

属于 #18149（阶段 1，S1）。基于 #18157：本分支包含 #18157 的提交，在 #18157 合入之前请只评审最后一个提交；#18157 合入后，本分支会 rebase 到 `main`。

</details>

prs.title: feat(core): derive image token estimates from resolution instead of the flat constant
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Context accounting now derives the token cost of an inline image from its actual resolution instead of charging every image the same flat 1600-token constant. A new header-only parser (`utils/image-dimensions.ts`, PNG/GIF/JPEG/WebP, no full decode, no dependencies) reads pixel dimensions from the base64 payload, and `estimatePartChars` charges the patch-grid formula the omni pipeline already uses — `ceil(pixels / VISUAL_PIXELS_PER_TOKEN)`, with that constant now exported from `omni/estimation.ts` as the single source of truth. Unparseable payloads (other binary kinds, truncated headers, non-image mime types) keep the configured flat estimate as fallback.

## Why it's needed

A small screenshot and a 4K diagram cost identically under the flat constant, so the auto-compaction threshold ladder mis-sizes real sessions (the `image_overflow` trigger is a separate count-based backstop that fires on tool-image count, not token weight, and is unaffected by this change) — early for text-heavy conversations with small images, late for a few large ones (#17315). OpenAI Codex derives per-image tokens from bytes and detail (`compact_remote_v2_media.rs`), which is the design precedent; qwen-code's own omni pipeline already uses resolution-aware math for media delivery, so compaction counting now reuses the same formula.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/utils/image-dimensions.test.ts src/services/compactionInputSlimming.test.ts` — synthetic headers for all four formats parse to exact dimensions; `estimatePartChars` charges 1013×4 chars for a declared 1920×1080 PNG (vs the flat 1600×4), and keeps the flat budget for unparseable/non-image payloads.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅    |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: header parsing is best-effort; exotic or corrupted images fall back to the flat estimate, which is the current behavior for everything today.
- Not validated / out of scope: audio duration tokens (no audio history in compaction inputs today); provider-specific detail levels (the patch formula is the same conservative upper bound omni uses).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: a documented, env-overridable estimation knob (`imageTokenEstimate` / `QWEN_IMAGE_TOKEN_ESTIMATE`) changes from always-applied to override-only — explicitly configured values keep their effect; the default now derives from image resolution instead of the flat constant. Animated media (multi-frame GIF, WebP with ANIM flag) bills the flat estimate until frame counting lands. One limit of that rule: a configured value equal to the default (1600) is indistinguishable from unset, so it too derives from resolution; any other value keeps a flat price. `/context` prices media exactly as the compaction gate's estimators do, by resolution; the side-query transport guard alone floors a kept image at the configured estimate, because an over-stated room there is a non-retryable 400 that nothing recovers from.
- Design documents: N/A.

## Linked Issues

Closes #17315

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

本 PR 让上下文计数按图片实际分辨率而非固定 1600 token 常数计费：新增仅解析文件头的工具（PNG/GIF/JPEG/WebP，零依赖），`estimatePartChars` 对可解析的内联图片按 omni 管道既有的 patch 公式（像素数 / VISUAL_PIXELS_PER_TOKEN，常量已从 omni/estimation 导出为唯一事实源）计费；不可解析的负载保持原固定估算回退。

动机：小截图与 4K 图成本相同，自动压缩阈值阶梯与 image_overflow 触发器对真实会话双向失准（#17315）。OpenAI Codex 的按字节计费是设计先例；qwen 自家 omni 管道已有同款数学，压缩计数现复用同一公式。

验证：四格式合成头解析精确；1920×1080 PNG 计 1013×4 字符（原 1600×4）；不可解析保持扁平。风险：奇异/损坏图片回退即现状。迁移说明：估算旋钮从"总是应用"变为"仅作覆盖"——显式配置的值保持生效，默认改为按分辨率推导；动画媒体在帧数统计落地前按固定估算计费。该规则的一个限制：配置值恰等于默认值（1600）时与未配置无法区分，同样按分辨率推导，其他任意值则保持扁平价。`/context` 对媒体的计价与压缩门的估计器完全一致（按分辨率）；只有旁路查询的传输守卫会把保留的图片托底到配置的估算值，因为那里的余量高估是不可重试的 400，且没有任何恢复路径。关闭 #17315。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): enable per-workspace management from sidebar menu and hover overview
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This change turns every locally trusted workspace in the Web Shell left sidebar into a directly manageable entry point instead of restricting management controls to the primary workspace and keeping hover details read-only. Every locally trusted non-SSH workspace now exposes its own capability-gated management menu entries for MCP servers, Skills, Extensions, Channels, and Settings, while untrusted local workspaces gain a one-click Trust action directly inside the sidebar menu when the daemon supports granting trust.

In the workspace hover details popover, manageable overview rows for MCP, Skills, Extensions, Channels, Context, and Hooks become interactive rows with trailing chevrons and workspace-scoped accessible names so clicking any facet closes the popover cleanly without pulling focus back to the sidebar and jumps straight to that workspace's management surface. Selecting MCP, Skills, or Extensions opens the unified Plugins view on the matching tab targeted to the clicked workspace (also resolving an existing issue where opening MCP from the workspace menu could fall through to the session overview). Selecting Channels or Settings targets that workspace with a workspace switcher in the scope bar, selecting Context opens that workspace's instruction files dialog, and selecting Hooks opens a dedicated workspace hooks dialog showing configured hooks and hash-bound project-hook approval controls.

## Why it's needed

Previously, users managing multiple local workspaces from the Web Shell sidebar saw live health counts in the hover popover that could not be clicked, had no management entries at all in secondary workspace overflow menus, and had to leave the sidebar for the full Workspaces overview table just to trust an untrusted directory. Because the daemon already exposes workspace-scoped routes for MCP, Skills, Extensions, Channels, Settings, Memory, Hooks, and Trust grants, wiring the sidebar controls and management panels to the clicked workspace removes this asymmetry while keeping strict workspace isolation and graceful degradation for older daemons.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open Web Shell against a multi-workspace daemon with at least one primary trusted workspace, one secondary trusted workspace, and (optionally) one untrusted local workspace.
2. Open the overflow menu on a secondary trusted workspace: confirm the Manage group appears with MCP, Skills (when supported), Extensions, Channels (when supported), and Settings alongside live counts, whereas previously no Manage entries were shown.
3. Click Settings from that secondary workspace menu: confirm Settings opens with the Workspace scope bar showing a workspace switcher pre-selected to that secondary workspace, and confirm editing a workspace-scoped setting or extra directory targets that workspace without altering global UI preferences for other sessions.
4. Hover over the same secondary workspace row to open its details popover: confirm manageable facet rows (MCP, Skills, Extensions, Channels, Context, and Hooks when enabled) render as interactive rows with trailing chevrons and distinct workspace-scoped accessible names, while unsupported facets remain plain read-only rows.
5. Click the MCP row inside the hover popover: confirm the popover closes immediately without stealing focus back to the sidebar row and opens the Plugins panel on the MCP tab already scoped to that secondary workspace.
6. Click Extensions from a secondary workspace and confirm the Extensions tab exposes the workspace switcher and routes activation changes to that secondary workspace; click Context to open that workspace's instruction files dialog; click Hooks to inspect configured hooks and approve/reject pending project hooks.
7. Open the overflow menu on an untrusted local workspace (on a daemon advertising trust grant): confirm management entries stay hidden and a Trust workspace action appears, disables while the runtime rebuilds, and transitions to trusted controls once capabilities refresh.

### Evidence (Before & After)

All screenshots below were captured against the live local daemon (`127.0.0.1:4170`, 24 workspaces) targeting the same secondary trusted workspace (`qwen-code-doc`) with uniform blur/home state before interaction.

#### Secondary workspace overflow menu (Before vs After)

| Before (secondary menu had no Manage group) | After (secondary menu exposes Manage group with live counts) |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: secondary workspace overflow menu without Manage entries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/before-secondary-menu.png) | ![After: secondary workspace overflow menu with Manage entries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/after-secondary-menu.png) |

#### Workspace hover overview popover (Before vs After)

| Before (overview facets were read-only divs) | After (manageable facets are interactive buttons with chevrons) |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: hover overview popover with read-only facet rows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/before-hover-overview-readonly.png) | ![After: hover overview popover with interactive facet rows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/after-hover-overview-interactive.png) |

#### Direct secondary-workspace navigation (After)

| Clicking MCP from hover popover opens Plugins → MCP scoped to `qwen-code-doc` | Clicking Settings from secondary menu opens Settings scoped to `qwen-code-doc` |
| --- | --- |
| ![After: Plugins MCP tab scoped to secondary workspace qwen-code-doc](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/after-secondary-plugins-mcp.png) | ![After: Settings panel with workspace switcher scoped to secondary workspace qwen-code-doc](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/after-secondary-settings.png) |

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Linux x86_64, Node v26.12.1 (`NODE_OPTIONS=--no-experimental-webstorage` for jsdom vitest suites), Vite dev server proxying local `qwen serve` daemon on port 4170, Chromium headless shell via CDP for Before/After UI verification.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Allowing management panels to target secondary workspaces requires careful isolation so editing workspace-scoped settings, directories, or memory files never leaks into the active session's workspace or global UI preferences, and removing or revoking trust on a targeted workspace must cleanly fall back to the primary workspace or close workspace-scoped dialogs.
- Not validated / out of scope: Full repository `npm run build` was not executed inside the detached linked worktree because the worktree did not have a standalone `node_modules` tree (CI runs the full workspace build); cross-host remote workspaces, SSH workspaces, Managed workspaces, and primary-workspace rename persistence remain out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None; older daemons without split skills runtime, channel management, or trust grant capabilities degrade gracefully by omitting unsupported secondary actions or rendering read-only hover rows.

Design documents: [English](docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-workspace-overview.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-workspace-overview.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Part of #10399

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本次改动将 Web Shell 左侧栏中的每一个本地受信任工作区都升级为可直接管理的入口，不再局限于主工作区，也不再把悬停概览保持为纯只读展示。所有本地受信任的非 SSH 工作区现在都在侧栏 `⋮` 菜单中提供按能力门控的「管理」分组（MCP、技能、扩展、频道、设置）；当守护进程支持信任授权时，未受信任的本地工作区也会在侧栏菜单中直接提供一键「信任工作区」操作。

在工作区悬停详情浮层中，可管理的概览状态行（MCP、技能、扩展、频道、上下文、Hooks）升级为带右侧箭头的交互按钮，并附带包含工作区名称的无障碍标签，避免与侧栏全局导航撞名。点击任意状态行会立即关闭浮层且不把焦点抢回侧栏行，随后直接打开该工作区对应的管理页面或弹窗：点击 MCP、技能或扩展会进入统一的插件管理页对应标签页并锁定目标工作区（同步修复原先从菜单点 MCP 时可能落回会话总览页的问题）；点击频道或设置会带入目标工作区，并在设置页的工作区作用域栏提供工作区切换器；点击上下文会打开该工作区的指令文件弹窗；点击 Hooks 会打开独立的工作区 Hooks 弹窗，展示已配置 Hooks 及绑定哈希的项目 Hook 审批控制。

## 为什么需要这个改动

此前在多工作区模式下，用户悬停左侧栏工作区虽然能看到 MCP、技能、扩展、频道、上下文等实时计数，却无法直接点击跳转；次级工作区的 `⋮` 菜单完全缺失管理入口；想要信任一个未受信任目录时也必须跳到全页工作区总览表。由于守护进程已经具备完善的工作区级路由，将侧栏菜单、悬停浮层与各管理页面按目标工作区打通，既能消除主次工作区的体验割裂，又能在老版本守护进程上保持严格的作用域隔离和优雅降级。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 验证步骤

1. 在包含主工作区、至少一个受信任次级工作区（以及可选的未受信任本地工作区）的多工作区守护进程下打开 Web Shell。
2. 打开受信任次级工作区的 `⋮` 菜单：确认出现「管理」分组，包含 MCP、技能（能力就绪时）、扩展、频道（能力就绪时）和设置及实时计数，而改动前没有任何管理项。
3. 从该次级工作区菜单点击「设置」：确认进入设置页且工作区作用域栏展示工作区切换器并默认选中该次级工作区；修改工作区级设置或额外目录不会误改其他会话的全局界面偏好。
4. 悬停同一受信任次级工作区行打开详情浮层：确认可管理状态行（MCP、技能、扩展、频道、上下文，以及开启时的 Hooks）均渲染为带右侧箭头的按钮且 `aria-label` 包含工作区名称；不支持的状态项保持纯只读行。
5. 直接点击悬停浮层中的 MCP 行：确认浮层立即关闭且不抢夺焦点，并跳转到插件管理页的 MCP 标签页且工作区切换器自动选中该次级工作区。
6. 从次级工作区点击「扩展」，确认扩展标签页同样展示工作区切换器并将启停操作路由至该工作区；点击「上下文」确认加载该工作区的指令文件；点击「Hooks」确认展示该工作区的 Hooks 列表及待审批项目 Hook 控制。
7. 打开未受信任本地工作区的 `⋮` 菜单（守护进程支持信任授权时）：确认隐藏管理项并展示「信任工作区」，点击后在运行时重建期间呈禁用态，重建完成后自动切换为受信任菜单。

### 验证证据（改动前后对比）

以下截图均在连接本机真实守护进程（`127.0.0.1:4170`，24 个工作区）的 Chromium 环境中针对同一个受信任次级工作区（`qwen-code-doc`）采集，交互前保持统一的焦点与首页背景状态。

#### 次级工作区 `⋮` 下拉菜单（改前 vs 改后）

| 改动前（次级工作区菜单无「管理」分组） | 改动后（次级工作区菜单完整展示「管理」分组与实时计数） |
| --- | --- |
| ![改前：次级工作区下拉菜单缺少管理入口](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/before-secondary-menu.png) | ![改后：次级工作区下拉菜单展示管理分组与计数](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/after-secondary-menu.png) |

#### 工作区悬停详情浮层（改前 vs 改后）

| 改动前（状态行全为只读元素） | 改动后（可管理状态行升级为带右侧箭头的交互按钮） |
| --- | --- |
| ![改前：悬停详情浮层状态行为只读](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/before-hover-overview-readonly.png) | ![改后：悬停详情浮层状态行可点击直达](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/after-hover-overview-interactive.png) |

#### 次级工作区直达管理视图（改动后）

| 点击悬停浮层 MCP 行直达插件页 MCP 标签页（已锁定 `qwen-code-doc`） | 从次级菜单点击设置进入设置页（工作区切换器已选中 `qwen-code-doc`） |
| --- | --- |
| ![改后：插件页 MCP 标签页锁定次级工作区 qwen-code-doc](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/after-secondary-plugins-mcp.png) | ![改后：设置页展示工作区切换器并锁定次级工作区 qwen-code-doc](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/after-secondary-settings.png) |

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试 |

### 测试环境（可选）

Linux x86_64，Node v26.12.1（jsdom 单测加 `NODE_OPTIONS=--no-experimental-webstorage`），Vite 开发服务器代理本机 4170 守护进程，Chromium headless shell 经 CDP 完成改前/改后真实页面交互验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险与权衡：多工作区管理需要确保工作区级设置、额外目录与上下文文件编辑不会串改当前会话或全局界面偏好，同时在目标次级工作区被移除或失去信任时必须安全回退至主工作区或关闭工作区级弹窗。

prs.title: docs(managed-agent): design widening Action parking coverage and confirm two pre-start checks
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR adds the pre-implementation design, in English and Chinese, for widening Action parking beyond the first increment that #18115 shipped, and links it from the parent Action parking design's open questions 3 and 4. It is the design behind the staged proposal in #18149.

The design takes each wait shape the first increment still keeps resident and traces it to the code gate that actually excludes it: image-only Prompts, extension command-step approvals, a wait that coexists with background work, Turns started by wake inputs, child Sessions, Sessions with Hooks or MCP, and `uncaptured` batches, whose most common source is a Shell approval on a Workspace Shell profile. For each shape it proposes how cold recovery is extended to accept the wait and which single eligibility term is then relaxed. It also says which shapes stay unsupported and why: legacy v1/v2 waits, plans over the inline size limit, and, explicitly out of scope, team plan approvals and parking a parent that waits on a child.

The organizing rule is that a frozen wait is, to the journal, the same as a crash at the wait point, so park coverage can never exceed cold-recovery coverage. Each slice therefore extends cold recovery first and relaxes park eligibility in the same change, which also fixes crash recovery for that shape. The first slice folds the park and recovery eligibility checks into one function that returns a typed refusal reason. Counting those refusals is how the remaining slices get reordered by real-load share instead of by code-level estimates. Slices that change the seal certificate are gated by a writer-grant capability bit, and no configuration key is added.

The PR also settles two of the design's pre-start checks for the first slice with Harness tests, and the design now records both as confirmed. After a text-plus-image Prompt parks, is cold-loaded and is allowed, the history handed to the model on resume still holds the original image, so the text-plus-image Prompts that park today need no tightening. And a cold load that carries only the passive recovery flag, which is what decision delivery sends for a Workspace Session, takes the parked Turn over and resumes it. A Session with no Workspace and with verified recovery off gets a plain load from decision delivery instead; the design states that it does not cover that case for now.

## Why it's needed

The first increment parks only waits that cold recovery already accepted, so most real Sessions still pin a resident Harness while a human decision is pending. That residency is the remaining blocker on the way to the zero-idle stateless end state. The parent design left "what to include once cold recovery is extended" and "how to combine with the background certificate" as open questions. This design answers them with a reviewable slice plan before any implementation starts.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Most of this PR is documentation. Confirm that:

- both language versions have matching sections, decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria and open questions;
- the parent design links to the new design in both languages;
- the cited code locations match `main`;
- the two new Harness tests assert what the design now records as confirmed: the image test checks the exact user record parts handed to the model on resume and that the approved tool ran once, and the decision-delivery test cold-loads with only the passive flag, allows, and checks that the tool ran once and that the model was resumed from the tool results.

The image test replaces the model function, so it proves the restored history carries the image, not the request-time image eviction; the design keeps its request-snapshot check for the first slice. The cited files are unchanged between the commit the design was checked against and the current `main`.

The points that most deserve scrutiny:

- **Ordering rule.** Every slice must extend cold recovery before relaxing park eligibility.
- **Wake-started Turns.** These have no coordinator-held Turn row, so the design has the wake-recovery scan wake them, with one new nullable head column, instead of creating dispatch rows.
- **MCP.** Parking is tied to Phase 2 MCP parking, because without a retained catalog the rediscovered tool definitions cannot be proven unchanged at recovery.
- **Unverified assumptions.** Every conclusion marked "to verify" is drawn from code reading, not tests, and the design requires a test to confirm each before its slice is implemented.

Local checks: the idle-suspension group of the Hosted Harness Session suite passes on Linux, including both new tests; Prettier passes on every changed file and ESLint on the test file; every relative link resolves; and the heading structure of the two versions matches one-to-one.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — documentation and tests only.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit and integration tests only, no live deployment.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the slice order rests on code-level estimates, not measurements. The design makes the first slice produce refusal counts, and the order should be revisited from those counts before the later slices start.
- Not validated / out of scope: no production code is changed. Several conclusions are still marked "to verify". The most consequential:
  - whether the wake-recovery load is a passive takeover load;
  - where wake-started Turns are cancelled today;
  - whether the Phase 1 relay attempt-budget gap is closed;
  - whether Shell execution has a prepare-without-dispatch step with exact-key replay.

  Team plan approvals, parking a parent that waits on a child, and the plain load that decision delivery sends to a Session with no Workspace and with verified recovery off are out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no production code is changed. The proposed implementation adds one nullable Session head column by editing the V1 schema baseline in place, plus writer-grant capability bits, and keeps everything behind the existing default-off Action parking setting.

Design document: [`docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.md`](docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.md) and [`docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.zh-CN.md`](docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Part of #18149. References #18115 (first increment) and #18047 (Action parking design). Related: #17527 (stateless Hosted Harness design), #17953 (Phase 3b) and #17749 (Phase 2 MCP parking).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

本 PR 新增一份实现前设计（中英两版），把审批停靠从 #18115 交付的首个增量往外扩展，并在父设计（审批停靠设计）的开放问题 3 和 4 处加上指向它的链接。#18149 中的分阶段提案就以这份设计为依据。

设计逐一梳理首个增量仍保持常驻的等待形态，并找到真正把它们排除在外的代码闸门：纯图片 Prompt、extension command-step 审批、与后台任务同时存在的等待、由 wake 输入启动的 Turn、子 Session、带 Hooks 或 MCP 的 Session，以及 `uncaptured` 批次。`uncaptured` 最常见的来源是 Workspace Shell profile 下的 Shell 审批。对每种形态，设计说明冷恢复如何扩展以接受这种等待，以及随后放宽哪一项资格条件。设计也说明了哪些形态保持不支持、为什么：遗留的 v1/v2 等待、超过 inline 大小上限的计划；团队计划审批和"父等子"停靠则明确列为范围外。

组织全文的规则是：冻结的等待对 journal 来说，等同于在等待点崩溃，因此停靠覆盖面永远不能超过冷恢复覆盖面。所以每个切片都先扩展冷恢复，再在同一改动里放宽停靠资格，这也顺带修好了该形态的崩溃恢复。第一个切片把停靠与恢复的资格判断合成一个函数，并让它返回带类型的拒绝原因。统计这些拒绝次数之后，后续切片就能按真实负载中的占比排序，而不是靠代码级估算。改变 seal 证书的切片由 writer grant 能力位把关，不新增配置项。

本 PR 还用 Harness 测试完成了第一个切片的两项开工前检查，设计中两项都已改为已确认。一个"文字 + 图片"Prompt 停靠、冷加载、Allow 之后，恢复时交给 model 的历史里仍有原图，所以今天已允许停靠的"文字 + 图片"Prompt 不需要收紧。只带被动恢复标志的冷加载（Workspace Session 投递决定时发出的正是这种加载）会接管停靠的 Turn 并让它恢复。没有 Workspace 且未开启 verified recovery 的 Session，投递决定时收到的是普通加载；设计写明暂不考虑这种情况。

## 为什么需要

首个增量只停靠冷恢复已经接受的等待，所以在等待人工决定期间，大部分真实 Session 仍然钉住一个常驻 Harness。这种常驻是通往零空闲无状态终态的剩余阻塞。父设计把"冷恢复扩展后纳入哪些范围"和"如何与后台证书组合"留作开放问题。本设计在开始任何实现之前，用一份可评审的切片计划回答了这两个问题。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

本 PR 以文档为主。请确认：

- 两种语言版本的章节、决定、约束、验收标准与开放问题一致；
- 父设计在两种语言中都链接到新设计；
- 引用的代码位置与 `main` 相符；
- 两个新的 Harness 测试断言的正是设计中改为已确认的内容：图片测试检查恢复时交给 model 的 user 记录的完整 parts，以及被批准的工具只执行一次；决定投递测试只带被动标志冷加载、Allow，然后检查工具只执行一次，且 model 从工具结果恢复。

图片测试替换了 model 函数，所以它证明的是恢复出的历史带有图片，而不是发请求时的图片驱逐；设计为第一个切片保留了请求快照检查。设计核对时所用的提交与当前 `main` 之间，被引用的文件没有变化。

最值得仔细审查的是：

- **顺序规则。** 每个切片都必须先扩展冷恢复，再放宽停靠资格。
- **wake 启动的 Turn。** 这类 Turn 没有协调器持有的 Turn 行，设计让 wake 恢复扫描来唤醒它们，只新增一个可空的 head 列，而不是新建分派行。
- **MCP。** 停靠与第二阶段的 MCP parking 绑定，因为不保留目录时，无法证明恢复时重新发现的工具定义没有变化。
- **未经验证的假设。** 每个标为"待验证"的结论都来自代码阅读而非测试，设计要求在对应切片实现前用测试逐一确认。

本地检查：Hosted Harness Session 测试中的 idle suspension 组在 Linux 上通过，包括两个新测试；所有改动文件通过 Prettier，测试文件通过 ESLint；所有相对链接都能解析；两种语言的标题结构逐一对应。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A —— 只有文档与测试。

### 测试平台

🍏 macOS ⚠️ 未测；🪟 Windows ⚠️ 未测；🐧 Linux ✅。

### 环境

仅单元与集成测试，没有在实际部署中运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：切片顺序基于代码级估算，不是测量结果。设计让第一个切片产出拒绝计数，开始后续切片之前应根据这些计数重新审视顺序。
- 未验证/范围外：没有生产代码改动。仍有若干结论标为"待验证"，其中影响最大的是：
  - wake 恢复加载是否是被动接管加载；
  - wake 启动的 Turn 现在在哪里被取消；
  - 第一阶段遗留的 relay 尝试预算缺口是否已关闭；
  - Shell 执行是否有"只 prepare 不派发"、可按精确 key 重放的步骤。

  团队计划审批、"父等子"停靠，以及决定投递给没有 Workspace 且未开启 verified recovery 的 Session 发出的普通加载，都在范围外。
- 破坏性改动/迁移：无，没有生产代码改动。拟议的实现会通过原地修改 V1 schema 基线新增一个可空的 Session head 列，并增加 writer grant 能力位；所有改动都在现有默认关闭的审批停靠设置之后。

设计文档：[`docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.md`](docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.md) 与 [`docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.zh-CN.md`](docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

属于 #18149。引用 #18115（首个增量）与 #18047（审批停靠设计）。相关：#17527（无状态 Hosted Harness 设计）、#17953（第三阶段 3b）与 #17749（第二阶段 MCP parking）。

</details>

prs.title: feat(cli): refuse new sessions under sustained host load
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds host-load admission for daemon operations that would allocate a fresh ACP child. A two-second monitor combines per-core host load average, event-loop p99 lag, and observation-gap protection, with three consecutive samples required to enter or leave overload. During sustained overload, create/load/resume/branch/cold delegated work is refused with `503 system_overloaded`, `Retry-After: 15`, and the actual measurements. Default scheduled-task creation is refused before task metadata is written; per-run refusals preserve the task and unsuccessful attempt history, and restore a paused one-shot task. Branch/worktree admission is checked before git preparation, while the final reservation and existing failure rollback remain the authoritative second line of defense. Ordinary spawn or dispatch failures retain their existing errors.

Already admitted work remains available: prompts, cancellation, status, detach, navigation, and explicitly targeted warm sessions are not rejected by this gate. This does not stop the daemon or disable all session operations. `/fork` background Agents continue to share their parent runtime. The decision is exposed through `runtime.loadAdmission` on `GET /daemon/status` and the `system_overloaded` issue. `--no-load-admission` is the explicit opt-out; injected bridges without the monitor remain ungated. Design: [English](docs/design/load-based-session-admission.md) / [简体中文](docs/design/load-based-session-admission.zh-CN.md). The coordinated Web Shell changes are in #18054.

## Why it's needed

Under heavy host load, every newly admitted task could allocate another full ACP child, deepening saturation until even status and cancellation stopped responding. Existing session and prompt caps only count work; they do not measure whether the machine can sustain another child. Failing fast before additional allocation lets load drain while keeping the control plane and existing sessions usable. The response remains machine-readable so clients can preserve drafts and retry deliberately rather than presenting an ordinary server failure.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Start a bundled daemon with an isolated runtime and workspace. Create a real session while healthy and apply actual host load until `/daemon/status` reports overload. Confirm that fresh standalone creation, cold resume, and a default scheduled task that needs a fresh child return 503 with `Retry-After: 15` and real load fields, without allocating a child or persisting the refused scheduled task. Trigger a per-run task and confirm that its failed dispatch is retained and its bound source is not replaced; a paused one-shot is restored. Attempt branch/worktree creation and confirm that the refusal occurs before creating the git branch/worktree, without changing ordinary worktree-creation errors into overload responses.

While overloaded, confirm that an existing warm target can accept a prompt with one dispatch and no new ACP child, while status, navigation, cancellation, and detach remain usable. Stop the load and confirm that the monitor recovers after its exit debounce and cold resume allocates a child again. Finally start with `--no-load-admission` and confirm that creation is not gated by this monitor.

Automated verification at `13345ab766`: all 1542 tests in `src/serve/server.test.ts`, all 140 in `src/serve/routes/scheduled-tasks.test.ts`, all 1136 bridge tests, and all 246 focused load/admission lifecycle tests passed. The final coordinated build with #18054 also passed `npm run build && npm run bundle`; its bundle SHA-256 is `ac1abf0f3d3fba61d0cb565bda8e9d1dcf6fb2f09ffdfb809adefbe66d2b368e`. This is not a claim that hosted CI has completed; that is tracked separately on the PR.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The baseline below was captured before this feature: under load ratio 2.23, `POST /session` still returned 200 and allocated a child. The patched daemon instead fails the allocation with the overload error contract.

![Before: the unguarded baseline admits another session under heavy host load](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/load-admission/before.png)

![After: the guarded daemon returns 503 system_overloaded and Retry-After 15](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/load-admission/after-503.png)

The final coordinated head `32dfd960c46f` contains gate `13345ab766` and Web Shell `49839e0103`, and was rebuilt and bundled before a real Linux Chromium probe against a private daemon. The probe exercised actual 32-core host load from 72 nice-19 burners, actual ACP child counts, persistent scheduled tasks, warm navigation, standalone ownership, cold restoration, and recovery. It completed with zero assertion failures and cleaned up its daemon, browser, and burners. The browser images are genuine captures, not generated UI mock-ups; the text file is a labelled excerpt of the run's machine-generated log.

![Final Chromium evidence: a compact overload indicator stays visible outside Home](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/576ef7c1b0b671393d95f53a7772a4b898e0ba2e/load-admission-ui/r7-overload-warning-rail.png)

![Final Chromium evidence: an existing warm session remains usable during overload](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/576ef7c1b0b671393d95f53a7772a4b898e0ba2e/load-admission-ui/r7-warm-session-admitted.png)

[Machine-generated live-probe assertion excerpt, archive result, bundle hash, and cleanup marker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/576ef7c1b0b671393d95f53a7772a4b898e0ba2e/load-admission-ui/r7-live-probe-evidence.txt)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local `npm run build && npm run bundle`, loopback daemon HTTP, isolated private runtime/conversation/workspace directories, real Playwright Chromium and daemon ACP children. Load was generated with nice-19 CPU burners on a 32-core host. No mock daemon, injected CPU readings, generated UI images, or replacement of the production renderer were used.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: host load average is not a per-daemon CPU measurement and can reflect IO pressure or host-wide activity. Conservative thresholds, event-loop lag, exit debounce, the status indicator, and `--no-load-admission` bound the impact. A race after preflight is still handled by final reservation and rollback rather than by disabling checks.
- Not validated / out of scope: live macOS/Windows behavior, cgroup-specific CPU-accounting calibration, and a memory-pressure admission signal. Windows supplies zero `os.loadavg()` by platform design, so event-loop lag carries that signal there. The real Chromium probe ran on Linux; it did not exercise every browser or every possible busy-client combination. Other attached clients and active prompts still use the server's existing ownership and busy protections.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. New opt-out behavior is explicit, status fields are additive, and refusal responses are limited to new-child allocation during sustained overload. The coordinated Web Shell behavior is delivered separately in #18054.

## Linked Issues

Refs #18054

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

为需要分配新 ACP child 的 daemon 操作增加主机负荷准入。监视器每两秒采样每核主机 load average、事件循环 p99 延迟并保护观测间隙，进入和退出过载均要求连续三次采样。持续过载期间，create/load/resume/branch/冷委派以 `503 system_overloaded`、`Retry-After: 15` 和真实负荷字段拒绝。默认定时任务创建在写入元数据前拒绝；per-run 拒绝保留任务和失败派发历史，并恢复已暂停的一次性任务。branch/worktree 在 git 准备前检查准入，最终 reservation 及既有失败回滚仍负责预检后的竞态。普通 spawn 或 dispatch 失败继续使用原错误，不会一律变成 overload。

已准入的工作保持可用：prompt、cancel、status、detach、导航和明确指定 warm 会话的请求不被此闸门拒绝；不会关闭 daemon 或禁止所有会话操作。`/fork` 后台 Agent 继续复用父 runtime。状态通过 `GET /daemon/status` 的 `runtime.loadAdmission` 和 `system_overloaded` issue 透出。`--no-load-admission` 显式退出，未启用监视器的 injected bridge 不设此闸。设计文档：[English](docs/design/load-based-session-admission.md) / [简体中文](docs/design/load-based-session-admission.zh-CN.md)。配套 Web Shell 改动见 #18054。

## 为什么需要

高负荷时每个新建任务都可能再分配完整 ACP child，使饱和不断加深，最终连 status 和 cancel 都无法及时响应。既有会话和 prompt 上限只计算工作数量，不衡量机器还能否承担新 child。在新增分配之前快速失败可以让负荷下降，同时保住控制面和已有会话。客户端也可读取结构化拒绝，保留草稿并明确重试，而不是把它误当成普通服务端故障。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

用隔离 runtime 和 workspace 启动 bundle 后的 daemon。健康时创建真实会话，用真实主机负荷使 `/daemon/status` 报告过载。确认新 standalone、冷恢复、需要新 child 的默认定时任务均返回 503、`Retry-After: 15` 和真实负荷字段，且不分配 child、不落盘被拒绝的任务。触发 per-run 任务，确认失败派发历史及原绑定保留；已暂停的一次性任务应恢复。尝试 branch/worktree，确认在创建 git 分支/worktree 前拒绝，且普通创建错误不被误改成 overload。

过载期间，现有 warm target 应能以一次派发接受 prompt 且不新增 ACP child，status、导航、取消和 detach 仍可用。停止负荷，确认退出迟滞结束后恢复，冷恢复再次分配 child。最后以 `--no-load-admission` 启动，确认本监视器不再设闸。

`13345ab766` 上的自动化验证：`src/serve/server.test.ts` 共 1542 项、`src/serve/routes/scheduled-tasks.test.ts` 共 140 项、bridge 共 1136 项、load/admission 生命周期相关共 246 项测试通过。与 #18054 的最终联合树也通过 `npm run build && npm run bundle`，bundle SHA-256 为 `ac1abf0f3d3fba61d0cb565bda8e9d1dcf6fb2f09ffdfb809adefbe66d2b368e`。这不代表托管 CI 已完成，CI 状态以 PR 实时检查为准。

### 证据（前后对照）

下图基线拍于本功能之前：负荷比 2.23 时 `POST /session` 仍返回 200 并分配 child。修复后 daemon 按 overload 契约拒绝新增分配。

![修复前：未设闸基线在高负荷下仍创建会话](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/load-admission/before.png)

![修复后：daemon 返回 503 system_overloaded 和 Retry-After 15](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/load-admission/after-503.png)

最终联合提交 `32dfd960c46f` 包含 gate `13345ab766` 与 Web Shell `49839e0103`，在真实 Linux Chromium 探针前重新 build/bundle。探针使用 32 核主机上的 72 个 nice-19 burner、真实 ACP child 计数、持久化定时任务、warm 导航、standalone owner、冷恢复及冷却后恢复，断言零失败并清理 daemon、浏览器和 burner。浏览器图片是真实截图，不是生成的 UI 示意图；文本为机器日志的明确标注摘录。

![最终 Chromium 证据：非 Home 页面仍可见紧凑过载指示](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/576ef7c1b0b671393d95f53a7772a4b898e0ba2e/load-admission-ui/r7-overload-warning-rail.png)

![最终 Chromium 证据：过载时已有 warm 会话仍可使用](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/576ef7c1b0b671393d95f53a7772a4b898e0ba2e/load-admission-ui/r7-warm-session-admitted.png)

[实机探针断言摘录、归档结果、bundle 哈希及清理标记](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/576ef7c1b0b671393d95f53a7772a4b898e0ba2e/load-admission-ui/r7-live-probe-evidence.txt)

### 测试平台

Linux ✅ 实测；macOS ⚠️ 未实测；Windows ⚠️ 未实测。

### 环境

本地 `npm run build && npm run bundle`、loopback daemon HTTP、私有隔离 runtime/conversation/workspace、真实 Playwright Chromium 与 daemon ACP child。负荷由 32 核主机上的 nice-19 CPU burner 产生。没有 mock daemon、注入 CPU 指标、生成式 UI 图片或替换生产 renderer。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：主机 load average 不是每 daemon CPU 占用，可能反映 IO 压力或全主机活动。保守阈值、事件循环延迟、退出迟滞、状态提示及 `--no-load-admission` 限制影响。预检后的竞态继续由最终 reservation 和回滚处理。
- 未验证/范围外：macOS/Windows 实机、cgroup 专属 CPU 计量校准、内存压力准入。Windows 的 `os.loadavg()` 按平台设计为零，因此由事件循环延迟承担该信号。真实 Chromium 仅覆盖 Linux；没有逐一覆盖每个浏览器或所有 busy-client 组合。其它附着 client 和活动 prompt 仍由服务端既有 owner/busy 保护。
- 破坏性变更/迁移：无。退出监视器须显式配置，状态字段为加性，拒绝仅作用于持续过载期间的新 child 分配。配套 Web Shell 行为由 #18054 交付。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #18054

</details>

prs.title: perf(serve): defer ACP workflow history until requested
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Defer interrupted workflow recovery and persisted snapshot loading until a session requests workflow history. Concurrent first requests for the same workflow store share the recovery. Retry, rerun, and deletion can recover a known run by ID before its history is listed.

## Why it's needed

Ordinary session creation waits for checkpoint discovery and reads every saved workflow snapshot. The first text prompt can proceed without accessing the workflow store. With 30 saved snapshots, the candidate removed 30 snapshot reads from session creation.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Create a session in a trusted workspace with saved runs and an abandoned checkpoint. Send a plain prompt and verify that the model receives it while the checkpoint remains on disk.
- Query workflow history from two sessions in that workspace. Both views show the recovered failure once. A checkpoint owned by a live writer stays in place.
- Before listing history, retry or delete a known interrupted run by ID. Retry finishes under the same run ID, deletion removes its artifacts, and a second workspace sees its own history.

### Evidence (Before & After)

On `ac4ae44c`, the initial session request claimed the abandoned checkpoint. With the change, the checkpoint survived the first model request and was claimed on the workflow-inclusive task query.

In 20 paired macOS cold starts with seven registered workspaces and 30 synthetic snapshots in the target workspace, the median paired savings were 56.4 ms for session creation and 62.9 ms from launch to the loopback model receiving the prompt. The isolated baseline scan took 4.9 ms at P50. Empty-history and single-workspace cohorts did not establish a first-prompt gain.

### Tested on

| OS          | Status                                                    |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| macOS arm64 | Verified with the packaged daemon and loopback model stub |
| Linux       | Pending                                                   |
| Windows     | Pending                                                   |

### Environment

Apple M4, Node 22.23.5, fresh daemon processes, warm OS file cache, and unpinned CPU. The benchmark measures the daemon-to-model request path.

## Risk & Scope

- The first workflow-inclusive query can write a failed snapshot, remove a checkpoint, and invoke existing retention. The query keeps its owning-session, workspace trust, and workflow controls gates. Its median paired overhead in the seven-workspace history cohort was 3.7 ms.
- A checkpoint that becomes abandoned after a session's first history query is picked up by a later session's first query or an action by run ID. Browser timing and production storage latency remain to be measured.
- The change uses the existing API and persisted formats, with no migration. See the [English design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/a1dc1cd551523d9cac4c556b6eddc20c1cc1ee06/docs/design/acp-on-demand-workflow-history.md) and [Chinese design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/a1dc1cd551523d9cac4c556b6eddc20c1cc1ee06/docs/design/acp-on-demand-workflow-history.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 改动

将中断工作流恢复和持久化快照读取推迟到会话请求工作流历史时。同一个工作流存储的并发首次查询共享恢复。首次查询前，重试、重跑和删除也可以按 ID 恢复目标运行。

## 原因

普通建会话需要等待检查点发现，并读取每条已保存的工作流快照。纯文本首问无需访问工作流存储。含 30 条快照时，候选从建会话路径省掉了 30 次快照读取。

## 审查验证

### 验证方法

- 在含已保存运行记录和中断检查点的可信工作区新建会话。发送纯文本首问，验证模型收到请求时检查点仍在磁盘上。
- 从同一工作区的两个会话请求工作流历史。两个视图都返回一条恢复后的失败记录，活跃写入进程的检查点依然保留。
- 在首次查历史前，按 ID 重试或删除中断运行。重试沿用原 ID 并完成，删除清理运行产物，第二个工作区显示自己的历史。

### 前后对照

在 `ac4ae44c` 基线上，建会话会认领中断检查点。应用改动后，首个模型请求到达时检查点仍然保留，随后由包含工作流的任务查询认领。

在 macOS 上测试了 20 对冷启动，环境含七个注册工作区，目标工作区含 30 条合成快照。建会话成对节省中位数为 56.4 ms，进程启动至本地模拟模型收到首问为 62.9 ms。基线扫描的独立计时 P50 为 4.9 ms。空历史和单工作区样本没有建立可重复的首问时延收益。

### 验证平台

| 系统        | 状态                                 |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------ |
| macOS arm64 | 已用打包版 daemon 和回环模拟模型验证 |
| Linux       | 待验证                               |
| Windows     | 待验证                               |

### 实验环境

Apple M4、Node 22.23.5、全新 daemon 进程、保留操作系统文件缓存、CPU 未绑核。实验测量 daemon 到模型请求的链路。

## 风险与范围

- 首次包含工作流的查询可以写入失败快照、移除检查点并执行已有保留策略。查询继续检查归属会话、工作区信任和工作流开关。七工作区有历史档的成对额外耗时中位数为 3.7 ms。
- 当前会话首次查历史后出现的中断检查点，会由后续会话首次查询或按 ID 操作处理。浏览器耗时和生产存储延迟待测。
- 改动沿用已有 API 和持久化格式，无需迁移。参见[英文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/a1dc1cd551523d9cac4c556b6eddc20c1cc1ee06/docs/design/acp-on-demand-workflow-history.md)与[中文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/a1dc1cd551523d9cac4c556b6eddc20c1cc1ee06/docs/design/acp-on-demand-workflow-history.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联议题

无。

</details>

prs.title: feat(core): add DeepInfra provider preset, service_tier support, and interactive model selection panel
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR introduces end-to-end support for DeepInfra as a built-in third-party provider preset, implements full `service_tier` routing support (enabling DeepInfra's 20% discounted Flex tier as well as OpenAI service tiers), and replaces manual model identifier typing in provider setup with a rich, interactive `ModelSelectionPanel` component.

Specifically, the implementation includes:
1. **DeepInfra Provider Preset (`packages/core/src/providers/presets/deepinfra.ts`)**: Registers DeepInfra (`AuthType.USE_OPENAI`, base URL `https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai`, environment variable `DEEPINFRA_API_KEY`) with `modelsEditable: true`, dual-gate ownership checks, and attribution headers (`HTTP-Referer`, `X-Title`).
2. **End-to-End `service_tier` Support**: Adds `service_tier` ('flex' | 'priority' | string) across configuration layers (`ContentGeneratorConfig`, `ModelGenerationConfig`, `ProviderConfig`), CLI options (`--service-tier`), and resolves it through `modelConfigResolver`. Injects `service_tier` into outgoing HTTP payloads across both `openaiContentGenerator` (Chat Completions) and `openaiResponsesContentGenerator` (Responses pipeline).
3. **Daemon Model Metadata Proxy Route (`/workspace/auth/deepinfra-models`)**: Queries `https://api.deepinfra.com/models/list` with an in-memory cache (TTL: 1 hour) to retrieve ~170 live models. Parses model type, context window (`max_tokens`), quantization formats (`fp32`, `fp8`, `int4`, etc.), pricing (`cents_per_input_token` and `cents_per_output_token` normalized to `$/Mt`), and tier tags (`flex`, `priority`). 
4. **Interactive `ModelSelectionPanel` (`packages/web-shell/client/components/messages/ModelSelectionPanel.tsx`)**: An interactive catalog table featuring real-time name and task search, filter dropdowns for task type, dynamic quantizations, and context lengths up to 1024k, four subline toggle buttons with inline SVG icons (`✨ Featured`, `🏷️ Discount`, `⚡ Priority`, `⏱️ Flex`), and separate sortable columns for `In ($/Mt)` and `Out ($/Mt)` pricing. Checkboxes allow multi-selecting models with real-time synchronization to the comma-separated model IDs input, which remains editable for custom models.
5. **CLI & Desktop Auth Integration**: Adds DeepInfra to interactive `qwen auth` workflows and preserves `DEEPINFRA_API_KEY` in daemon environment snapshots for workspace tasks.

## Why it's needed

DeepInfra provides serverless inference API (including Qwen, Deepseek, Nemotron, ...). Furthermore, its Flex service tier provides a 20% cost reduction (0.8× pricing) for throughput-oriented tasks. Previously, users had to set up DeepInfra as a generic custom provider and had no way to pass `service_tier: "flex"` to request bodies. In addition, configuring editable-model providers previously required users to manually research, remember, and type model IDs into a bare text input without knowing context windows, quantization variants, or input/output pricing.

### Why this change exceeds 2,000 lines and needs to land together

This PR exceeds 2,000 lines because it represents the complete, cohesive integration of a Tier 1 provider preset:
- Backend preset registration and security dual-gate ownership (`packages/core/src/providers/`).
- End-to-end `service_tier` typing, resolution, and wire serialization in both Chat Completions and Responses generator engines (`packages/core/src/core/`, `packages/core/src/models/`).
- Daemon proxy route with server-side caching, metadata mapping, and model filtering (`packages/cli/src/serve/routes/`).
- CLI commands, config schema, options, and daemon env snapshots (`packages/cli/src/`).
- Frontend interactive `ModelSelectionPanel` component, styles, and Web Shell auth integration (`packages/web-shell/client/components/messages/`).
- Full unit test coverage across all packages (preset tests, resolver tests, wire payload tests, daemon route tests, and React component tests) and documentation updates.

Splitting this PR into isolated fragments would leave the repository in incomplete intermediate states (e.g., a backend preset without frontend model selection, or a UI attempting to consume an unreleased daemon proxy route). Landing the entire feature together guarantees architectural consistency and a fully functional user experience.

### Tier 1 — Built-in Preset Criteria Disclosure

As required by `CONTRIBUTING.md` for Tier 1 provider presets:
- **Affiliation Disclosure**: The PR author is a regular paying customer of DeepInfra and has no commercial affiliation, employment, partnership, or financial interest in DeepInfra.
- **Operational Maturity**: DeepInfra operates publicly with high availability and transparent uptime tracking. Their public status page and incident history are accessible at https://status.deepinfra.com/.
- **Organic User Demand**: Requested by the author ("only me so far") to enable low-cost, high-throughput open model inference with Flex tier support in Qwen Code.
- **Data and Security Transparency**: DeepInfra publishes a documented Zero Data Retention (ZDR) policy confirming that prompt and completion data are not retained or used for training.
- **Maintenance Commitment**: No ongoing maintenance commitment is given by the PR author; maintenance is community-driven.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. **Verify Backend Provider Preset & Service Tier Wire Propagation**:
   - Run unit tests:
     ```bash
     cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/providers/__tests__/presets/deepinfra.test.ts src/models/modelConfigResolver.test.ts src/core/openaiContentGenerator/provider/default.test.ts src/core/openaiResponsesContentGenerator/responses-pipeline.test.ts
     ```
   - Verify that setting `service_tier: "flex"` in provider/model configuration or `--service-tier flex` results in `"service_tier": "flex"` in the HTTP payload.

2. **Verify Daemon Proxy Endpoint**:
   - Run unit tests:
     ```bash
     cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/routes/workspace-auth.test.ts
     ```
   - Confirm that GET `/workspace/auth/deepinfra-models` returns parsed model metadata with context, quant, pricing in `$/Mt`, and excludes `anthropic/*` models.

3. **Verify Interactive Model Selection Panel**:
   - Run component tests:
     ```bash
     cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/components/messages/ModelSelectionPanel.test.tsx client/components/messages/AuthMessage.dom.test.tsx
     ```
   - Launch the Desktop app or Web Shell, navigate to Settings → Connect a Provider → DeepInfra. Enter an API key and proceed to Step 4 ("Model IDs").
   - Test search by typing model names (e.g., "deepseek").
   - Test dropdown filters (Type, Quant, Context length including 1024k).
   - Test toggle buttons: click `Featured`, `Discount`, `Priority`, and `Flex` and confirm the table filters to matching models.
   - Click column headers for `In ($/Mt)` and `Out ($/Mt)` to confirm independent sorting.
   - Select checkboxes to confirm model IDs synchronize to the comma-separated text box at the bottom.

### Evidence (Before & After)

#### Before
In Step 4 ("Model IDs") of provider setup, users were presented with only a plain text input with no guidance on available models, requiring them to leave the application, look up model identifiers manually, and guess their context windows, quantization variants, and token pricing.

#### After: Interactive Model Selection Panel in Action

**1. Full Model Selection Panel Overview**
An interactive table displays ~170 live models with context windows, quantization tags, and token pricing in $/Mt:
![Model Selection Panel Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alphataubio/qwen-code-alphataubio/alphataubio-deepinfra/docs/design/assets/deepinfra-model-selection-modal.png)

**2. Filter Toolbar & Toggle Buttons**
Live search, task type dropdown, dynamic quantization dropdown, context window dropdown (including 1024k), four toggle buttons with inline SVG icons (`✨ Featured`, `🏷️ Discount`, `⚡ Priority`, `⏱️ Flex`), and independent sortable headers for `In ($/Mt)` and `Out ($/Mt)`:
![Filter Toolbar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alphataubio/qwen-code-alphataubio/alphataubio-deepinfra/docs/design/assets/deepinfra-model-selection-filters.png)

**3. Selection Summary & Manual Input Synchronization**
Selected model counter with "Select all visible", prompt guidance examples, and a synchronized editable comma-separated input field:
![Selection Input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alphataubio/qwen-code-alphataubio/alphataubio-deepinfra/docs/design/assets/deepinfra-model-selection-input.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

- Node.js v24.6.0 on macOS Darwin arm64.
- Verified in Qwen Code Desktop (Tauri) and local daemon Web Shell.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: The daemon proxy endpoint `/workspace/auth/deepinfra-models` contacts `api.deepinfra.com/models/list` to fetch the catalog. An in-memory cache with a 1-hour TTL is used to prevent external rate limiting. If the network request fails, the UI gracefully falls back to displaying empty results while allowing manual text entry.
- Not validated / out of scope: DeepInfra asynchronous offline batch processing APIs (DeepInfra Flex is a synchronous API call).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. All changes are backward compatible and additive. Existing custom provider configurations are unaffected.

## Linked Issues

No existing issue tracker issue was filed prior to this PR.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 变更内容

本 PR 为 Qwen Code 提供了完整的 DeepInfra 内置第三方服务商预设支持，实现了端到端的 `service_tier` 路由能力（支持 DeepInfra 享受 20% 折扣的 Flex 服务层级以及 OpenAI 的 service tier），并在服务商接入流程中引入了交互式 `ModelSelectionPanel` 模型选择面板，取代了以往需要用户纯手动输入模型 ID 的繁琐体验。

具体实现包含：
1. **DeepInfra 服务商预设（`packages/core/src/providers/presets/deepinfra.ts`）**：注册 DeepInfra 预设（`AuthType.USE_OPENAI`，基地址 `https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai`，环境变量 `DEEPINFRA_API_KEY`），开启 `modelsEditable: true`，提供双重门禁归属判断以及请求归属标头（`HTTP-Referer`、`X-Title`）。
2. **端到端 `service_tier` 支持**：在配置层（`ContentGeneratorConfig`、`ModelGenerationConfig`、`ProviderConfig`）、CLI 选项（`--service-tier`）中增加 `service_tier`（'flex' | 'priority' | string），通过 `modelConfigResolver` 进行解析，并在 `openaiContentGenerator`（Chat Completions）与 `openaiResponsesContentGenerator`（Responses 调用链路）的请求体中透传 `service_tier`。
3. **守护进程模型元数据代理路由（`/workspace/auth/deepinfra-models`）**：请求 `https://api.deepinfra.com/models/list` 并加入 1 小时内存缓存，获取约 170 个最新模型。服务端解析任务类型、上下文长度（`max_tokens`）、量化格式（`fp32`、`fp8`、`int4` 等）、输入与输出计费（以 `$/Mt` 呈现）以及服务层级标签（`flex`、`priority`），并自动过滤排除 `anthropic/*` 模型。
4. **交互式模型选择面板（`packages/web-shell/client/components/messages/ModelSelectionPanel.tsx`）**：提供实时名称与任务搜索、类型/量化/上下文长度（最高支持 1024k）下拉筛选、四个带 SVG 图标的次级快速过滤按钮（`✨ Featured`、`🏷️ Discount`、`⚡ Priority`、`⏱️ Flex`）以及独立的 `In ($/Mt)` 与 `Out ($/Mt)` 计费排序表头。支持复选框多选并即时同步到底部的逗号分隔文本框，同时保留手动输入自定义模型的能力。
5. **CLI 与桌面端接入集成**：在交互式 `qwen auth` 命令中增加 DeepInfra 支持，并在守护进程环境快照中持久化 `DEEPINFRA_API_KEY`。

## 变更背景与原因

DeepInfra 为热门开源大模型（如 DeepSeek-V3、DeepSeek-R1、Llama 3.3 与 Qwen 2.5）提供了高性价比的推理托管服务。其推出的 Flex 服务层级能够在尽力而为调度下为用户节省 20% 的推理开销（0.8× 计费）。在此之前，用户只能通过通用自定义服务商手动连接 DeepInfra，且无法在请求体中传递 `service_tier: "flex"`。此外，此前接入支持自定义模型的服务商时，用户必须自行离开软件查询模型 ID 并手动输入，无法直观获取上下文大小、量化规格与 Token 价格。

### 为什么本 PR 超过 2000 行且需要整体合并

本 PR 涵盖了一个 Tier 1 服务商预设从底层到界面的完整实现闭环：
- 后端服务商预设注册与双门禁归属校验（`packages/core/src/providers/`）。
- Chat Completions 与 Responses 双链路中的 `service_tier` 类型定义、解析与请求体透传（`packages/core/src/core/`、`packages/core/src/models/`）。
- 守护进程元数据拉取、内存缓存与模型过滤代理路由（`packages/cli/src/serve/routes/`）。
- CLI 命令支持、配置定义与守护进程环境快照（`packages/cli/src/`）。
- 前端交互式 `ModelSelectionPanel` 组件、样式及 Web Shell 接入流程整合（`packages/web-shell/client/components/messages/`）。
- 涵盖所有模块的单元测试（预设测试、解析测试、网络负载测试、守护路由测试及 React 组件测试）与双语设计文档。

若拆分此 PR，将会产生不完整的中间状态（例如有预设却无前端选择支持，或前端调用未发布的代理端点）。整体合并保证了系统架构的一致性与完整可用的功能交付。

### Tier 1 内置服务商预设资质披露

按照 `CONTRIBUTING.md` 中关于 Tier 1 服务商预设的规范要求披露如下：
- **关联关系披露（Affiliation Disclosure）**：PR 作者为 DeepInfra 的普通付费用户，与 DeepInfra 不存在任何雇佣、商业合作、财务或推广关联。
- **运营成熟度（Operational Maturity）**：DeepInfra 拥有公开的运行状态页与事故历史记录，详情可见 https://status.deepinfra.com/。
- **真实用户需求（Organic User Demand）**：由作者首次发起需求（"目前仅作者本人"），旨在满足低成本、大吞吐的开源模型推理及 Flex 服务层级使用需求。
- **数据与安全透明度（Data and Security Transparency）**：DeepInfra 公开承诺零数据留存（ZDR）政策，明确声明不会存储用户提示词与生成内容，亦不会将其用于模型训练。
- **维护承诺（Maintenance Commitment）**：PR 作者不提供长期的后续维护承诺，由社区共同维护。

## 评审测试计划

### 验证步骤

1. **验证后端预设与 Service Tier 请求透传**：
   - 运行单元测试：
     ```bash
     cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/providers/__tests__/presets/deepinfra.test.ts src/models/modelConfigResolver.test.ts src/core/openaiContentGenerator/provider/default.test.ts src/core/openaiResponsesContentGenerator/responses-pipeline.test.ts
     ```
   - 确认在配置中指定 `service_tier: "flex"` 或使用 `--service-tier flex` 时，发往底层的请求体会携带 `"service_tier": "flex"`。

2. **验证守护进程代理路由**：
   - 运行单元测试：
     ```bash
     cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/routes/workspace-auth.test.ts
     ```
   - 验证 GET `/workspace/auth/deepinfra-models` 正确返回格式化后的上下文长度、量化规格、`$/Mt` 价格，且成功过滤排除 `anthropic/*` 模型。

3. **验证交互式模型选择面板**：
   - 运行组件测试：
     ```bash
     cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/components/messages/ModelSelectionPanel.test.tsx client/components/messages/AuthMessage.dom.test.tsx
     ```
   - 启动 Desktop 应用或 Web Shell，进入设置 → Connect a Provider → DeepInfra。输入 API Key 后进入第 4 步（Model IDs）。
   - 测试搜索框输入（如 "deepseek"）。
   - 测试下拉过滤（类型、量化、上下文长度含 1024k）。
   - 测试快速切换按钮：点击 `Featured`、`Discount`、`Priority`、`Flex`，表格实时更新。
   - 点击 `In ($/Mt)` 与 `Out ($/Mt)` 表头确认可独立进行价格升序/降序排序。
   - 勾选复选框，验证模型 ID 实时同步到底部输入框。

### 变更对比与截图证据

#### 变更前
在服务商配置第 4 步中，仅提供一个空白文本框，无任何可选模型指引，用户必须离开应用自行查找模型名称，无法获知上下文大小、量化版本与计费标准。

#### 变更后：交互式模型选择面板交互演示

**1. 完整模型选择面板总览**
表格展示约 170 个实时模型及其上下文长度、量化标签与输入/输出价格（$/Mt）：
![Model Selection Panel Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alphataubio/qwen-code-alphataubio/alphataubio-deepinfra/docs/design/assets/deepinfra-model-selection-modal.png)

**2. 过滤工具栏与快速切换按钮**
包含实时搜索、任务类型下拉、动态量化格式下拉、上下文长度下拉（含 1024k）、四个带 SVG 图标的快速切换按钮（`✨ Featured`、`🏷️ Discount`、`⚡ Priority`、`⏱️ Flex`）以及独立的 `In ($/Mt)` 和 `Out ($/Mt)` 排序表头：
![Filter Toolbar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alphataubio/qwen-code-alphataubio/alphataubio-deepinfra/docs/design/assets/deepinfra-model-selection-filters.png)

**3. 已选数量统计与手动输入框实时同步**
包含选中数量统计（"Select all visible"）、模型 ID 格式示例说明以及实时同步更新的逗号分隔输入框：
![Selection Input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alphataubio/qwen-code-alphataubio/alphataubio-deepinfra/docs/design/assets/deepinfra-model-selection-input.png)

### 测试环境

| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 运行环境（可选）

- macOS Darwin arm64，Node.js v24.6.0。
- 已在 Qwen Code 桌面客户端（Tauri）与本地守护进程 Web Shell 中实测通过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险与权衡：守护进程代理端点 `/workspace/auth/deepinfra-models` 会请求外部 `api.deepinfra.com/models/list` 接口获取模型目录。服务端采用 1 小时内存缓存防止频繁触发外部限流。若网络请求失败，UI 会安全降级显示空列表并允许用户手动输入。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：DeepInfra 异步离线 Batch 处理接口（DeepInfra Flex 本身为同步 API 调用）。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无破坏性变更，完全向下兼容。现有自定义服务商配置不受任何影响。

prs.title: feat(verify-pr): preflight execution approvals
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an execution preflight for maintainer-driven local `/verify-pr` rounds. Legacy watcher commands that omit `--execution` retain their container meaning, while a host or VM selection is now explicit and is validated before artifacts are created or untrusted PR code runs. A maintainer can trust their own or a same-repository PR locally with `--trust-pr-head` after an explicit decision, without publishing an approval comment. For another fork, an approval comment is coupled with a real in-flight watch registration bound to the matching repository, PR, head, and round. Reusing a completed round's comment no longer authorizes another execution. Publication compares the artifact declaration with prepare's host-held approval, requires the context digest, checks eligibility again, and canonicalizes the entire registration path so an intermediate symlink cannot redirect it into the PR clone.

## Why it's needed

The local workflow already said that host execution required a maintainer's approval, but the only executable check was performed while preparing the publication comment. A host round could therefore run the entire battery before asking for evidence that should have existed beforehand. This moves the supported workflow's checks earlier, makes approval externally auditable, and avoids turning a private trust decision for a maintainer's own or shared-repository PR into a mandatory public comment.

Design documents: [English](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/feat/verify-pr-execution-preflight/docs/design/verify-pr-execution-preflight.md) and [中文](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/feat/verify-pr-execution-preflight/docs/design/verify-pr-execution-preflight.zh-CN.md). They cover the compatibility choices, approval model, trust boundaries, test plan, and deferrals.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Confirm that a legacy coordinate prepare without `--execution` completes in container mode and does not create `executionApproval` or a host declaration. Verify that host or VM still requires an explicit execution selection and cannot silently inherit this compatibility default.
2. For a maintainer's own fork and for a same-repository collaboration PR, check explicit `--trust-pr-head`. The authenticated maintainer's own identity and write/maintain/admin permission are verified, the approval names the exact current head and round, and another fork or read-only identity fails before the artifact directory appears. Author or repository matching alone is not an automatic waiver.
3. For another fork, register the exact head and round, then use a marked maintainer approval comment with `--approval` and its PR-external `--state-root`. Preparing a retry while that registration is in flight works. After the real watch completion, repeating the same command fails with exit 3 rather than replaying the old approval into a later execution. Wrong heads, rounds, comment targets, permissions, and missing or nested-symlinked registration paths also fail before preparation succeeds.
4. Inspect a host/VM publication. The artifact declaration and the host-held `executionApproval` must be deeply equal and its context must match `--context-sha256`; a missing digest, altered permission/source/basis/comment/head/round, or forged PR-side context is refused. Existing container and CI-lane declarations should remain unaffected.
5. Run the six affected suites (`verify-pr-prepare`, `verify-pr-check`, `verify-pr-model-proxy`, `verify-pr-watch-state`, `verify-pr-guard`, and `qwen-triage-workflow`): 657 tests passed and 16 skipped on macOS. The real helper E2E matrix passed 81/81 cells, followed by a separate symlink-containment regression that failed before its fix and passed afterward. Four removal controls became red when the container default, registration check, declaration-write error handling, or containment guard was removed, then returned green after exact restoration.

Verification also passed `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run bundle`, `node dist/cli.js --version` (0.28.0), `npm run format`, `npm run lint`, and `git diff --check`. A full scripts run with the macOS temporary-directory alias removed reported 5048 passed, 89 skipped, and one infrastructure-rerun timeout in an unchanged autofix test; that same test passed in isolation in 16.2 seconds. No assertion or timeout was weakened. The local E2E used disposable clones and fake `gh`, never a real PR battery or a GitHub write API.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for this non-UI change. The supporting local E2E log is `verify-pr-execution-preflight-revised-20261122-022953/report.md`; it records command exits, completed watch registrations, publication tamper cases, and the original in-flight retry versus completed-round replay. It is a git-ignored fixture log, not a PR code artifact.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ Node.js 24.18.1 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

<!-- ✅ tested · ⚠️ not tested · N/A -->

### Environment (optional)

Local Node.js 24.18.1 with a frozen-lockfile install, full workspace build, targeted tests, real helper CLIs, disposable git clones, and fake GitHub responses. The `/var` to `/private/var` macOS alias was reproduced separately in the baseline lint-scope fixture; its unmodified test passes with `TMPDIR=/private/tmp`. No daemons, persistent watches, real approval comments, external-image uploads, or PR-battery execution were used in the E2E harness.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: This is a fail-closed workflow around trusted prepare and publish commands, not an operating-system sandbox. It cannot prove that subsequent commands stay inside the chosen boundary or prevent a caller from bypassing prepare and opening a shell. It also validates maintainers through live GitHub identity and permission APIs, so transient preflight failures reject VM/host execution rather than silently degrading it.
- Not validated / out of scope: Prepare does not revalidate a comment's later deletion or the revocation of permission after the preflight. Mandatory execution confinement is deferred. The unrelated, load-sensitive autofix timeout remains an existing test-budget issue and is disclosed above rather than hidden.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: Legacy container coordinate calls remain compatible, including old watch snapshots. Legacy host/VM artifacts without the host-held approval and verified context digest are intentionally rejected: use a real container or run the new preflight. Comment-backed fresh rounds also need a real watch registration; a verifier for a maintainer's own or same-repository PR can instead use explicit `--trust-pr-head` without a public approval comment.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次改动

为维护者在本地发起的 `/verify-pr` 轮次增加执行预检。旧 watch 命令即使省略 `--execution`，仍保留原有 container 语义；宿主或 VM 则必须显式选择，并在创建产物或运行不可信 PR 代码之前完成验证。维护者明确决定后，可用 `--trust-pr-head` 在本地信任本人或同仓 PR，不必公开发布批准评论。对于他人的 fork，批准评论必须与真实 in-flight watch 注册配合，绑定对应的仓库、PR、head 和 round，完成后复用旧评论不能再授权新的执行。发布时把产物声明与 prepare 写入宿主侧的批准进行对账，强制核对 context digest 并重新检查资格；注册路径的完整规范化也会阻止中间软链把它带回 PR 克隆。

## 为什么需要

本地工作流原本就要求宿主执行前获得维护者批准，但唯一的机器检查在生成发布评论时才执行。宿主轮次因此可能先运行完整测试，再补上本应在执行前具备的批准证据。本 PR 将受支持流程中的检查前移，使批准可审计，并避免把维护者对本人或同仓 PR 的私人信任决定强制变成公开评论。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/feat/verify-pr-execution-preflight/docs/design/verify-pr-execution-preflight.md) 与 [中文](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/feat/verify-pr-execution-preflight/docs/design/verify-pr-execution-preflight.zh-CN.md)，覆盖兼容选择、批准模型、信任边界、测试计划与后续事项。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

1. 确认不带 `--execution` 的旧 coordinate prepare 仍能以 container 模式完成，且不产生 `executionApproval` 或宿主声明。宿主/VM 仍必须显式选择执行方式，不能通过该兼容默认值静默获得豁免。
2. 对维护者本人的 fork 与同仓协作 PR，验证显式 `--trust-pr-head`：会核验当前认证维护者以及其 write/maintain/admin 权限，批准绑定当前完整 head 和 round；他人 fork 或只读身份在创建产物目录之前失败。作者或仓库匹配单独并不构成自动豁免。
3. 对他人 fork，先注册精确 head 与 round，再将带标记的维护者批准评论连同 `--approval`、位于 PR 外的 `--state-root` 一起使用。原注册仍在 in-flight 时允许重试 prepare；真实 watch 完成后，同一命令必须以 exit 3 拒绝，不能把旧批准重放到后续执行。错误 head、round、评论目标、权限，以及缺失或嵌套软链的注册路径，也都会在 prepare 成功前失败。
4. 检查宿主/VM 发布内容：产物声明与宿主持有的 `executionApproval` 必须深度相同，context 必须匹配 `--context-sha256`；缺少 digest，篡改 permission/source/basis/comment/head/round，或伪造 PR 侧 context，都必须被拒绝。原有 container 与 CI-lane 声明不受影响。
5. 运行六套受影响测试（`verify-pr-prepare`、`verify-pr-check`、`verify-pr-model-proxy`、`verify-pr-watch-state`、`verify-pr-guard`、`qwen-triage-workflow`）：macOS 上 657 passed、16 skipped。真实 helper E2E 通过 81/81 格，随后另行的软链 containment 回归在修复前失败、修复后通过。四个去修复对照分别在移除 container 默认值、注册校验、声明写入异常处理或 containment 守卫时转红，恢复原实现后转绿。

同时已通过 `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`、`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck`、`npm run bundle`、`node dist/cli.js --version`（0.28.0）、`npm run format`、`npm run lint` 与 `git diff --check`。移除 macOS 临时目录别名后的全量脚本测试报告 5048 passed、89 skipped、1 个既有 autofix 基础设施重跑用例超时；同一用例独立运行以 16.2 秒通过。没有弱化任何断言或超时。全部 E2E 使用一次性克隆与 fake `gh`，未执行真实 PR 电池或 GitHub 写接口。

### Before / After 证据

本改动不涉及 UI。辅助证据留存于本地 `verify-pr-execution-preflight-revised-20261122-022953/report.md`，包含命令退出状态、完整 watch 注册、发布篡改矩阵，以及原 in-flight 重试与完成后重放的区别。该文件是 git-ignored 测试日志，不属于要提交的代码产物。

### 已测试系统

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ Node.js 24.18.1 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境（可选）

本机 Node.js 24.18.1，按 lockfile 安装依赖，完整构建工作区，并运行目标测试、真实 helper CLI、一次性 git 克隆与 fake GitHub 响应。已在基线 lint-scope 夹具中单独复现 macOS 的 `/var` 到 `/private/var` 路径别名；未修改的测试在 `TMPDIR=/private/tmp` 下通过。E2E 没有使用 daemon、持久 watch、真实批准评论、外部图床或 PR 电池。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：这是围绕可信 prepare 与发布命令的 fail-closed 流程，不是操作系统沙箱。它不能证明后续命令始终在所选边界内，也不能阻止调用方绕过 prepare 另开 shell。预检还通过实时 GitHub 身份与权限 API 验证维护者，若 API 暂时失败，VM/宿主执行将失败而不是静默降级。
- 未验证或不属于本次范围：prepare 不重新验证评论后来被删除或权限后来被撤销的情况；强制 confinement 留给后续工作。上述无关且受负载影响的 autofix 超时仍是既有测试预算问题，已披露而不是隐藏。
- 破坏性变更与迁移说明：旧 container coordinate 调用以及旧 watch 快照保持兼容。缺少宿主批准及已验证 context digest 的旧宿主/VM 产物会被有意拒绝，应使用真实容器或执行新的预检。评论批准的新轮次还需要真实 watch 注册；验证维护者本人或同仓 PR 时，可以改为显式 `--trust-pr-head`，无需公开批准评论。

## 关联 Issue

无。

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): admit session skills on external Workspace creation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Backport of #18099 to `dev/managed-agent`, with one conflict resolution and one correctness fix on top.

External Workspace session creation now admits caller-supplied session skills: the refusal condition no longer rejects a non-empty skill list, and the effective creation pin carries those skills into the immutable creation receipt. Extension pins, plan mode, memory store, and non-text input remain refused. The loop-skill merge then skips re-appending caller skills when the profile is external (the pin already carries them), instead of appending them a second time and tripping the duplicate-name catalog validation.

Two deltas versus #18099, both forced by this branch's state:

- **Conflict resolution**: this branch's admission already resolves a requested external tool profile and gates its published approval modes. The backport keeps that logic and carries skills into the resolved profile's pin (main hardcodes the files profile here). The now-unused `List` import is dropped so Checkstyle stays green.
### Completing the lane

Admitting the catalog at creation was only the first of four refusals, so this PR now lands the whole lane instead of leaving a Session that accepts no turn. On top of the two deltas above:

- The first turn no longer refuses a Session whose effective catalog is non-empty; the initial-selection refusal stays, and so do the extension, MCP, plan-mode and non-text-input refusals.
- The Harness attach accepts a pinned catalog and still rejects an initial selection, which keeps extension packages that admission refuses out of the external Session.
- The CLI no longer lists the skill reference among the external lanes' closed options, and both external Turn shapes declare the content-only `skill` tool; the catalog is served from the Session's pinned definition and writes nothing to the Workspace.
- The bilingual design record records session skills as the single admitted lane, replacing the entries that claimed a third refusal for them.

Tests pin each refusal that was removed: the turn gate, the Harness attach, both external declarations, and the creation pin plus bundled-loop drop. Each was mutation-checked by restoring the removed clause.

- **Dedup guard by profile, not by emptiness**: #18099 appends caller skills only when the merged catalog is empty. On this branch that silently drops every caller skill whenever the pinned definition already carries skills — 5 existing tests regress (`ManagedSessionCreationSkillsTest` ×4, `ManagedLoopSkillTest` ×1). This PR instead branches on `isExternal(profile)`: external pins already hold the caller catalog (treated as the caller slice so bundled-loop recognition still applies), non-external forms keep the original append and loop-injection behavior unchanged. A regression test pins the external no-double-append case.

## Why it's needed

Same motivation as #18099: DataAgent pre-installs default skills on managed instances, and external Workspace creation refused any request carrying skills, so new instances came up with no slash commands. Once skills are admitted, the merge must not double-append them or the SDK rejects the whole creation with `agent_definition_unsupported`. `dev/managed-agent` needs the same fix; the two affected files were byte-identical to the v1 pre-fix state before this change.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the focused suites from `packages/managed-agent-server` (JDK 21):

```bash
mvn -Dtest='ManagedSessionCreationSkillsTest,ManagedLoopSkillTest,AgentSessionPoliciesExternalTurnTest,QwenHostedHarnessConnectorTest,WorkspaceToolProfilesTest,JdbcManagedSessionSkillsDecodeTest' -DfailIfNoTests=false test checkstyle:check

# from packages/cli
npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-workspace-profiles.test.ts src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts src/serve/workspace-recovery-session.test.ts
```

Expected: 48/50 pass, 0 Checkstyle violations. The 2 failures (`aSnapshotChildReselectsTheLoopByItsOwnProfile`, `serverLoopProvenanceMarkerRoundTripsThroughTheSnapshot`) are **pre-existing on the base branch** — verified by running them on unmodified `dev/managed-agent` (d033ef3e5173b), same 2 failures. Root cause: main wires `ManagedLoopSkill.childCatalog` + the server-loop provenance marker into child admission (`AgentSessionAdmissions`), but this branch's split-out `ChildSessionAdmissions` saves inherited skills verbatim and never received that wiring. Out of scope here; worth a separate sync.

Confirm an external-profile creation with caller skills persists them once (no duplicate names), and a non-external creation with definition-authored skills still merges caller skills and injects the profile loop variant as before.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — persistence/admission behavior, no UI change. #18099 carries the DataAgent pre-production evidence (409 `workspace_admission_refused` → 200 with 16 default skills); the admission logic here is equivalent after the conflict resolution.
