prs.title: fix(deps): clear the current high-and-critical prod audit findings
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Clears every high-and-critical finding currently failing the nightly Security Checks gate (`pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high`): bumps the directly declared packages (simple-git 3→4.1, shell-quote, sharp, markdown-it in both majors in use), lifts the msteams channel's `@microsoft/agents-*` to the upstream release that already carries the fixed zod and msal-node, and adds three workspace overrides for transitive-only findings (proxy-addr, follow-redirects, and the shell-quote copies pinned by ink's react-devtools-core chain).

## Why it's needed

The Security Checks workflow has been red on main for over a week on a batch of advisories published against the locked tree (simple-git's November CVE set, proxy-addr IP spoofing, shell-quote command injection, follow-redirects credential handling, sharp's librsvg, markdown-it quadratic complexity, and the zod/msal-node copies entering through `@microsoft/agents-*@1.9.1`). The behavioral adaptation has two halves, both in v4's environment guard. It throws when a task environment names a guarded `GIT_*` variable without an explicit opt-in, and the extension git client deliberately sets `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM`/`GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL`/`GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT` (plus the inline credential trio when authenticating), so those are named in `allowEnvironment`. It also deletes any guarded key a client did not name from the inherited environment — not only ones a task env sets — so the guarded loader now allowlists the transport credentials `gitEnv()` restores (`GIT_SSH_COMMAND`, `GIT_SSH`, `GIT_ASKPASS`, `SSH_ASKPASS`); without that, a client that returns before `.env()` lost the operator's SSH identity and an SSH-sourced install failed `Permission denied (publickey)`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

`corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && corepack pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high` should exit 0 (remaining findings: 1 low, 6 moderate — below the gate). The behavior-sensitive surface is the extension git client: its unit tests exercise the restricted-environment client against simple-git's guard, including the credentialed paths.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — dependency and guard-configuration change, no UI.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

Local verification: `pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high` exits 0; `npm run build` and `npm run typecheck` pass; targeted vitest runs all pass — packages/core git suites (`extension-git-client`, `github`, `load-simple-git`, `gitUtils`, `enter-worktree`, `agent`: 649 tests), shell parse/quote suites (784 tests), msteams channel suite (65 tests), and the notices generator test. Both `NOTICES.txt` files were regenerated with the repo's script.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: simple-git 3→4 is a major; the breaking changes (default export removed, abbreviated long options rejected, ambient GIT_* env filtered) were each checked against this repo's usage — all git access goes through the guarded loader, which already uses the named export. The msteams agents minor bump is upstream's own fix carrier. The pnpm minimumReleaseAge gate accepted every pinned version at install time.
- Not validated / out of scope: 1 low and 6 moderate findings remain below the gate; the broader Snyk-driven remediation program is tracked separately in #17099.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none expected. The two allowlists only name keys a client already wants to keep in its child environment — they do not inject values, so a client that scrubs to `gitEnv()` stays scrubbed, and the loader's guard, config blocklist and unsafe-option policy are untouched.

## Linked Issues

Refs #17099 (the standing security-upgrade tracker). Refs #16434.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

清空当前导致 nightly Security Checks 门禁（`pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high`）失败的全部 high/critical 发现：升级直接声明的包（simple-git 3→4.1、shell-quote、sharp、两个主线的 markdown-it），把 msteams 频道的 `@microsoft/agents-*` 升到上游已携带修复版 zod 和 msal-node 的版本，并为纯传递路径的发现加了三条 workspace override（proxy-addr、follow-redirects，以及 ink 的 react-devtools-core 链锁住的 shell-quote 副本）。

## 为什么需要

Security Checks 在 main 上已经红了一周多，原因是针对锁定依赖树新发布的一批 advisory（simple-git 十一月 CVE 组、proxy-addr IP 欺骗、shell-quote 命令注入、follow-redirects 凭据处理、sharp 的 librsvg、markdown-it 二次复杂度，以及经 `@microsoft/agents-*@1.9.1` 进入的 zod/msal-node）。唯一的行为适配：simple-git v4 对显式设置受保护 `GIT_*` 环境变量的任务会抛错，除非显式 opt-in；extension git client 有意设置 `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM`/`GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL`/`GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT`（认证时另有内联凭据三件套），现在通过 `allowEnvironment` 显式声明。

## 评审验证

`corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && corepack pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high` 应退出 0（剩余 1 low / 6 moderate，低于门禁线）。行为敏感面是 extension git client：其单测覆盖了受限环境客户端在 simple-git 守卫下的行为，包括带凭据路径。

本地验证：audit 退出 0；`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck` 通过；packages/core 的 git 相关套件（649 个测试）、shell parse/quote 套件（784 个）、msteams 频道套件（65 个）、notices 生成器测试全部通过；两个 `NOTICES.txt` 均用仓库脚本重新生成。守卫适配的补充用例：`load-simple-git`（8）、`extension-git-client`（29）、`github`（157）、`git-worktree-marker`（35）、`gitWorktreeService.env-passthrough.integ`（3），在真实 4.x 客户端上验证两条 allowlist；`packages/core` 的 `tsc --noEmit` 干净。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：simple-git 3→4 是大版本；其 breaking change（默认导出移除、缩写长选项拒绝、过滤环境 GIT_* 变量）已逐一对照本仓库用法——所有 git 访问都走受守护的 loader，且已使用命名导出。msteams agents 的次版本升级是上游自己的修复载体。所有锁定版本都通过了 pnpm 的 minimumReleaseAge 门。
- 范围外：剩余 1 low / 6 moderate 低于门禁线；更广泛的 Snyk 驱动治理在 #17099 跟踪。
- 破坏性变更：无预期。两份 allowlist 只“点名”客户端本来就希望保留在子环境里的键，不会注入值：清洗到 `gitEnv()` 的客户端保持清洗，loader 的守护、配置黑名单与 unsafe 策略均未改动。

</details>

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): admit session skills on external Workspace creation
prs.body:
## Problem

External Workspace session creation rejects any request carrying skills (`!command.skills().isEmpty()` in `creationPin`). This blocks DataAgent from pre-installing default skills on managed instances — users see no slash commands after creating a new instance.

Skills and extension pins have different semantics in external Workspace: skills are content declarations persisted into the immutable creation receipt (consumed by the external Worker as installed files), while extension pins require the native Shell/MCP lifecycle for package execution that external profiles never negotiate.

Additionally, once skills are admitted into the effective pin, `ManagedLoopSkill.mergeInto` double-merges them: `merged` starts as `pin.skills()` (already containing caller skills in external mode), then `addAll(callerSkills)` appends the same list again, causing `names.add()` to return false on duplicates and the SDK to reject with `agent_definition_unsupported`.

## Changes

**`ExternalWorkspaceSessionPolicies.creationPin`**: Remove `!command.skills().isEmpty()` from the refusal condition; effective pin carries `command.skills()` into the session snapshot. Extension pins, planMode, memoryStoreId, and non-text input remain refused.

**`ManagedLoopSkill.mergeInto`**: Only `addAll(callerSkills)` when `merged` is empty (non-external form where pin does not carry skills). When pin already contains caller skills (external Workspace), skip the redundant append.

## Verification

Tested on DataAgent pre-production (弹内预发) with SDK release `0.1.0-dataagent-managed-20261122.5-external-skills-dedup`:

- Before: `createManagedRuntime` → 409 `MANAGED_RUNTIME_TOOL_PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE` / `workspace_admission_refused`
- After: `createManagedRuntime` → 200, session `bb5aae7b-6b94-4a1d-924e-88e656f9a69a` created, `getManagedRuntimeSessionSkills` returns 16 default skills

Co-authored-by: Qwen-Coder <qwen-coder@alibabacloud.com>

prs.title: fix(serve): isolate session deletion from sibling sessions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When deleting a live workspace session, the daemon waits for the ACP child to acknowledge that the session's recorder has flushed and closed before removing the transcript and attachments. If the close times out, the delete reports an error and preserves the session's files. Other sessions on the ACP channel can keep running, and a late acknowledgement closes only the target session. Worktree cleanup also checks for references from sessions in the other archive state before removing a checkout.

## Why it's needed

### Original report

A Web Shell user on Qwen Code 0.27.4 started a `/loop` and believed the model had set it up as an automation that opened a separate conversation for each run. The user deleted the conversation that started the loop (A), then saw a **History gap** notice when opening what appeared to be a run conversation (B). An independently created run should remain openable with its full history after its controller is deleted. If it is still running, it should be able to finish its turn.

### Investigation

1. **The affected conversation's own transcript had a missing prefix.** Replaying the export through the released 0.27.4 daemon returned HTTP 200 and reproduced the History gap notice. The first surviving record points to an earlier record missing from that same JSONL file. The two subsequent Cron turns captured in the export also use that session ID and have no independent run marker. The original scheduling parameters and the delete request's target are unavailable, so the exact sequence in the report remains unconfirmed.
2. **A live recorder can recreate a removed transcript.** Removing the JSONL of a live recorder let its next write recreate the file with a stale parent record ID. Closing the recorder before removing the file prevented recreation. In a separate 0.27.4 control, a fixture with a complete run transcript, its own session ID, and a recorded parent remained readable after the distinct parent was deleted.
3. **A shared ACP channel gave us a reproducible cross-session failure.** With distinct sessions A and B on the same healthy ACP channel, we delayed A's close reply while B had an active prompt. The previous unknown-outcome recovery terminated the shared child process, and B failed with `agent channel closed mid-request`. A failed close for one session could therefore interrupt an otherwise healthy session even when their transcripts were independent.

This PR addresses the reproduced isolation failure by requiring the ACP owner's close acknowledgement before deleting A's files and keeping sibling sessions connected when A's close is unconfirmed. The real `per_run` daemon regression verifies the original user expectation that B can reopen with its complete history after A is deleted. The worktree check applies the same ownership boundary to checkouts still referenced from the other archive state.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Create a scheduled task in `per_run` mode, run it, then delete its controller session. Reopen the run session by its original ID and confirm its full transcript is readable with the same messages in order.
- Delay one session's ACP close response while a different session is running on the same channel. The delete should time out and preserve the target's files. The sibling turn should finish normally, and a late acknowledgement should close only the target.
- Delete a session that owns a checkout still referenced by a different archived session. The session should disappear and the shared checkout should remain accessible.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before, the timeout probe terminated the shared channel and the sibling prompt failed with `agent channel closed mid-request`.
- After, the ACP channel stayed live, the sibling streamed further output, and its prompt reached `end_turn`. The daemon integration test created a real `per_run` session using a local deterministic model and compared the transcript events exactly before and after controller deletion.
- [E2E verification report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17707#issuecomment-6975036623)

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Build, typecheck, focused tests and daemon integration |
| 🪟 Windows | Pending CI |
| 🐧 Linux | Pending CI |

### Environment

Node.js 22 and the bundled CLI. The daemon integration uses a local OpenAI-compatible fixture. The close timeout is controlled at the ACP test transport.

## Risk & Scope

- The delete can time out while the ACP close is still settling. If the child stays alive without replying, retries return `session_closing` until the close settles or the owning channel exits.
- The verification exercises workspace session deletion through the daemon API.
- Recovering the already damaged history from the original report requires its missing transcript records.
- Existing HTTP and transcript formats are retained.
- Design documentation [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/session-delete-isolation/docs/design/2026-11-18-session-delete-isolation.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/session-delete-isolation/docs/design/2026-11-18-session-delete-isolation.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

User-reported Web Shell session deletion behavior.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

删除正在运行的工作区会话时，daemon 会等待 ACP 子进程确认该会话的写入已刷盘、写入器已关闭，再移除历史与附件。关闭超时时，删除请求返回错误并保留会话文件。同一 ACP 通道上的其他会话可以继续运行，迟到的回执只会关闭目标会话。Worktree 清理也会检查另一个归档状态的会话是否还在引用该 checkout。

## 背景

### 原始反馈

一位使用 Qwen Code 0.27.4 Web Shell 的用户启动了 `/loop`，认为模型把它设成了每次运行都会新开会话的自动化。用户删除启动循环的会话 A 后，打开看起来是运行结果的会话 B 时看到**历史记录缺口**提示。预期是独立创建的运行会话在调度会话被删后仍可打开，历史完整。如果它仍在运行，也应该能正常完成当前轮次。

### 排查过程

1. **受影响会话自己的历史文件缺了前段。** 用发布版 0.27.4 daemon 回放导出记录，HTTP 返回 200，同时复现了历史记录缺口提示。首条保留下来的记录指向同一个 JSONL 里已经缺失的前序记录。导出中后续两次 Cron 轮次也写在该会话 ID 下，没有独立运行的来源标记。最初的调度参数和删除请求的目标 ID 都无法取得，因此现场的确切操作链路仍待确认。
2. **活跃写入器可以重建被移除的历史文件。** 移除活跃写入器的 JSONL 后，下一次写入会重建同名文件，并保留已失效的父记录 ID。先关闭写入器再移除文件，可以避免重建。另一组 0.27.4 对照使用了带独立会话 ID、完整历史和父会话标记的测试数据。删除父会话后，该运行会话仍可正常读取。
3. **共享 ACP 通道上复现了明确的跨会话故障。** 让会话 A 和 B 共用一条正常的 ACP 通道，在 B 已经开始执行时延迟 A 的关闭回执。原先处理关闭结果不明的逻辑终止了共用的子进程，B 随即报 `agent channel closed mid-request`。即使两个会话的历史文件各自独立，关闭 A 的失败也可能中断正常运行的 B。

本 PR 修复已复现的隔离问题。删除 A 的文件前先等待 ACP 持有者返回关闭成功，A 的关闭结果不明时保留其他会话的连接。真实 daemon 的 `per_run` 回归验证了用户原先关心的行为，即删除 A 后仍可重新打开 B 并看到完整历史。Worktree 清理按同一归属规则保护另一个归档状态中的会话仍在引用的 checkout。

## 审查验证

### 验证步骤

- 创建 `per_run` 定时任务并运行一次，删除调度会话，再通过原 ID 打开运行会话。检查完整历史中的消息及顺序一致。
- 在同通道另一个会话正在运行时延迟目标会话的 ACP 关闭回执。删除请求应超时并保留目标会话的文件。另一个会话应正常结束，迟到的回执只关闭目标会话。
- 删除一个拥有 checkout 的会话，同时保留另一个引用它的归档会话。删除目标会话后，共用 checkout 应仍可访问。

### 修复前后证据

- 修复前，超时探针导致共享通道终止，另一个会话的请求报 `agent channel closed mid-request`。
- 修复后，ACP 通道继续运行，另一个会话继续输出并收到 `end_turn`。daemon 集成测试使用本地确定性模型创建真实 `per_run` 会话，逐条对比删除调度会话前后的历史事件。
- [E2E 验证报告](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17707#issuecomment-6975036623)

### 验证平台

| 平台 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 构建、类型检查、聚焦测试与 daemon 集成测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | 待 CI |
| 🐧 Linux | 待 CI |

### 验证环境

Node.js 22 和 CLI bundle。daemon 集成使用本地 OpenAI 兼容测试服务。关闭超时由 ACP 测试通道控制。

## 风险与范围

- ACP 关闭尚未结束时，删除请求可能超时。如果子进程仍存活且一直不回执，重试会返回 `session_closing`，直到关闭请求有结果或所属通道退出。
- 验证通过 daemon API 覆盖工作区会话删除。
- 原始反馈中已经断链的历史需要找回缺失的记录才能恢复完整。
- 沿用现有 HTTP 和历史记录格式。
- 设计文档 [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/session-delete-isolation/docs/design/2026-11-18-session-delete-isolation.md) 和 [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/session-delete-isolation/docs/design/2026-11-18-session-delete-isolation.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联问题

用户反馈的 Web Shell 会话删除行为。

</details>

prs.title: feat(core): give the model a context-remaining tool and a self-triggered compaction path
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Gives the model a read-only tool around its own context budget. `get_context_remaining` reports the context window, tokens used (flagged as an estimate until the route reports real counts), tokens remaining, the level where auto-compaction actually fires (the real send-path ladder, including the user's threshold override, rounded), and the session-token limit when one is configured — with the headroom line naming whichever bound (ladder or session limit) fires first. The numbers come from a new read-only `getContextUsageSnapshot()` accessor on `LlmChat` that exposes the existing per-route accounting without opening the fields. The snapshot is a pure read that reports the window the send layer last resolved for the request and whether the counters still describe that request's route, so counts recorded for another route are named as such instead of being presented as the current one's; with no reported count the derived figures are withheld rather than computed from zero. The tool is excluded from subagent and teammate tool inheritance because it reports the base session's chat, not the caller's.

## Why it's needed

The model currently learns its context is nearly full only when auto-compaction has already fired (or the request overflows). It cannot decide "wrap up now" or "delegate this large sub-task" while there is still room — users have `/context`; the model has nothing (#17313). OpenAI Codex ships the same half as a model tool (`get_context_remaining.rs`), which is the design precedent.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Unit level: `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/tools/get-context-remaining.test.ts` — the tool reports the window/used/remaining/ladder snapshot, rounds the fractional ladder, names the session-token limit as the binding bound when it sits below the ladder, degrades without an active chat (both the no-client and the throwing-client paths), states that no count was reported without naming a cause and without reading the history, reports the window of the route the last request used, and does not present another route's counts as the request route's. The request-route window is pinned against a real send by `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/llm-chat.test.ts -t "reports the window of the route the last request used"`. The registry wiring is pinned by `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/config/config.workflow-registration.test.ts` (registration + subagent exclusion). Behaviorally: with the tool registered, ask a model near a full window what it would do — it can now read the remaining budget and the real auto-compaction level before deciding to wrap up or delegate.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅    |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the reported "used" figure is the last route-reported count (or the local estimate until then), so it can lag the in-flight turn; the output flags estimated counts and zero-measurement states rather than presenting them as exact.
- Not validated / out of scope: no live end-to-end model session in CI (the accessor composes the same per-route accounting the send path reads; the ladder is computed by the same `computeThresholds` function the send path calls); a subagent-scoped variant (per-turn chat handle) is a follow-up — the base-session hazard is removed by excluding the tool from subagent inheritance.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — the tool, its registry entry, and the read-only accessor are additive.
- Design documents: N/A.

## Linked Issues

Closes #17313

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

本 PR 给模型补上一个只读的上下文预算工具。`get_context_remaining` 通过 `LlmChat` 上新增的只读 `getContextUsageSnapshot()` 访问器，报告上下文窗口、已用 token（在路由报告真实计数前标注为估算）、剩余量、自动压缩真实触发线（发送路径的同一阶梯函数，含用户阈值覆盖，取整），以及配置了会话 token 上限时的该上限——余量行会指明阶梯与会话上限哪个先到。快照是纯读取：报告发送层为上次请求解析出的窗口，以及计数是否仍描述该请求的路由——属于其他路由的计数会被如实标注，而不会被当作当前路由的；没有上报计数时，派生数字会被扣留而不是按零计算。该工具同时被排除出子代理与队友的工具继承，因为它读取的是基础会话的 chat 而非调用者自己的。

动机：模型此前只有自动压缩已经触发（或请求溢出）时才感知上下文将满，无法趁还有余量时自行决定"现在收尾"或"把大任务委托出去"（#17313）。OpenAI Codex 的同名模型工具（get_context_remaining.rs）是设计先例。

验证：工具单元测试（快照报告/阶梯取整/会话上限绑定/无会话降级两条路径/零计数不归因且不读历史/上次请求路由的窗口/不把别的路由的计数当作请求路由的）+ 请求路由窗口对真实发送的钉（`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/llm-chat.test.ts -t "reports the window of the route the last request used"`）+ 注册与子代理、队友排除钉（config.workflow-registration.test.ts）。风险：已用数字取自路由最近上报（或本地估算），可能滞后于进行中的回合——输出对估算与零计量状态均有标注。无破坏性变更。关闭 #17313。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): pause task creation and show an overload strip in the sidebar
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Surfaces the daemon's load-admission pause in the Web Shell without turning the left rail into a monitoring dashboard. A small native-tooltip warning indicator remains visible on the collapsed rail even when the Home panel is hidden, and remains non-duplicated across non-Home navigation, section views, selection mode, and collapsed channels; expanded Home continues to use the compact strip. Visible text stays small; raw CPU and memory metrics remain in the existing Daemon Status dialog. `title` and ARIA text carry the actual daemon reason and readings.

The client combines a five-second summary status poll with a reactive `system_overloaded` hint that expires after the daemon's `Retry-After`. It pauses fresh-child creation before dispatch, including new/unbound tasks, per-run work, cold restoration, worktree preparation, and delegations without a target. It preserves the last draft on rejection, including asynchronous preflight rejection, and retains a branch session identity when its deferred load is refused. The original action name and overload error are notified once rather than being duplicated or mislabelled as a generic load failure. This is not a blanket disable of every session operation: connected prompts, warm-target sends, Overview Back, navigation, cancellation, status, detach, and explicit recovery cleanup remain available. `/fork` continues to use its parent's existing runtime and is not rejected merely because its name resembles a process fork.

The coordinator distinguishes warm reuse from cold restore using server-fresh state rather than assuming that every bound ID is warm. Before archiving the currently selected standalone session, Overview releases the same session/client registration through the existing detach API; it does not detach other sessions, bypass active-prompt/other-client protections, or allocate a replacement child. Other registrations still obey the server's busy guard. The SDK status type gains the additive optional `loadAdmission` field. Older daemons and `--no-load-admission` degrade to existing behavior plus any genuine reactive refusal. Design: [English](docs/design/daemon-overload-sidebar-indicator.md) / [简体中文](docs/design/daemon-overload-sidebar-indicator.zh-CN.md). Depends on #18052 for proactive daemon measurements and the authoritative backend gate.

## Why it's needed

Without the UI transition, the reviewer could only discover a saturated daemon after a doomed fresh-session request. Fresh-child clicks appeared actionable, navigation and task actions could accidentally trigger a cold allocation, and async rejection could leave a cleared composer or a duplicated warning. A global button disable would have been equally wrong: it would block the existing sessions and control actions needed to inspect, finish, or clean up work during overload. This change places a small, explained warning at the point of action while preserving control-plane recovery and genuine warm reuse.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the real Web Shell against a daemon containing #18052. With a collapsed sidebar, open Scheduled Tasks or another non-Home surface. Apply sustained host load and confirm that the small warning remains visible on the always-visible rail, not inside the hidden Home panel; its native tooltip/ARIA should contain actual load-ratio and event-loop readings. Collapse a channels section, enter selection mode, and navigate between surfaces: there should be one visible warning, rather than a hidden instance and a second visible one. Return to expanded Home and confirm that the compact strip appears with no duplicate rail icon. Headless Chromium does not paint the operating system's native tooltip in screenshots, so tooltip content is verified from the live element's `title` and ARIA, not a fabricated tooltip image.

With a per-run task selected, choose Run now while overloaded: no `/run` request should occur before warning and no run should be consumed. Directly dispatch the same task to the daemon and expect 503 with Retry-After and a retained unsuccessful attempt; a default task creation that needs a fresh child must not persist task metadata. Enter a new `/send` without a target and confirm that the draft remains unchanged and no creation request is sent. Then use an explicit connected warm target: the request body names that exact target, and the caller shows the cross-session result; one request is admitted, the draft commits, the caller remains loaded, and no new ACP child is allocated. Confirm that Overview Back returns to that conversation. Attempt branch/deferred cold restore and confirm that real overload is reported once as `branch_session`/`load_session` as appropriate, the session identity and worktree slug are retained for explicit later continuation, and recovery does not replay a paused directive accidentally.

For the standalone lifecycle, create an idle standalone session, open it from Overview, and archive it. The request must include the selected session in `archived`, not merely return HTTP 200 with `errors: [session_busy]`; afterwards the selected session should have `clientCount: 0` and `isArchived: true`. No other session should be detached and no replacement ACP child should be created. A session with other registered clients or an active prompt continues to use the server's normal busy protection. Finally verify that a genuinely cold standalone restore returns structured 503 during overload, allocates no child, and succeeds after load drains.

At `49839e0103`, the affected six-file Web Shell unit run passed **2242 tests with 0 failures** (the overload-strip file's 15 tests are included once in that total). `SessionOverviewPanel.test.tsx` passed **180/180**, and the sidebar overload-strip suite passed **15/15**. ACP bridge **1136/1136**, gate server **1542/1542**, scheduled-task routes **140/140**, and focused admission **246/246** tests also passed on the coordinated heads. The final coordinated tree, `32dfd960c46f` with gate `13345ab766` and UI `49839e0103`, passed `npm run build && npm run bundle` and the affected typechecks with an 8 GB Node heap. Bundled export renderer JavaScript measured **2,156,064 bytes**. These are local results, not a substitute for the current hosted CI checks.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before this slice, a saturated daemon could be discovered through a failed fresh-child request without a prior warning. The healthy-state reference below is preserved from an earlier coordinated run; it shows the control during normal operation, and is not presented as a newly captured image of the final head.

![Healthy-state reference: no overload warning appears during normal operation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/65e6334d0e0c3d1c883205603e692de31484e9b7/load-admission-ui/sidebar-normal-no-strip.png)

The following images are actual Chromium captures from the final coordinated build, all at 1280×720, from the run with **49 passing assertions, 0 failures, and cleanup complete**. The first and third use the collapsed non-Home rail. The middle capture exercises the caller on expanded Home, so it intentionally shows the full compact strip in the visible Home panel, including a warning toast with the same real readings; this covers both expected placements rather than claiming identical sidebar states. The archive acts on a separate idle standalone fixture with no active prompt, while the already admitted warm conversation remains visible. The other warm session's pending approval is unrelated to archiving the released idle fixture.

![After: overload icon stays visible on Scheduled Tasks, rather than in the hidden Home panel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/576ef7c1b0b671393d95f53a7772a4b898e0ba2e/load-admission-ui/r7-overload-warning-rail.png)

![After: an explicitly targeted warm session is admitted with one dispatch and no fresh ACP child](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/576ef7c1b0b671393d95f53a7772a4b898e0ba2e/load-admission-ui/r7-warm-session-admitted.png)

![After: the idle selected standalone is detached and archived without a replacement child](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/576ef7c1b0b671393d95f53a7772a4b898e0ba2e/load-admission-ui/r7-overview-after-archive.png)

[Machine-generated assertion excerpt, archive result, bundle hash, and cleanup marker from the final real-load run](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/576ef7c1b0b671393d95f53a7772a4b898e0ba2e/load-admission-ui/r7-live-probe-evidence.txt)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local Web Shell component suites on Node 26 use `NODE_OPTIONS=--no-experimental-webstorage` as a runtime workaround. The real-load probe used real Chromium, private daemon HTTP, actual ACP children, and 72 nice-19 CPU burners on a 32-core host. Bundle SHA-256: `ac1abf0f3d3fba61d0cb565bda8e9d1dcf6fb2f09ffdfb809adefbe66d2b368e`. No mock daemon, injected measurements, generated UI images, or fabricated browser tooltip were used.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: one extra summary request per five seconds per open Web Shell. Correctly recognizing warm reuse depends on fresh server state and real client/session ownership; a bound ID alone is not treated as proof of warmth. Client-side preflight is a usability optimization; the daemon in #18052 remains the admission authority and handles races.
- Not validated / out of scope: live macOS/Windows/WebKit coverage; a large CPU/memory dashboard or a new daemon-status affordance on the strip. Real browser coverage on Linux included scheduled work, warm navigation, draft retention, standalone archive, cold refusal and recovery. It did not repeat every other-client/active-prompt combination; those retain existing backend checks and focused tests.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Older daemons without the optional status field never proactively pause the UI; native overload responses still surface their real error. This changes only fresh-child admission and current-owner detach before archive, not existing prompt/cancel semantics.

## Linked Issues

Refs #18052

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

在 Web Shell 透出 daemon 的负荷准入暂停，不把左侧栏变成监控仪表盘。Home 面板隐藏时，小型原生 tooltip 警示图标仍在始终可见的折叠栏上显示；非 Home 导航、section view、多选和 channels 折叠时不会产生重复条。展开 Home 继续使用紧凑 strip。文字保持克制，原始 CPU/内存指标仍在既有 Daemon Status 对话框。`title` 与 ARIA 包含真实 daemon 原因和读数。

客户端把每五秒的 summary 轮询与按 daemon `Retry-After` 过期的被动 `system_overloaded` 提示组合。在派发前暂停 new/unbound、per-run、冷恢复、worktree 和无 target 委派等 fresh-child 创建。拒绝时保留草稿，包括异步 preflight 期间发生的拒绝；延迟 branch 加载被拒时保留会话身份。原 action 与 overload 错误只通知一次，不重复或误标成普通加载失败。这不是禁止所有会话操作：已连接的 prompt、warm-target send、Overview Back、导航、取消、status、detach 和显式恢复清理仍可用。`/fork` 继续复用父 runtime，不因名字像 OS fork 而被误拦。

协调逻辑以服务端新鲜状态区分 warm reuse 与 cold restore，不把每个绑定 ID 都当作 warm。归档当前选中的 standalone 前，Overview 通过既有 detach API 释放相同 session/client 的注册；不会 detach 其它会话、绕过活动 prompt/其它 client 的保护或分配替代 child，其它注册仍遵循服务端 busy guard。SDK 状态类型新增可选 `loadAdmission` 字段。旧 daemon 和 `--no-load-admission` 保持原行为，仅增加真实被动拒绝的提示。设计：[English](docs/design/daemon-overload-sidebar-indicator.md) / [简体中文](docs/design/daemon-overload-sidebar-indicator.zh-CN.md)。主动状态和权威后端闸门依赖 #18052。

## 为什么需要

没有 UI 配合时，只能在一次注定失败的新建请求后发现 daemon 饱和。fresh-child 点击看起来可用，导航和任务动作可能意外触发冷分配，异步拒绝还可能留下已清空的 composer 或重复警告；直接全局禁用按钮同样错误，会封掉过载时应保留的已有会话与控制操作。本改动在动作点显示小型、有原因的提示，同时保留控制面恢复与真实 warm 复用。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

对包含 #18052 的 daemon 运行真实 Web Shell。折叠侧栏，打开 Scheduled Tasks 或其它非 Home 面板，施加持续主机负荷，确认小警示仍位于始终可见的 rail，而不是藏进 Home 面板；原生 tooltip/ARIA 应包含真实负荷比和事件循环读数。折叠 channels、进入多选、切换页面时可见提示应只有一个，不能有另一个隐藏副本。回到展开 Home，应出现紧凑 strip 而不是两个 rail 图标。Headless Chromium 截图不会绘制操作系统的原生 tooltip，因此通过存活元素的 `title`/ARIA 验证内容，不伪造 tooltip 图片。

过载时选择 per-run 任务的 Run now：应在警告前没有 `/run` 请求，也不消费运行次数。直接对 daemon 派发同一任务应得到带 Retry-After 的 503，并保留失败记录；需要新 child 的默认定时任务创建不得落盘。输入不带 target 的新 `/send`，草稿应保持且没有创建请求。改用明确连接的 warm target：请求体精确指定目标，caller 显示跨会话结果；只派发一次并被接受，提交草稿、保持 caller 加载且不新增 ACP child。Overview Back 应能返回该会话。尝试 branch/延迟冷恢复，应按实际场景以 `branch_session` 或 `load_session` 通知一次，保留 session 身份和 worktree slug 供稍后显式继续，恢复时不得误重放暂停指令。

独立会话生命周期：创建 idle standalone，从 Overview 打开并归档。响应必须把选中的 session 放入 `archived`，不能仅凭 HTTP 200 就忽略 `errors: [session_busy]`；操作后应为 `clientCount: 0`、`isArchived: true`。不得 detach 其它会话或创建替代 ACP child。存在其它 client 或活动 prompt 的会话继续由服务端 busy guard 保护。最后确认真正 cold standalone 在过载时返回结构化 503、无新 child，冷却后恢复成功。

`49839e0103` 的六个受影响 Web Shell 测试文件共 **2242 tests / 0 failures**（overload-strip 的 15 项只计一次）；`SessionOverviewPanel.test.tsx` **180/180**，sidebar overload-strip **15/15**。协调 HEAD 上 ACP bridge **1136/1136**、gate server **1542/1542**、scheduled-task routes **140/140**、focused admission **246/246** 也均通过。最终联合树 `32dfd960c46f`（gate `13345ab766` + UI `49839e0103`）通过 `npm run build && npm run bundle` 和使用 8 GB Node heap 的相关类型检查；export renderer JS 为 **2,156,064 bytes**。这些是本地实测，不取代当前托管 CI。

### 证据（前后对照）

本切片之前，饱和 daemon 可能直到一次失败的新建请求才暴露，没有事先预警。下面保留了更早联合运行的健康态参考，用于展示正常运行时的对照，不冒充最终 HEAD 新拍的图片。

![健康态参考：正常运行时不显示过载提示](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/65e6334d0e0c3d1c883205603e692de31484e9b7/load-admission-ui/sidebar-normal-no-strip.png)

以下图片均来自最终联合构建的真实 Chromium，均为 1280×720，来自 **49 项断言通过、0 项失败并完成清理** 的运行。第一张与第三张使用折叠的非 Home rail；中间图中 caller 处于展开 Home，因此有意展示 Home 内完整紧凑 strip，包含相同真实读数的 warning toast。这覆盖两种预期展示位置，不假装侧栏状态完全相同。归档作用于没有活动 prompt 的另一个 idle standalone，已准入的 warm 会话仍可见；另一个 warm 会话的待审批状态与被释放的 idle fixture 归档无关。

![之后：Scheduled Tasks 可见过载图标，不藏在 Home 面板](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/576ef7c1b0b671393d95f53a7772a4b898e0ba2e/load-admission-ui/r7-overload-warning-rail.png)

![之后：明确 warm target 仅派发一次，无新 ACP child](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/576ef7c1b0b671393d95f53a7772a4b898e0ba2e/load-admission-ui/r7-warm-session-admitted.png)

![之后：当前 idle standalone detach 后归档，无替代 child](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/576ef7c1b0b671393d95f53a7772a4b898e0ba2e/load-admission-ui/r7-overview-after-archive.png)

[最终真实负荷运行的机器断言摘录、归档结果、bundle 哈希和清理标记](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/576ef7c1b0b671393d95f53a7772a4b898e0ba2e/load-admission-ui/r7-live-probe-evidence.txt)

### 测试平台

Linux ✅ 实测；macOS ⚠️ 未实测；Windows ⚠️ 未实测。

### 环境

Node 26 的本地 Web Shell 组件套件使用 `NODE_OPTIONS=--no-experimental-webstorage` 绕过本机运行时问题。真实负荷探针使用真实 Chromium、私有 daemon HTTP、真实 ACP child 和 32 核主机上的 72 个 nice-19 CPU burner。bundle SHA-256：`ac1abf0f3d3fba61d0cb565bda8e9d1dcf6fb2f09ffdfb809adefbe66d2b368e`。没有 mock daemon、注入指标、生成 UI 图片或伪造浏览器 tooltip。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：每个打开的 Web Shell 每五秒多一次 summary 请求。warm reuse 依赖服务端新鲜状态与真实 client/session owner，绑定 ID 本身不能证明 warm。客户端预检只是易用性优化；#18052 的 daemon 才是权威闸门并处理竞态。
- 未验证/范围外：macOS/Windows/WebKit 实机；大型 CPU/内存仪表盘；strip 上新增 daemon-status 入口。Linux 浏览器实测包含定时任务、warm 导航、草稿保留、standalone 归档、冷拒绝和恢复，未逐一覆盖其它 client/活动 prompt 的全部组合，后者仍由既有后端检查与定向测试保障。
- 破坏性变更/迁移：无。旧 daemon 没有可选状态字段时不主动暂停 UI；原生 overload 仍展示真实错误。仅改变 fresh-child 准入与归档当前 owner 前的 detach，不改变已有 prompt/cancel 语义。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #18052

</details>

prs.title: feat(core): run headless sessions on the event-bus kernel by default
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Headless sessions (`-p` and stream-json, SDK sessions included) now run the shared agent loop on the event-bus kernel by default. To switch back, set `"experimental": { "eventBusAgentLoop": false }` or `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_EVENT_BUS_AGENT_LOOP=headless=0`. A cancelled headless run on the kernel settles within 10 s: a run still pending then ends as cancelled and late tool results are dropped. This is headless's step 4 of #17045: the `headless` entry of the kernel switch's per-surface default table turns on. Headless already runs on the shared loop by default (#17362); this moves that loop from its procedural path onto the kernel. Every other surface keeps the procedural path, and no shared-loop default changes. It replaces #17445, closed on 11-18, and carries that PR's review fixes.

`experimental.eventBusAgentLoop` no longer defaults to `false`: when it is unset, each surface uses its own default. Setting it to `true` still turns the kernel on for every surface that runs on the shared loop, and `false` keeps every surface, headless included, on the procedural path. In `/settings`, the OpenTUI settings dialog and `/config`, the setting shows as not set, and its first toggle writes `true`, as before. The settings description, the settings reference, the VS Code schema, the Web Shell's Chinese descriptions and the design docs, the capability ledger included, say so.

Two review fixes from #17445 come with it. The rollout-switches design no longer calls a kernel-leg failure "a signal, not a regression": with the kernel on by default for headless, a headless failure on the Linux kernel leg is a regression of its default path, and for the surfaces whose kernel is still off a failure restarts their count of nights. The two headless Workflow-mode suites (CLI and SDK) pin their shared arm off the kernel, so it still covers the shared loop's procedural path, and assert the `[LOOP] headless <path>` debug marker of each arm.

### Intended differences

The kernel runs the same rounds and batches as the procedural path; the event-bus design's equivalence suite and the headless parity suite compare the two. A headless run on the kernel differs in these intended ways:

- when a run is cancelled, the kernel publishes `loop.cancelled` and gives the run 10 s to settle; a run still pending then ends as cancelled with no tool results, and late tool progress and results are dropped, where the procedural path waits for every handler without a cap;
- the debug log marks each round on the kernel (`[EVENT_BUS]`), and `/about` and `/bug` report the loop path as `kernel`.

### How to switch back

Either of these keeps headless on the procedural path of the shared loop:

- the setting `"experimental": { "eventBusAgentLoop": false }` (this turns the kernel off for every surface);
- the environment variable `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_EVENT_BUS_AGENT_LOOP=headless=0` (headless only), or `=0` (every surface).

`"experimental": { "unifiedAgentLoop": false }` still takes headless off the shared loop altogether. The procedural path stays until every surface has had its kernel default for 14 days.

## Why it's needed

#17045 turns the kernel on one surface at a time, and headless is first (planned for 11-30). Every step-4 condition holds:

- headless runs on the shared loop by default (#17362);
- #17145 (cancellation through the bus and the bounded close) merged on 11-13;
- the Linux leg that runs the integration tests with both settings on has passed every night from 11-14 to 11-22, except 11-17, when it failed only in a test unrelated to the loop that failed the same way on main with the switches off; under #17045's rule of 11-18 that night does not restart the count, so its seven nights ended on 11-20;
- the intended differences and the way back are listed above, so the release notes carry them.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- With nothing set, `qwen -p` runs on the kernel: its debug log (`QWEN_DEBUG_LOG_FILE=1`) shows `[LOOP] headless kernel` and the `[EVENT_BUS]` marker, and `/about` reports `kernel`. With `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_EVENT_BUS_AGENT_LOOP=headless=0`, or `"experimental": { "eventBusAgentLoop": false }`, it shows `[LOOP] headless shared`.
- The config tests pin the kernel on by default for headless and off for every other surface, both ways back, each surface's loop path, and that the shared-loop default does not move with it. The headless visibility suite runs a real headless process with both switches unset and checks it takes the kernel.
- The Workflow-mode suites' shared arm reports `[LOOP] headless shared`; with its kernel pin removed it reports `kernel` and the suite fails.

```
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/config/config.test.ts
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/config/settingsUtils.test.ts src/config/config.test.ts src/config/settingsSchema.test.ts src/ui/components/SettingsDialog.test.tsx src/ui/opentui/dialogs-settings.test.ts src/ui/commands/config-command.test.ts src/serve/routes/workspace-settings.test.ts
cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/i18n.test.ts client/settings.test.ts client/settings
QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run --root ./integration-tests ./cli/agent-loop-visibility.test.ts ./cli/workflow-mode.test.ts ./sdk-typescript/workflow-mode.test.ts
```

Results: after merging main (d4b28087f4), `npm run build`, `npm run bundle` and the typechecks of core, the CLI, the Web Shell and the integration tests are clean; core config (1099), CLI config (746) and Web Shell i18n and settings (235) tests pass, and so do the tests of the setting's readers: both settings dialogs, `/config` and the daemon's workspace-settings route (227); the three integration suites above pass (22 tests). With the kernel pin removed from both Workflow-mode suites, their shared arm reports `kernel` instead of `shared` and fails, as it should. Linux, Node 22.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A: no visible change in the common case; the differences are listed above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22, no sandbox; fake OpenAI server for the integration suites.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: every headless run, SDK sessions included, moves to the kernel at once. The kernel wraps the same round and batch steps as the procedural path; a regression attributed to it restarts headless's wait, and either switch above brings the procedural path back.
- Not validated / out of scope: the other surfaces' kernel defaults (the Ink TUI's follows this one); removing headless's legacy loop (step 5) and the procedural path.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the cancellation cap above; `experimental.eventBusAgentLoop: false` now also keeps headless on the procedural path.

Design doc: [English](docs/design/2026-11-11-event-bus-agent-loop.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-11-11-event-bus-agent-loop.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Part of #17045 (headless's step 4). Replaces #17445.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

headless 会话（`-p` 和 stream-json，包括 SDK 会话）现在默认在事件总线内核上运行共享 agent loop。切回方式：设置 `"experimental": { "eventBusAgentLoop": false }`，或设 `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_EVENT_BUS_AGENT_LOOP=headless=0`。内核上被取消的 headless 运行在 10 秒内收尾：届时仍未结束的运行以取消结束，迟到的工具结果被丢弃。这是 #17045 中 headless 的第 4 步：内核开关按入口默认值表中的 `headless` 一项改为开启。headless 已经默认运行在共享 loop 上（#17362）；本 PR 把这个 loop 从过程式路径移到内核上。其他入口都保持过程式路径，共享 loop 的默认值都不变。本 PR 取代 11-18 关闭的 #17445，并带上了它评审中要求的修改。

`experimental.eventBusAgentLoop` 不再默认为 `false`：未设置时，每个入口使用自己的默认值。设为 `true` 仍对所有运行在共享 loop 上的入口开启内核，设为 `false` 让所有入口（包括 headless）使用过程式路径。在 `/settings`、OpenTUI 设置对话框和 `/config` 中，这个设置显示为未设置，第一次切换写入 `true`，与以前相同。设置说明、设置参考文档、VS Code schema、Web Shell 的简体和繁体中文说明，以及设计文档（包括能力台账）都已同步。

同时带上 #17445 评审中的两处修改。rollout-switches 设计文档不再说内核组的失败"是信号，不是回归"：headless 默认开启内核后，Linux 内核组上 headless 的失败就是它默认路径的回归；对内核仍默认关闭的入口，失败会让它的晚数重新计算。两组 headless Workflow 模式测试（CLI 和 SDK）把 shared 那组固定在内核之外，让它继续覆盖共享 loop 的过程式路径，并断言每组的 `[LOOP] headless <path>` 调试标记。

### 有意差异

内核运行的模型轮和工具批与过程式路径相同；事件总线设计的等价测试和 headless 对拍套件比较两者。headless 在内核上运行时有以下有意差异：

- 运行被取消时，内核发布 `loop.cancelled`，给运行 10 秒收尾；届时仍未结束的运行以取消结束、不带工具结果，迟到的工具进度和结果被丢弃，而过程式路径会无上限地等待每个 handler；
- 调试日志为内核上的每一轮打上标记（`[EVENT_BUS]`），`/about` 和 `/bug` 报告 loop 路径为 `kernel`。

### 如何切回

下面任意一种方式都能让 headless 回到共享 loop 的过程式路径：

- 设置 `"experimental": { "eventBusAgentLoop": false }`（这会对所有入口关闭内核）；
- 环境变量 `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_EVENT_BUS_AGENT_LOOP=headless=0`（只关 headless），或 `=0`（关闭所有入口）。

`"experimental": { "unifiedAgentLoop": false }` 仍会让 headless 完全离开共享 loop。过程式路径保留到每个入口的内核默认开启都满 14 天。

## 为什么需要

#17045 一次为一个入口开启内核，headless 是第一个（原定 11-30）。第 4 步的条件都已满足：

- headless 已默认运行在共享 loop 上（#17362）；
- #17145（经由事件总线的取消和有界收尾）已于 11-13 合入；
- 两个设置都开启、跑集成测试的 Linux 组从 11-14 到 11-22 每晚通过，只有 11-17 失败，失败的是一个与 loop 无关、在 main 上关闭开关时也以同样方式失败的测试；按 #17045 11-18 的规则，那一晚不让晚数重新计算，所以它的 7 晚在 11-20 已满；
- 有意差异和切回方式已在上面列出，release notes 会带上它们。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 什么都不设置时，`qwen -p` 运行在内核上：调试日志（`QWEN_DEBUG_LOG_FILE=1`）显示 `[LOOP] headless kernel` 和 `[EVENT_BUS]` 标记，`/about` 报告 `kernel`。设 `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_EVENT_BUS_AGENT_LOOP=headless=0` 或 `"experimental": { "eventBusAgentLoop": false }` 时显示 `[LOOP] headless shared`。
- 配置测试固定 headless 默认开启内核、其他入口关闭，两种切回方式，各入口的 loop 路径，以及共享 loop 的默认值不随之变化。headless 可见性测试在两个开关都未设置时运行一个真实的 headless 进程，检查它走内核。
- Workflow 模式测试中 shared 那组报告 `[LOOP] headless shared`；去掉它的内核固定后报告 `kernel`，测试失败。

结果：合并 main（d4b28087f4）后，`npm run build`、`npm run bundle` 以及 core、CLI、Web Shell 和集成测试的 typecheck 都无错误；core 配置测试（1099）、CLI 配置测试（746）、Web Shell 的 i18n 和设置测试（235）通过，读取这个设置的几处（两个设置对话框、`/config` 和 daemon 的 workspace-settings 路由）的测试也通过（227）；上面三个集成测试通过（22 个用例）。去掉两组 Workflow 模式测试里对内核的固定后，它们的 shared 组报告 `kernel` 而不是 `shared`，测试失败，符合预期。Linux、Node 22。

### 前后对比

不适用：常见情况下没有可见变化；差异已在上面列出。

### 环境

Node 22，无沙箱；集成测试使用 fake OpenAI server。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：所有 headless 运行（包括 SDK 会话）一起切到内核。内核包装的是与过程式路径相同的模型轮和工具批步骤；归因于内核的回归会让 headless 重新等待，上面任意一种开关都能切回过程式路径。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：其他入口的内核默认开启（Ink TUI 在本 PR 之后）；删除 headless 的旧 loop（第 5 步）和过程式路径。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：上面的取消上限；`experimental.eventBusAgentLoop: false` 现在也会让 headless 保持过程式路径。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-11-11-event-bus-agent-loop.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-11-11-event-bus-agent-loop.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

属于 #17045（headless 的第 4 步）。取代 #17445。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): match /cd and /directory add completions case-insensitively on Windows
prs.body:
## What this PR does Makes `/cd` and `/directory add` directory path completion match prefixes case-insensitively on Windows (`win32`) while preserving the real on-disk directory casing in returned suggestions. Both commands share the same directory-completion helper, which now accepts an optional injectable platform parameter (defaulting to the current runtime platform) so unit tests can exercise both Windows (`win32`) and POSIX (`linux`/`darwin`) matching paths regardless of the host CI runner. On `win32`, prefixes such as `doc` or `DOC` match `Documents` and suggest `Documents\`; on POSIX platforms, matching stays case-sensitive. Hidden dot-directories remain excluded on all platforms. ## Why it's needed Windows filesystems are case-insensitive, so Windows users routinely type lowercase prefixes such as `/cd doc` or `/directory add pack` when navigating into directories like `Documents` or `Packages`. Previously, directory completion filtered child entries with a case-sensitive prefix check on every platform, returning no suggestions whenever capitalization differed from the on-disk folder name. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify 1. In a Windows workspace, create directories `Documents` and `Packages`. 2. Start the interactive CLI and type `/cd doc` (without pressing Enter). Expect the completion dropdown to suggest `Documents\` (preserving the on-disk capitalization). 3. Clear the input and type `/directory add pack`. Expect the completion dropdown to suggest `Packages\`. 4. Confirm that typing `/cd Doc` (exact case) still suggests `Documents\`, hidden directories starting with `.` are still excluded, and POSIX platforms keep case-sensitive prefix matching. ### Evidence (Before & After) Real-terminal A/B verification on Windows 11 (ConPTY real-terminal harness against a local mock OpenAI server, Chinese locale, default settings): | Scenario | Before (`18ac669a3a`) | After (`fdb159a8a2`) | | --- | --- | --- | | Control (`/cd Doc` exact case) | Suggests `Documents\` | Suggests `Documents\` | | `/cd doc` (lowercase prefix) | No completion suggestions shown | Suggests `Documents\` | | `/directory add pack` (lowercase prefix) | No completion suggestions shown | Suggests `Packages\` | | | Before (`18ac669a3a`) | After (`fdb159a8a2`) | | --- | --- | --- | | `/cd doc` | | | | `/directory add pack` | | | Unit tests and typecheck (same complete test file before and after): ```bash cd packages/cli npx vitest run src/ui/commands/directoryCommand.test.tsx ``` - Before fix (`18ac669a3a` with added regression tests): 1 test file failed (2 failed, 28 passed; 30 total). - After fix (`fdb159a8a2`): 1 test file passed (30 passed; 30 total), `npm run build` and `tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli` exited 0, and ESLint/Prettier passed with 0 warnings. ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested | | 🪟 Windows | ✅ tested | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested | ### Environment (optional) Windows 11 (`win32`), Node.js v24.20.0, base commit `18ac669a3a`, fix commit `fdb159a8a2`. Verified via `npm run build`, `tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli`, the full directory-command Vitest suite (covering both injected `win32` and `linux`/`darwin` platforms), and interactive ConPTY A/B capture. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: Scoped strictly to the shared directory-completion helper used by `/cd` and `/directory add` (2 files changed, no changes to `packages/core`). Only `win32` switches to case-insensitive prefix matching; POSIX platforms (`linux`, `darwin`) keep exact case-sensitive matching unchanged. - Not validated / out of scope: Native macOS/Linux terminal runs were not executed (both `win32` and POSIX branches are covered directly in unit tests via the injectable platform parameter). macOS case-insensitive APFS volumes are intentionally left unchanged here. The workspace-directory completion inside the `/permissions` dialog has a similar case-sensitive filter and is left out of scope; this PR only changes the helper behind `/cd` and `/directory add`. - Breaking changes / migration notes: None. ## Linked Issues Fixes #18162
中文说明 ## 本次 PR 做了什么 让 `/cd` 和 `/directory add` 的目录路径补全在 Windows（`win32`）上按大小写不敏感匹配前缀，并在返回的补全建议中保留磁盘上的真实目录大小写。 两个命令共用同一目录补全辅助函数，本次为其增加可选的可注入平台参数（默认取当前运行平台），使单元测试在任意操作系统的 CI 上都能同时覆盖 Windows（`win32`）与 POSIX（`linux`/`darwin`）两条分支。在 `win32` 上，输入 `doc` 或 `DOC` 均可匹配 `Documents` 并提示 `Documents\`；在 POSIX 平台上继续保持大小写敏感匹配。以 `.` 开头的隐藏目录在所有平台上仍被排除。 ## 为什么需要这个改动 Windows 文件系统不区分大小写，用户在输入 `/cd doc` 或 `/directory add pack` 时通常直接敲小写前缀。此前目录补全在所有平台上都采用区分大小写的前缀过滤，导致输入大小写与磁盘目录名不一致时完全没有补全提示。 ## 评审测试方案 ### 如何验证 1. 在 Windows 工作区中创建目录 `Documents` 和 `Packages`。 2. 启动交互式 CLI，输入 `/cd doc`（不回车），预期补全下拉列表提示 `Documents\`（保留磁盘真实大小写）。 3. 清空输入后输入 `/directory add pack`，预期补全下拉列表提示 `Packages\`。 4. 确认精确大小写 `/cd Doc` 仍正常提示 `Documents\`、以 `.` 开头的隐藏目录仍被排除、POSIX 平台继续保持大小写敏感匹配。 ### 验证证据（修复前 vs 修复后） Windows 11 真终端 A/B 实测（使用 ConPTY 真终端测试框架配合本地 mock OpenAI 服务端，中文界面、默认设置）： | 场景 | 修复前（`18ac669a3a`） | 修复后（`fdb159a8a2`） | | --- | --- | --- | | 对照组（`/cd Doc` 精确大小写） | 提示 `Documents\` | 提示 `Documents\` | | `/cd doc`（小写前缀） | 无任何补全提示 | 提示 `Documents\` | | `/directory add pack`（小写前缀） | 无任何补全提示 | 提示 `Packages\` | 单元测试与类型检查（修复前后运行完全相同的完整测试文件）： ```bash cd packages/cli npx vitest run src/ui/commands/directoryCommand.test.tsx ``` - prs.title: feat(cli): retain and restore worktree snapshots across workspaces
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR implements P6 U4/U5: count-based retention for held chats and owner-scoped reconstruction of their retained worktrees on reopen. Every active, trusted, non-internal primary and secondary workspace is handled independently, using its own settings, storage, Git root, bridge and runtime-generation checks rather than falling back to the primary workspace. The limit applies to eligible chats; live and pinned chats are preserved separately. Setting `worktree.maxRetained` to zero disables automatic sweeping, not an explicit restore of an already retained snapshot.

Retention preserves the chat, transcript, sidecar and exact snapshot pair across removal, archive and unarchive. Restore is available only when the owner's registered workspace and the selected archive agree. It reconstructs a fresh managed checkout, then verifies actual file bytes, deletions, owner-executable bits, HEAD, branch state and the exclusive owner marker before completing the session binding and normal load. A named branch is attached only while it still points at the captured commit; a moved ref is left untouched and the checkout is restored detached.

Snapshot extraction now preserves captured modes on reused HEAD files, including `0755` on Linux. Catalog lifecycle fields are also refreshed from the current sidecar: an older live summary or a reused metadata cache cannot resurrect an old archive key or make a successfully restored chat look removed again. Existing protected cleanup checks, including drift, pending Git operations, ownership and snapshot validation, remain in force.

The new daemon/API and Session Overview flow is capability-gated and consumes the same owner-scoped state as retention. It is separate from `worktree-reset`, which is an ownership-changing replacement workflow.

## Why it's needed

The earlier lifecycle could snapshot and preserve worktrees, but it did not provide an applied per-workspace retention sweep and a production, owner-proven way to reopen them. Capturing state without a reliable restoration and projection path leaves users with stale or inaccessible data; simply deleting old checkouts would risk losing dirty work.

A single daemon can own many workspaces. Primary-only cleanup would leave secondary workspaces behind, while guessing ownership from a name or path prefix could remove or replace another workspace's checkout. Orphan archives therefore remain preserved rather than being adopted automatically.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Register two Git workspaces in one daemon, with a primary root and a distinct secondary root, and give each an independent retention limit. Create sessions containing dirty tracked text, executable tracked files, untracked binary data and a tracked deletion. Hold live and pinned sessions out of the eligible set. Confirm each root keeps its configured newest eligible chats, removes only older eligible checkouts after capturing a snapshot, and leaves the chat/transcript/sidecar intelligible. Shared/unknown roots, inaccessible settings or pin state and unknown ownership must preserve instead of deleting.
2. Archive and unarchive the retained chats. Confirm each snapshot tar/JSON pair follows the same owner into its corresponding archive or active directory, without filename/prefix-based adoption. Ask the other runtime to restore a target and confirm it is rejected without creating a checkout or changing the removal binding.
3. In Session Overview, choose All workspaces and restore each retained target. Confirm the request carries that workspace's registered `cwd`, no caller-supplied target/archive path is needed, and normal navigation succeeds. Inspect the reconstructed Git checkout: the tracked bytes, untracked bytes, executable mode and captured HEAD must match; deleted files stay absent; and the owner marker matches the session. The archive must remain readable rather than being silently consumed.
4. Exercise the named-ref case: restore while the ref still resolves to the captured commit and verify attachment; advance that ref separately and verify the restored checkout is detached without resetting the ref.
5. Re-create a retained removal, corrupt its selected tar and activate Restore snapshot. Confirm a visible error and no replacement owner marker. The current sidecar key, JSON header and the archive itself must remain intact, so another fallback or cleanup does not turn partial failure into apparent success.

### Evidence (Before & After)

These are real operation states from the isolated primary/secondary run, not a claim that the panel's visual theme changed. The first frame is captured after both workspace catalogs have loaded and their valid restore actions are visible. The second frame shows both targets reopened. The third frame is the observed error after deliberately corrupting the newly retained tar; its persistent binding and other recovery evidence are checked on disk.

![Both workspaces with valid retained snapshot restore actions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-worktree-manager/u45-retention-restore-2026-11-21/before-restore.png)

![Successful restoration for both the primary and secondary workspaces](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-worktree-manager/u45-retention-restore-2026-11-21/after-restore.png)

![Visible failure after corrupting the current retained archive](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-worktree-manager/u45-retention-restore-2026-11-21/corrupt-archive-failure.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested with real Git, tar, filesystem, HTTP, and Chromium |

### Environment (optional)

Linux with Node 26. The isolated integration run starts a real daemon with independent primary and secondary runtime homes, settings, storage and Git repositories, using a mock model provider. Browser actions use the built Web Shell in real Chromium with a temporary profile. The run does not use real model credentials or restart the user's existing daemon.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: retention is destructive to checkout placement and depends on correct runtime ownership, generation and sidecar ordering. This PR deliberately preserves on ambiguous or unreadable state, rechecks ownership immediately before removal, and verifies reconstruction before publishing a normal binding. Metadata availability and restoration are evaluated against the current sidecar rather than a stale live projection or cached sidecar snapshot. A precision tradeoff is that malformed or inaccessible data can remain unrecovered and require manual attention instead of being guessed into a different workspace.
- Preserve-on-unproven-ownership is intentionally global across the attestation map. An unreadable root, environment or settings entry pauses automatic sweeping rather than treating a possibly shared or corrupted root as unsupported. An early partial checkout that lacks its exclusive marker likewise remains untouched for manual recovery. Only a partial checkout that has the matching owner, target and bytes may use binding-only completion. These availability tradeoffs are documented in both languages.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS, Windows, the complete CI matrix and Java verification were not run locally. External model calls are not exercised by the mock-provider integration run. P7 custom roots, TTLs, orphan-expiry, a global aggregate quota, arbitrary user-selected snapshot paths and changes to ownership-changing reset semantics remain out of scope. No byte-for-byte global transaction is claimed across Git objects, archive/header writes, external process crashes or concurrent raw filesystem edits.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no intended breaking change. Active worktree summaries retain their previous shape, with snapshot state optional. Ordinary archive/unarchive continues to preserve existing content and bindings. The restoration surface is capability-gated. Existing hidden-index, pending-operation and ownership guards are not weakened.
- Design documents: [English](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/f37158005a/docs/design/2026-11-21-web-shell-worktree-retention-restore.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/f37158005a/docs/design/2026-11-21-web-shell-worktree-retention-restore.zh-CN.md). Decisions, constraints, validation and follow-up limits are synchronized in both versions.

## Linked Issues

Refs #17237 (P6 U4/U5). This does not claim completion of later P7 scope or close the parent issue.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的内容

本 PR 实现 P6 的 U4/U5：对保留会话执行按数量的 worktree 清扫，并在重新打开会话时按已验证 owner 从快照恢复 checkout。每个 active、trusted、非 internal 的 primary 和 secondary workspace 都独立处理，使用自己的 settings、storage、Git 根、bridge 与 runtime generation 检查，而不是回退到 primary。配额只针对 deletion-eligible 会话，live 与 pinned 会话单独保护。`worktree.maxRetained` 为 0 时关闭自动清扫，但不会禁用对已保留快照的显式恢复。

清扫会保留 chat、transcript、sidecar 与精确配对的快照，并在移除、归档和取消归档之间维持其归属。恢复只有在注册 workspace owner 与所选归档一致时才允许：先重建全新的托管 checkout，再校验真实文件字节、删除项、属主可执行位、HEAD、分支状态和互斥 owner marker，最后完成会话绑定并正常加载。命名分支仅在仍指向捕获提交时连接；ref 已前进则恢复为 detached，绝不重置该 ref。

快照解包现在会对复用的 HEAD 文件恢复捕获的 mode，包含 Linux 下的 `0755`。catalog 生命周期字段也会读取当前 sidecar，旧 live 摘要或被复用的元数据缓存不能再复活旧 archive key，也不能让已经成功恢复的会话再次显示为已移除。既有的保护式清理检查，包括内容漂移、暂停中的 Git 操作、ownership 和快照校验，均继续生效。

新的 daemon/API 与 Session Overview 流程通过 capability 开关启用，消费与清扫相同的 owner-scoped 状态。它与会改变 ownership 的 `worktree-reset` 替换流程分开，不复用语义。

## 为什么需要

此前生命周期已能捕获并保留 worktree，但尚无应用到实际生产的、按 workspace 隔离的保留清扫，也没有可靠的按 owner 恢复流程。仅能保存状态却无法可靠恢复和投影，会让用户面对陈旧或不可达的数据；直接删除旧 checkout 又可能丢失未提交的工作。

一个 daemon 可以拥有很多 workspace。只清扫 primary 会遗漏 secondary，而按文件名或路径前缀猜测 ownership 可能删除或替换其它 workspace 的 checkout。本 PR 因此保留 orphan 归档，不自动把它们提升为某个会话。

## 审查者验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 在同一个 daemon 注册两个 Git workspace，一个有 primary 根，一个有独立的 secondary 根，并给各自设置独立保留上限。创建包含 dirty tracked 文本、可执行 tracked 文件、未跟踪二进制数据及 tracked 删除的会话，并将 live/pinned 会话置于 eligible 集合之外。确认每个根均按自己的设置保留最新的合规会话，仅在完成快照后移除较老的 eligible checkout，并保留其 chat/transcript/sidecar。共享或不明根、不可读设置或 pin 状态、未知 ownership 均必须保留而不是删除。
2. 归档再取消归档这些会话。确认 tar/JSON 快照对跟随同一 owner 进入对应 archive 或 active 目录，不按文件名或前缀重新认养。从另一个 runtime 请求恢复该目标，确认请求被拒绝，不创建 checkout，也不改变 removal binding。
3. 在 Session Overview 选择 All workspaces，分别恢复两个保留目标。确认请求携带各 workspace 已注册的 `cwd`，不需要调用方提供目标目录或归档路径，正常导航成功。检查重建后的 Git checkout：tracked 字节、未跟踪字节、可执行位和捕获 HEAD 均相同，删除文件保持不存在，owner marker 与会话相符。归档仍须可读，不能静默被消费。
4. 验证命名分支情形：ref 仍指向捕获提交时可以连接；另将 ref 前进后，确认恢复为 detached 且不重置该 ref。
5. 再产生一次保留移除，故意损坏其当前选择的 tar，然后点击 Restore snapshot。确认出现可见错误且没有替代 owner marker。当前 sidecar key、JSON 头部和归档本身均保留，不会靠别的回退或清理把部分失败伪装成成功。

### 前后证据

以下均为隔离 primary/secondary 运行中的真实操作状态，并不表示面板视觉主题被重新设计。第一张图在两个 workspace 的目录都加载完成、有效恢复按钮均可见时截取。第二张图展示两个目标均已重新打开。第三张图是故意损坏新保留 tar 后实际观察到的错误；其持久化绑定及恢复相关证据均在磁盘上进一步校验。

![两个 workspace 都具备有效的快照恢复操作](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-worktree-manager/u45-retention-restore-2026-11-21/before-restore.png)

![primary 与 secondary workspace 均成功恢复](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-worktree-manager/u45-retention-restore-2026-11-21/after-restore.png)

![损坏当前保留归档后的可见错误](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-worktree-manager/u45-retention-restore-2026-11-21/corrupt-archive-failure.png)

### 已验证平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未验证 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 已使用真实 Git、tar、文件系统、HTTP 与 Chromium 验证 |

### 环境（可选）

Linux，Node 26。隔离集成运行启动真实 daemon，赋予 primary 和 secondary 各自独立的 runtime HOME、settings、storage 与 Git 仓库，模型提供方使用 mock。浏览器操作通过构建后的 Web Shell，在带临时 profile 的真实 Chromium 中进行。运行不读取真实模型凭据，也不重启用户原有 daemon。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：保留清扫会改变 checkout 的落盘位置，依赖正确的 runtime ownership、generation 和 sidecar 写入顺序。本 PR 在状态不明或不可读时保留，在删除前再次复核 ownership，并在发布正常绑定前验证重建结果。元数据可用性及其恢复状态以当前 sidecar 为依据，而不是旧 live 投影或缓存中的快照。代价是损坏或不可读的数据可能保持不可恢复，需要人工处理，而不是被猜测认领到另一个 workspace。
- 归属证明未完成时，整个归属图按保守策略暂停自动清扫。root、环境或设置不可读时，不把可能共享或已损坏的根当作「不适用清扫」。若在 owner marker 创建前就失败形成部分 checkout，也不会把它直接认养或覆盖，而是保留给人工恢复。只有 owner、目标与内容都严格匹配的 partial 才允许 binding-only 收尾。相应的可恢复性取舍已在中英设计文档中明确。
- 未验证/范围外：macOS、Windows、完整 CI 矩阵与 Java 验证没有在本地执行；使用 mock 模型提供方的集成验证不覆盖真实外部模型调用。P7 自定义根、TTL、孤儿归档过期、全局聚合配额、任意用户选择的归档路径及改变 ownership 的 reset 语义都不在本范围内。不声明覆盖 Git 对象库、归档/头部写入、外部进程崩溃或原始并发文件操作的逐字节全局事务保证。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无预期破坏性变更。活跃 worktree 摘要保持原有形状，快照状态为可选。普通 archive/unarchive 继续保留已有内容和绑定。恢复能力通过 capability 启用。既有隐藏索引位、暂停 Git 操作和 ownership 守卫不被削弱。
- 设计文档：[英文](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/f37158005a/docs/design/2026-11-21-web-shell-worktree-retention-restore.md) 与 [简体中文](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/f37158005a/docs/design/2026-11-21-web-shell-worktree-retention-restore.zh-CN.md)。两份文档的决策、约束、验证和后续范围保持同步。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #17237 的 P6 U4/U5。本 PR 不表示完成后续 P7 范围，也不关闭父 issue。

</details>

## Follow-up verification (f67c90bb6a)

A follow-up run on f67c90bb6a used a real isolated daemon, distinct primary and secondary workspaces, an isolated dummy provider and Chromium. Retained secondary data was restored through the real UI: the deleted parent directory stayed absent, while force-added ignored files, binary data, deleted paths, symlink targets, HEAD/branch state and the session owner marker matched the original. The worktree-restore operation completed once with no subsequent ordinary session load. The hydrated client kept its replay and artifacts, and its final detach returned 204 with no remaining live-session diagnostics. A real Git removal gate also held shutdown until the actual filesystem work finished; after restart, the retained pair and binding restored correctly. A deliberately corrupted archive produced a visible failure without deleting the sole recovery binding or manufacturing a replacement owner.

These results supplement the isolated local verification rather than claiming that GitHub CI or the new review has completed.

## 跟进验证（f67c90bb6a）

本次在 f67c90bb6a 上使用隔离的真实 daemon、独立的 primary/secondary workspace、dummy provider 和 Chromium 完成操作。secondary 被保留的 worktree 通过真实界面完成恢复：删除的文件及其空父目录不再存在，force-added ignored 文件、二进制数据、删除项、symlink target、HEAD/branch 和 owner marker 都与原内容一致。worktree-restore 只调用一次，后续的普通 load 没有发生；已水合的 client 保留 replay 和 artifacts，最后一次 detach 返回 204，诊断中没有残留活跃注册。真实阻塞 Git remove 时，daemon 等它结束后才退出，重启后仍能按快照绑定恢复。人为损坏归档时明确报错，不制造替代 owner，也不删除唯一恢复绑定。

这些截图是隔离运行中的真实记录，说明上述操作和文件字节已经复查；不表示 GitHub CI 或最新评审已经结束。

![Restore snapshot for retained worktrees](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets-pr18009/pr18009/f67c90bb6a/browser-02-retained-overview.png)

![Restored secondary workspace with its original conversation replay](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets-pr18009/pr18009/f67c90bb6a/browser-03-restored-secondary.png)

## Follow-up verification (4934d25d4e)

A historical removal was constructed from real retained snapshots and owner records produced by the actual daemon. After the daemon stopped normally, only the worktreeRemoved property was omitted, with retention disabled to prevent an automatic repair before preview. Running the newly built bundle with isolated HOME/runtime, two registered workspaces, a loopback dummy provider and real Chromium showed that the read-only catalog exposed restoration while preserving the original sidecar byte-for-byte. Browser restoration recreated the checkout and retained the original replay and artifacts, performed one restore without a later ordinary load, and detached with HTTP 204. A secondary record also completed actual HTTP archive/unarchive: the sidecar and exact snapshot pair moved to the matching archive locations, their SHA-256 values stayed unchanged, and the original secondary replay restored with one client and no attach registrations. The harness process exited zero and the dummy provider made no upstream calls.

The five affected CLI test files passed 298 tests, and repository lint, build, typecheck and bundling passed. These are local results and do not replace GitHub CI or an independent review.

## 历史绑定跟进验证（4934d25d4e）

在独立 HOME/runtime、真正 daemon、两个注册工作空间、dummy provider 和 Chromium 中完成复核。先由实际 retention 生成快照和 owner 记录，正常停止 daemon 后仅省略 worktreeRemoved 属性构造历史窗口，并禁止后台自动补回。在缺失字段的原始记录上，目录预览可以展示恢复入口，且只读查询前后 sidecar 字节完全一致。真实浏览器恢复 checkout 后保留原始 replay 与 artifacts，只调用一次 restore，没有后续普通 load，最后一次 detach 返回 204。secondary 还经过真实 HTTP archive/unarchive：sidecar 和精确归档对随状态搬移，tar 和 metadata 的 SHA-256 均保持不变，随后仍以原 secondary workspace 恢复历史，只有一个 client，attachCount 为 0。测试进程正常退出，dummy provider 没有对外部上游的请求。

相关 5 个 CLI 测试文件共 298 项通过，仓库 lint、build、typecheck、bundle 均通过。这些是本地验证结果，不替代 GitHub CI 或独立评审结论。

prs.title: feat(core): carry recent failed tool attempts into the compaction input
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Appends a bounded digest of recent failed tool calls to the compaction side-query's system instruction, with an explicit directive to carry those attempts and their failure reasons into the state snapshot. The digest scans the history being compressed for `functionResponse` parts carrying an error, takes the newest first, caps at 8 entries with 160-character error snippets, dedupes identical entries, and is omitted entirely when there are no recent failures.

## Why it's needed

Failed attempts live in the history being summarized, but whether the summary preserves them is the summarizer's discretion — post-compaction context can lose "what was tried and why it failed" and the model retries blindly (#17314). OpenAI Codex attaches executed-call metadata to compaction prompts (`executed_tool_calls.rs`), which is the design precedent.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/services/chatCompressionService.test.ts` — with a history containing a failed `write_file` response, the side-query's `systemInstruction` contains the digest header, the tool name, and the error snippet; with a clean history, no digest section is added. Full file: 190/190.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅    |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the digest adds up to ~1.5K chars to the compaction system prompt when failures exist; the side-query budget math already treats the system instruction as part of the payload, so the window guard accounts for it.
- Not validated / out of scope: no change to what the summarizer does with the directive (it remains a prompt-level instruction, same as custom/hook instructions); rejections recorded as plain user directives rather than functionResponse errors are already visible in the history.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.
- Design documents: N/A.

## Linked Issues

Closes #17314

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

本 PR 在压缩侧查询的 system instruction 末尾附加一段有界的"近期失败工具调用"摘要（最新在前、最多 8 条、错误截取 160 字符、去重），并明确指示摘要器把这些尝试与失败原因带进状态快照。无近期失败时完全不附加。

动机：失败尝试在被摘要的历史里，但摘要是否保留它们全凭摘要器裁量——压缩后"试过什么、为何失败"可能丢失，模型盲目重试（#17314）。OpenAI Codex 向压缩提示附加已执行调用元数据（executed_tool_calls.rs）是设计先例。

验证：含失败 write_file 响应的历史 → 侧查询 systemInstruction 含摘要头/工具名/错误片段；干净历史不附加。全文件 190/190。风险：失败存在时最多增加约 1.5K 字符，窗口守卫已把 system instruction 计入负载。关闭 #17314。

</details>
