prs.title: fix(cli): recognize CJK text and fullwidth punctuation around @-paths
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Enables `@` file and mention references to work naturally in Chinese and other CJK prose without requiring ASCII spaces around `@` or before fullwidth punctuation, across prompt submission, ACP `@ext:` / `@mcp:` mention extraction, and `@` autocomplete in both the Ink and OpenTUI composers.

Specifically, `@` path and mention parsing now terminates cleanly at fullwidth CJK punctuation (`，`, `。`, `、`, `；`, `：`, `！`, `？`, `（`, `）`, `【`, `】`, `「`, `」`, `『`, `』`, `《`, `》`, `［`, `］`, `｛`, `｝`) while continuing to support Chinese filenames like `@说明.md`, curly-apostrophe filenames like `@don’t.md`, and existing ASCII punctuation prefixes like `(@x.md)`. `@` command detection and both `@` completion triggers now recognize `@` immediately following CJK text or fullwidth punctuation, stop scanning at both fullwidth punctuation and whitespace (including ideographic space `U+3000`), and skip inserting an extra trailing ASCII space when accepting an `@` directory completion immediately before closing fullwidth punctuation (so directory completion inside `（@sr）` stays continuable as `（@src/）`, while regular file and slash completions still append a space to exit completion cleanly). Email addresses (`a.b@example.com`) and asset suffixes (`icon@2x.png`) remain untriggered.

## Why it's needed

When users write prompts in Chinese, typing `@` directly after Chinese characters (e.g. `请看@说明.md，解释一下`) or placing fullwidth punctuation directly after a path (e.g. `请看 @README.md，帮我解释` or `（@README.md）`) is standard everyday input. Previously, `@` command detection only accepted `@` at the start of input or after whitespace, and path/mention parsing only stopped at ASCII punctuation, causing both patterns to silently drop the referenced file or mention on submit and preventing `@` completion from working naturally in Chinese sentences.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In a workspace, create `README.md`, `说明.md`, and `x.md`.
2. Start the interactive CLI, type `请看 @README.md，帮我解释` and submit. Expect a `Read @README.md` card and the contents of `README.md` attached to the request.
3. Type `请看@说明.md，解释一下` and submit. Expect a `Read @说明.md` card and the contents of `说明.md` attached to the request.
4. Type `请看@READ` without submitting. Expect the `@` completion dropdown to suggest `README.md`.
5. Type `（@sr）` with the cursor right after `r` and accept a directory suggestion (e.g. `src/`). Expect `（@src/）` with no extra space before `）` so nested completion continues. Type `请看 @README.md，帮我` or `请看 @README.md　帮我` (fullwidth space) with the cursor at the end and expect `@` completion to stay closed.
6. Verify `a.b@example.com` and `icon@2x.png` still do not trigger `@` commands or completion, and that existing ASCII punctuation prefixes inside an `@` prompt (e.g. `请看@README.md，和(@x.md)`) continue to resolve `x.md` as before.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Real-terminal A/B verification on Windows 11 (ConPTY real-terminal harness against a local mock OpenAI server, checking both UI read cards and wire-level file payloads):

| Scenario | Before (`18ac669a3a`) | After (`540e87b59e`) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Control (`@README.md 总结`) | File content received, `✓ Read @README.md` shown | File content received, `✓ Read @README.md` shown |
| Fullwidth punctuation after `@file` (`请看 @README.md，帮我解释`) | File silently dropped (`received: false`, no read card) | File content received, `✓ Read @README.md` shown |
| CJK directly before `@` + Chinese filename (`请看@说明.md，解释一下`) | File silently dropped (`received: false`, no read card) | File content received, `✓ Read @说明.md` shown |
| CJK directly before `@` completion (`请看@READ`) | No completion suggestions shown | Dropdown suggests `README.md` |

| Scenario | Before (`18ac669a3a`) | After (`540e87b59e`) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `请看 @README.md，帮我解释` | ![before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Plastic-time/qwen-code/rrfz/pr-assets-at-cjk-delimiters/before-01-cjk-punct-after.png) | ![after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Plastic-time/qwen-code/rrfz/pr-assets-at-cjk-delimiters/after-01-cjk-punct-after.png) |
| `请看@说明.md，解释一下` | ![before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Plastic-time/qwen-code/rrfz/pr-assets-at-cjk-delimiters/before-02-cjk-before-at.png) | ![after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Plastic-time/qwen-code/rrfz/pr-assets-at-cjk-delimiters/after-02-cjk-before-at.png) |
| `请看@READ` | ![before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Plastic-time/qwen-code/rrfz/pr-assets-at-cjk-delimiters/before-03-cjk-before-at-completion.png) | ![after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Plastic-time/qwen-code/rrfz/pr-assets-at-cjk-delimiters/after-03-cjk-before-at-completion.png) |

Unit tests (run from `packages/cli`, the same 5 test files on both commits):

```
npx vitest run src/ui/utils/commandUtils.test.ts src/ui/hooks/atCommandProcessor.test.ts src/ui/hooks/useCommandCompletion.test.ts src/ui/opentui/input-prompt-model.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts
```

- Base `18ac669a3a` with this PR's test files: 5 files failed, 10 failed / 1909 passed / 16 skipped. All 10 failures are the new CJK cases.
- This PR `540e87b59e`: 5 files passed, 1919 passed / 16 skipped.
- `npm run build` and `npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli` exit 0. ESLint and Prettier (pre-commit) report no errors.
- The existing #4487 regression (`cici@192.168.0.160` must not open `@` completion) stays green: ASCII letters, digits and punctuation before `@` still do not trigger.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Windows 11 (`win32`), Node.js v24.20.0, base commit `18ac669a3a`, fix commit `540e87b59e`. Verified via `npm run build`, `tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli`, targeted Vitest suites, and interactive ConPTY A/B capture.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Scoped strictly to `packages/cli` with no changes to `packages/core`. `@` start scanning inside the parser is intentionally unchanged so existing ASCII punctuation prefixes (e.g. `(@x.md)`, `,@y.md`) keep their `main` behavior. Two known tradeoffs:
  1. `@` now triggers after CJK characters, so a Chinese name glued to an email domain such as `请发给张三@example.com` enters `@` handling. It behaves like `张三 @example.com` does on `main`: no file is read when `example.com` does not exist. The #4487 guard for ASCII prefixes (`cici@192.168.0.160`) is unchanged.
  2. Behavior change: a filename that itself contains fullwidth punctuation, such as `说明（一）.md`, resolves on `main` but is now split at `（`. The core path-escaping set does not cover fullwidth punctuation, so completion cannot escape it either. Extending that set is left for a follow-up if maintainers want it.
- Overlap with #18142: both PRs add an import line at the same spot in `atCommandProcessor.ts` and append tests at the end of `atCommandProcessor.test.ts`. Whichever merges second gets a small textual conflict there. The logic changes do not overlap.
- Not validated / out of scope: Native macOS/Linux terminal runs were not executed (delimiter and trigger rules are pure Unicode/regex logic with no OS-specific branches). OpenTUI was verified via unit tests on its completion detector and completion acceptance logic rather than an interactive OpenTUI terminal run. Input-box syntax highlighting for non-ASCII filenames (such as `@说明.md`) is unchanged and out of scope here (ASCII paths next to fullwidth punctuation already stop highlighting before `，`). The sibling `@` image-path scanner in the VS Code companion package is cross-package and left for a separate follow-up.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #18144

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次 PR 做了什么

让 `@` 文件与提及引用在中文及其他 CJK 语境中无需刻意加英文空格即可自然工作，覆盖消息提交、ACP `@ext:` / `@mcp:` 提及提取以及 Ink 和 OpenTUI 两个输入框的 `@` 自动补全。

具体而言，`@` 路径与提及解析现在会在全角 CJK 标点（`，`, `。`, `、`, `；`, `：`, `！`, `？`, `（`, `）`, `【`, `】`, `「`, `」`, `『`, `』`, `《`, `》`, `［`, `］`, `｛`, `｝`）处正常终止，同时继续支持中文文件名（如 `@说明.md`）、含弯撇号文件名（如 `@don’t.md`）以及既有的 ASCII 标点前缀（如 `(@x.md)`）。`@` 命令判定与两套 `@` 自动补全触发器现在也支持紧跟在 CJK 字符或全角标点后的 `@`，在全角标点与空白（含全角空格 `U+3000`）处停止扫描，并且在全角闭合标点前接受 `@` 目录补全时不额外追加英文空格（因此 `（@sr）` 接受目录后为 `（@src/）` 可继续嵌套补全，而普通文件与斜杠命令补全仍追加空格以便正常退出补全）。邮箱地址（`a.b@example.com`）与资源后缀（`icon@2x.png`）仍不会误触发。

## 为什么需要这个改动

中文用户写提示词时，直接在汉字后面接 `@`（例如 `请看@说明.md，解释一下`）或在 `@路径` 后直接打全角标点（例如 `请看 @README.md，帮我解释`、`（@README.md）`）是最常见的输入方式。此前 `@` 命令判定只认行首和空白后的 `@`，路径与提及解析也只在 ASCII 标点处断开，导致这两种日常写法都会在提交时静默丢弃文件或提及，且在中文句中无法自然触发或完成 `@` 补全。

## 评审测试方案

### 如何验证

1. 在工作区中创建 `README.md`、`说明.md` 和 `x.md`。
2. 启动交互式 CLI，输入 `请看 @README.md，帮我解释` 并提交。预期显示 `Read @README.md` 卡片，且请求附带 `README.md` 的内容。
3. 输入 `请看@说明.md，解释一下` 并提交。预期显示 `Read @说明.md` 卡片，且请求附带 `说明.md` 的内容。
4. 输入 `请看@READ` 但不提交。预期 `@` 补全下拉框弹出 `README.md`。
5. 输入 `（@sr）` 并将光标停在 `r` 后接受目录候选（如 `src/`），预期变为 `（@src/）` 且 `）` 前没有多余空格，可继续补全子文件；输入 `请看 @README.md，帮我` 或含全角空格的 `请看 @README.md　帮我` 且光标在末尾时，预期不弹出 `@` 补全。
6. 验证 `a.b@example.com` 与 `icon@2x.png` 仍不会触发 `@` 命令或补全，且同句包含合法 `@` 触发器时的既有 ASCII 标点前缀（如 `请看@README.md，和(@x.md)`）仍能照常解析 `x.md`。

### 验证证据（修复前 vs 修复后）

Windows 11 真终端 A/B 实测（使用 ConPTY 真终端测试框架配合本地 mock OpenAI 服务端，同时校验界面读取卡片与实际发送的文件内容）：

| 场景 | 修复前（`18ac669a3a`） | 修复后（`540e87b59e`） |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 对照组（`@README.md 总结`） | 收到文件内容，显示 `✓ Read @README.md` | 收到文件内容，显示 `✓ Read @README.md` |
| `@路径` 后紧跟全角标点（`请看 @README.md，帮我解释`） | 文件被静默丢弃（未收到内容，无读取卡片） | 收到文件内容，显示 `✓ Read @README.md` |
| 汉字直连 `@` 与中文文件名（`请看@说明.md，解释一下`） | 文件被静默丢弃（未收到内容，无读取卡片） | 收到文件内容，显示 `✓ Read @说明.md` |
| 汉字直连 `@` 触发补全（`请看@READ`） | 无补全候选 | 下拉列表提示 `README.md` |

单元测试（在 `packages/cli` 下跑，两个提交用同一组 5 个测试文件，命令见英文部分）：

- 基线 `18ac669a3a` 加本 PR 的测试文件：5 个文件失败，10 失败 / 1909 通过 / 16 跳过，失败的都是新加的 CJK 用例。
- 本 PR `540e87b59e`：5 个文件通过，1919 通过 / 16 跳过。
- `npm run build`、`npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli` 退出码 0，提交前的 ESLint 和 Prettier 无报错。
- 原有的 #4487 回归测试（`cici@192.168.0.160` 不能弹出 `@` 补全）仍然通过：`@` 前是 ASCII 字母、数字、标点时照旧不触发。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### 测试环境（可选）

Windows 11（`win32`），Node.js v24.20.0，基线提交 `18ac669a3a`，修复提交 `540e87b59e`。通过 `npm run build`、`tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli`、定向 Vitest 测试套件及 ConPTY 交互式 A/B 实测验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：改动严格限定在 `packages/cli`，不触碰 `packages/core`。解析器内部查找 `@` 起点的规则保持原样，确保既有的 ASCII 标点前缀（如 `(@x.md)`、`,@y.md`）保持 `main` 原有行为。已知两处权衡：
  1. 汉字后的 `@` 现在会触发，所以 `请发给张三@example.com` 会进入 `@` 处理，和 `main` 上 `张三 @example.com` 一样：没有 `example.com` 这个文件就不读。#4487 对 ASCII 前缀（`cici@192.168.0.160`）的保护不变。
  2. 行为变化：文件名本身带全角标点的（如 `说明（一）.md`），`main` 上能引用，本 PR 之后会在 `（` 处断开。核心层的路径转义字符集不含全角标点，补全也没法转义它。要不要扩展转义集留给维护者决定，另做。
- 和 #18142 的重叠：两个 PR 都在 `atCommandProcessor.ts` 同一位置加了一行 import，都在 `atCommandProcessor.test.ts` 末尾追加测试，后合的那个会有一处小的文本冲突。逻辑改动不重叠。
- 未验证与范围外事项：未在 macOS/Linux 真机上运行终端测试（分隔符与触发规则为纯 Unicode/正则逻辑，无操作系统分支）；OpenTUI 端通过补全检测与接受逻辑单元测试验证，未单独运行 OpenTUI 交互终端；输入框中非 ASCII 文件名（如 `@说明.md`）的语法高亮不在本 PR 范围内（ASCII 路径紧跟全角标点原本就已在 `，` 前停止高亮）；VS Code 伴随扩展包中另一份同源 `@` 图片路径解析器属跨包范围，留作后续单独处理。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无。

Fixes #18144

prs.title: feat(web-shell): keep touch composer editing bar single-row across phone and iPad
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR keeps the touch composer's top editing bar on a single compact row across phones and iPads while preserving all six editing controls (up, down, right/accept follow-up, slash, hide keyboard, and expand editor). Instead of forcing the editing keys onto a second wrapped line underneath workspace and Git controls, the composer adapts context placement to the composer container's actual inline width across three tiers:

- Wide touch layouts (560px and above, such as iPad landscape or wide split view) keep workspace selection, the full Git branch control, and all six editing keys together on one single row with ellipsis truncation.
- Medium touch layouts (420px to 559px, such as iPad narrow split view or foldables) keep workspace selection inline with truncation, collapse the Git control into its compact icon-and-status-dot form, and keep all six editing keys on the same single row.
- Narrow touch layouts (below 420px, such as phone portrait or iPad Slide Over) dedicate the top editing bar exclusively to the six editing keys on one row, and move workspace and Git context into a single non-wrapping strip below the composer while the input is blurred (automatically hiding while the soft keyboard is focused, and avoiding duplicate workspace controls when the session header already owns the workspace).

It also compacts the top editing row visually to 36px while preserving real hit areas, keeps Shell mode from adding extra controls to that row, and retains 44px targets for workspace/Git controls and the mobile bottom toolbar. Shell and history entries live in the Add drawer; hosts that explicitly omit Add keep those entries in the bottom toolbar instead. Long model/mode labels can still truncate smoothly.

## Why it's needed

On touch browsers, placing workspace/Git controls and a full-width editing-key group in the same wrapping container caused the upper area of the composer to occupy two (and sometimes three) vertical lines even on empty drafts. When a mobile soft keyboard opened, that header overhead consumed a large share of the remaining viewport height and hid conversation history. Keeping the six editing controls strictly single-row while letting iPad-sized widths retain inline workspace visibility significantly improves screen utilization on phones without sacrificing tablet ergonomics.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open Web Shell in a touch browser or Chromium mobile emulation (matching coarse pointer and no hover) on a new session with multiple workspaces and a Git repository.
2. prs.title: feat(web-shell): add pure Managed SessionChatController adapter core (slice 3a)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This increment starts slice 3 of the unified chat surface migration with a pure, dependency-injected Managed adapter for the shared chat contract. It projects Managed capabilities and session state into the common chat model, keeps transport admission separate from authoritative establishment, supports turn-scoped cancellation, history pagination, expiry filtering, duplicate-decision protection, and recovery states without importing daemon adapter implementation or translating between daemon and Java protocols.

The adapter carries pending permissions and questions into the shared renderers. Questions and options now retain their backend identifiers through the surface, so selected option ids and separately typed free text survive without decoding a comma-joined display string. The card tracks selection by its position within the question, making repeated labels and a label that equals another option's id independent. Existing hosts that do not provide a complete set of identifiers retain the original three-argument, text-answer submission. The legacy decoder normalizes comma boundaries consistently on both sides and still rejects duplicate-label or joined-label ambiguity. Required answers, single-select cardinality, unknown or repeated ids, text permissions, and the existing per-answer and total-payload size limits are enforced.

Settlement buffering now belongs to the attempt that needed it: actions only buffer while their own dispatch is awaiting transport, while operation and turn evidence records its dispatch sequence so a later retry cannot inherit an older outcome. The previously pinned case of an in-flight cancel whose submit shares its turn id still works. The linked design documents are synchronized in English and Chinese, including structured answers, attempt-scoped settlement, verification boundaries, and the remaining slices. The daemon controller regression noted during #18091 is retained as well.

## Why it's needed

Managed Agent and Daemon need one shared chat column rather than two independently maintained UIs. This slice supplies the Managed implementation of that common contract in small, testable terms before wiring it into the page. It also fixes two correctness failures found during review: an unrelated dispatch could make an older terminal settlement settle a later retry before that retry's own response arrived, and a selected option plus typed text matching another option's label could be sent as two choices even though the user selected only one. Typed text must not silently manufacture an authorization choice, and retried work must not inherit a previous attempt's terminal state.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run this exact suite from `packages/web-shell`. Confirm 14 test files and 404 tests pass, including the unmodified daemon adapter, the shared three-argument question-card behavior, the DOM-to-transport integration, stale-settlement retries, optional ambiguous questions, comma-boundary labels, and duplicate-label/id collisions:

```bash
cd packages/web-shell
npx vitest run client/components/managed/chat-capabilities.test.ts client/components/managed/chat-controller.test.ts client/components/managed/chat-controller.local-integration.test.tsx client/components/messages/AskUserQuestion.test.tsx client/chat-core/ client/i18n.test.ts client/i18n-loading.test.tsx client/daemon/useDaemonChatController.test.tsx client/daemon/chat-controller.test.ts client/daemon/chat-intents.test.ts client/daemon/permission-signals.test.ts client/adapters/transcriptAdapter.test.ts
npx tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit
npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
```

Both TypeScript projects exit 0 locally. The package build, repository-wide typecheck, and repository ESLint also complete; the local full-repository lint invocation excludes an unrelated, already git-ignored review checkout under `.claude/tmp`. The full `App.test.tsx` run also passed 1621 tests, covering the existing daemon host.

For an actual browser regression, this existing question-page test passed in Chromium against the local Vite page and its in-process mock daemon. Its reload, question expansion/collapse, and submission displays were checked in the captured screenshots:

```bash
cd packages/web-shell
PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=5183 npx playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=chromium client/e2e/web-shell.question-message.spec.ts
```

The Managed DOM integration verifies that selecting `Dry run` and typing `Verbose` produces `{ questionId: 'notes', optionIds: ['dry'], text: 'Verbose' }`, not a fabricated second option. It uses the actual shared surface, question card, and Managed controller with an explicit transport boundary. It does not claim a live Java provider connection, which belongs to slice 3b.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for a Managed page visual comparison because no production page is switched in this slice. The browser regression above exercises the existing daemon question page and confirms that its legacy render/submit behavior remains intact. The visual before/after gate for the Managed page belongs to slice 3c.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS with Node 22, repository Vitest/jsdom harnesses, TypeScript, and local Playwright Chromium. The browser daemon is mocked by the existing E2E fixture; it is not a production daemon or live Managed Agent Java service.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: shared questions now carry an optional structured answer alongside the original rendered string. The structured path is selected only when every question and every option has a backend id; incomplete legacy requests keep their original three-argument behavior. Legacy label decoding remains deliberately fail-closed on ambiguous inputs, even for optional questions.
- Not validated / out of scope: `useManagedSession`, `useManagedPendingActions`, and `ManagedAgentProvider` are not connected to the new controller yet (slice 3b), and `ManagedSessionsPage` is not switched (slice 3c). No live Java event stream or production Managed UI is claimed as verified. Teaching the card about `required`/`allowText` display behavior remains part of slice 3c; structured ids and independent free text are already present here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no Java route, OpenAPI, session-id namespace, storage-key, or daemon protocol change. The Managed adapter has no imports from the daemon chat adapter implementation. Design docs: [English](docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-chat-controller.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-chat-controller.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Part of #17460 (builds on #17520, #17684, #17709, #17794, #17895, #17952, #18066, #18091).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本增量启动统一聊天界面迁移的切片 3，为共享聊天契约落地纯依赖注入的 Managed 适配器。它把 Managed 能力与会话状态投影为公共聊天模型，区分传输准入与权威建立，支持回合作用域取消、历史分页、过期过滤、重复决策防护与恢复状态，不导入 daemon 适配器实现，也不进行 daemon 与 Java 的协议互转。

适配器把待审批与待提问投影到共享渲染器。问题与选项在表面传递过程中保留后端 id，使所选选项 id 与独立输入的自由文本无需从逗号拼接的展示串反解。卡片按选项在题目中的位置记录选择，同标签以及某选项标签等于另一选项 id 的情况均可独立选择。未提供完整 id 集合的既有宿主继续保持原三参数文本提交。旧解码器在比较两侧采用相同逗号边界规范化，并对重复标签与拼接歧义 fail-closed。必填答案、单选数量、未知或重复 id、文本权限及既有单答案与总载荷体积上限均被强制执行。

结算缓冲现在归属于需要它的尝试：action 仅在自身派发等待传输时缓冲，operation 与 turn 证据记录派发序号，防止后续重试继承旧终态。原先钉住的「共享 turn id 的 submit 仍在飞时，cancel 仍能收到结算」行为保持不变。互链的中英文设计文档已同步结构化答案、按尝试结算、验证边界与后续切片；#18091 留下的 daemon 控制器回归用例也一并保留。

## 为什么需要

Managed Agent 与 Daemon 应共用一套聊天列，而不是分别维护两套 UI。本切片在接入页面之前，以小且可测试的增量提供该公共契约的 Managed 实现，并修复评审发现的两类正确性问题：无关派发可能使旧终态结算提前结束稍后的重试；勾选一个选项再输入另一选项的标签，可能被上报为用户选择了两个选项。自由文本不得静默制造授权选择，重试也不得继承前次尝试的终态。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在 `packages/web-shell` 下运行以下完整套件。确认 14 个测试文件、404 项测试全部通过，覆盖未修改的 daemon 适配器、共享卡片原三参数行为、DOM 到传输的集成、旧结算后的重试、可选歧义题、逗号边界标签，以及重复标签和 id 碰撞：

```bash
cd packages/web-shell
npx vitest run client/components/managed/chat-capabilities.test.ts client/components/managed/chat-controller.test.ts client/components/managed/chat-controller.local-integration.test.tsx client/components/messages/AskUserQuestion.test.tsx client/chat-core/ client/i18n.test.ts client/i18n-loading.test.tsx client/daemon/useDaemonChatController.test.tsx client/daemon/chat-controller.test.ts client/daemon/chat-intents.test.ts client/daemon/permission-signals.test.ts client/adapters/transcriptAdapter.test.ts
npx tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit
npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
```

两个 TypeScript 项目在本地均退出 0。包构建、全仓 typecheck 与仓库 ESLint 也已通过；本机全仓 lint 命令排除了位于 `.claude/tmp` 且已被 git 忽略的无关评审工作副本。完整 `App.test.tsx` 的 1621 项测试也通过，覆盖了既有 daemon 宿主。

实际浏览器回归使用本地 Vite 页面与进程内 mock daemon，既有提问页测试在 Chromium 中通过；刷新、提问展开/折叠与提交后的展示均经捕获截图人工核对：

```bash
cd packages/web-shell
PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=5183 npx playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=chromium client/e2e/web-shell.question-message.spec.ts
```

Managed DOM 集成验证选择 `Dry run` 并输入 `Verbose` 会产生 `{ questionId: 'notes', optionIds: ['dry'], text: 'Verbose' }`，而不是伪造第二个选项。它使用真实共享表面、提问卡片和 Managed 控制器，并显式隔离传输边界。这里的传输不是切片 3b 才会接入的实时 Java provider。

### 证据（修改前后对比）

本切片没有切换生产 Managed 页面，因此 N/A 的 Managed 页面视觉前后对比。上述浏览器回归覆盖既有 daemon 提问页，确认原有渲染与提交行为保持不变；Managed 页面视觉前后对比门属于切片 3c。

### 已测试平台

|   操作系统   | 状态 |
| :----------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS    |  ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows   | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux    |  N/A  |

### 环境（可选）

macOS、Node 22、仓库 Vitest/jsdom 测试工具、TypeScript 与本地 Playwright Chromium。浏览器侧 daemon 由现有 E2E fixture mock，不是生产 daemon 或真实 Managed Agent Java 服务。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：共享提问在原有展示串之外增加可选结构化答案。仅当每道题及其每个选项都提供后端 id 时才走结构化路径；id 不完整的旧请求保留原三参数行为。旧标签解码对歧义输入仍严格 fail-closed，即使题目可选也不例外。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：`useManagedSession`、`useManagedPendingActions` 与 `ManagedAgentProvider` 尚未接入新控制器（切片 3b），`ManagedSessionsPage` 尚未切换（切片 3c）。不声称验证了真实 Java 事件流或生产 Managed UI。令卡片学习 `required`/`allowText` 的展示行为仍属切片 3c；结构化 id 与独立自由文本已在当前切片落地。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无 Java 路由、OpenAPI、会话 id 命名空间、存储键或 daemon 协议变更。Managed 适配器不导入 daemon 聊天适配器实现。设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-chat-controller.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-chat-controller.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

#17460 的一部分（基于 #17520、#17684、#17709、#17794、#17895、#17952、#18066、#18091）。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): accept single-line bracketed paste in /resume and /settings search boxes
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Enables single-line bracketed paste in the focused `/resume` and `/settings` search boxes through a shared paste-extraction helper.

When focus is inside the `/resume` search input or the `/settings` search box, unmodified single-line pastes (including ASCII, CJK, emoji, spaces, and a single copied line with at most one trailing CR/LF line ending) are sanitized via the shared single-line terminal sanitizer (stripping terminal escape sequences, C0/C1 control characters, and Unicode bidi override characters, flattening tabs to spaces) plus DEL removal, then appended to the current search query. Multi-line pastes (including trailing blank lines, VT/FF, and Unicode/C1 line separators), whitespace-only pastes, and empty/image/control-only pastes continue to be ignored. Handling paste events ahead of deletion and escape checks in both focused search handlers also prevents a pasted DEL byte or control-only paste from deleting existing query text or exiting search mode.

## Why it's needed

Users routinely copy keywords such as Chinese phrases, branch names, or setting names and paste them into `/resume` or `/settings` to filter quickly. Previously, the shared printable-character predicate rejected every paste event unconditionally to keep multi-line pastes from silently seeding a query from list mode, which left focused search boxes completely unresponsive to `Ctrl+V` / terminal paste even for a single word. Keeping list-mode implicit search entry rejecting pastes while handling sanitized single-line pastes in focused search boxes preserves the original multi-line safeguard and restores normal copy-paste search workflow.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open `/settings`, press `↑` to focus the `Search settings…` box, and paste a multi-line string (`line1\nline2`) via bracketed paste. Expect the search box to remain empty.
2. With the `/settings` search box still focused, paste a single-line keyword (such as `语言` or `vim mode`) via bracketed paste. Expect the search box to show the pasted query and filter the settings list accordingly.
3. With focus on the settings list (list mode), paste a normal keyword (such as `vim`) via bracketed paste. Expect focus to stay in the list without seeding the search query.
4. Create or have at least one session (for example containing `帮我重构登录模块`), open `/resume`, press `/` to enter search mode, paste a multi-line string (expect it to be ignored), then paste a single-line keyword (`登录`). Expect the pasted keyword to appear in the search input and filter matching sessions. Verify that pasting a keyword in `/resume` list mode still does not enter search mode.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Real-terminal A/B verification on Windows 11 (ConPTY real-terminal harness against a local mock OpenAI server, Chinese locale, default settings):

| Scenario | Before (`18ac669a3a`) | After (`febba8d63e`) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Control (`/settings` direct typing `语言`) | Query shown (`⌕ 语言`), settings list filtered | Query shown (`⌕ 语言`), settings list filtered |
| `/settings` search box multi-line paste (`line1\nline2`) | Rejected; search box stays empty | Rejected; search box stays empty |
| `/settings` search box single-line paste (`语言`) | Ignored; placeholder `⌕ Search settings…` remains | Query shown (`⌕ 语言`), settings list filtered |
| `/resume` search box multi-line paste (`line1\nline2`) | Rejected; search input stays empty | Rejected; search input stays empty |
| `/resume` search box single-line paste (`登录`) | Ignored; `Search: ▌` remains empty | Query shown (`Search: 登录▌`), matching session shown |

| Scenario | Before (`18ac669a3a`) | After (`febba8d63e`) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/settings` single-line paste | ![before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Plastic-time/qwen-code/rrfz/pr-assets-search-paste/before-01-settings-paste.png) | ![after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Plastic-time/qwen-code/rrfz/pr-assets-search-paste/after-01-settings-paste.png) |
| `/resume` single-line paste | ![before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Plastic-time/qwen-code/rrfz/pr-assets-search-paste/before-02-resume-paste.png) | ![after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Plastic-time/qwen-code/rrfz/pr-assets-search-paste/after-02-resume-paste.png) |

Unit and component tests (same 3 complete test files before and after):

```
npx vitest run src/ui/hooks/useSessionSearchInput.test.ts src/ui/hooks/useSessionPicker.test.tsx src/ui/components/SettingsDialog.test.tsx
```

- Before fix (`18ac669a3a` with added regression tests): 3 test files failed (9 failed, 114 passed; 123 total).
- After fix (`febba8d63e`): 3 test files passed (123 passed; 123 total), `npm run build` and `tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli` exited 0, and ESLint/Prettier passed with 0 warnings.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Windows 11 (`win32`), Node.js v24.20.0, base commit `18ac669a3a`, fix commit `febba8d63e`. Verified via `npm run build`, `tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli`, the 3 complete search/picker/settings Vitest suites, and interactive ConPTY A/B capture.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Scoped to the Ink CLI search-input hook and the Ink settings dialog focused search-box branch (5 files changed including tests, no changes to `packages/core`). List-mode implicit character search entry keeps rejecting bracketed pastes, and multi-line pastes remain rejected even in focused search boxes. Behavioral change to note: previously, pasting a raw DEL byte (`\x7f`) into a focused search box fell through to the raw-byte Backspace fallback and deleted a character (and in `/resume` exited search mode if the query became empty); handling paste events first now ignores control-only pastes without altering existing query text. Clean merge confirmed via `git merge-tree --write-tree` against open sibling PRs #18142, #18145, and #18153.
- Not validated / out of scope: Native macOS/Linux terminal runs were not executed (paste sanitization is pure string logic with no OS-specific branches). OpenTUI dialogs route bracketed pastes through a separate renderer paste hook rather than keyboard events, `/permissions` uses its own local search state, and pre-existing list-mode single-key branches (`/` in `/resume`, digits and raw deletion bytes in `/settings`) do not guard against `key.paste` on `main`; all of those are intentionally left out of scope for this PR.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #18160

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次 PR 做了什么

通过共用的粘贴提取函数，让已聚焦的 `/resume` 和 `/settings` 搜索框支持单行 bracketed paste 粘贴。

当焦点位于 `/resume` 搜索框或 `/settings` 搜索框时，未带修饰键的单行粘贴（支持 ASCII、中文、emoji、空格，以及最多带一个末尾 CR/LF 换行的单行复制）会经由仓库共用的单行终端净化函数清理（剥离终端转义序列、C0/C1 控制字符和 Unicode 双向覆盖字符，并将制表符折叠为空格）并移除 DEL 字节，再追加到当前搜索词中。多行粘贴（含末尾空行、VT/FF 以及 Unicode/C1 行分隔符）、纯空白粘贴、空粘贴/图片粘贴/纯控制字符粘贴继续保持忽略。两个聚焦搜索分支均先于删除键和 Esc 判断处理粘贴事件，避免粘贴 DEL 字节或纯控制字符时误删已有搜索词或退出搜索模式。

## 为什么需要这个改动

用户在 `/resume` 查找历史会话或在 `/settings` 过滤配置项时，经常复制中文关键词、分支名或配置项名称后按 `Ctrl+V` 粘贴。此前共用的可打印字符判断为了避免列表模式下多行粘贴静默变成搜索词，把所有粘贴事件一刀切拒绝，导致搜索框聚焦后连单个词也无法粘贴。在保持列表模式隐式字符搜索入口继续拒绝粘贴的同时，为聚焦搜索框补上经净化的单行粘贴处理，既保留原有防误触保护，又恢复正常的复制粘贴搜索体验。

## 评审测试方案

### 如何验证

1. 打开 `/settings`，按 `↑` 聚焦到 `Search settings…` 搜索框，通过 bracketed paste 粘贴多行文本（`line1\nline2`）。预期搜索框保持空白。
2. 保持 `/settings` 搜索框聚焦，粘贴单行关键词（例如 `语言` 或 `vim mode`）。预期搜索框显示粘贴的关键词并过滤设置列表。
3. 焦点停留在设置列表（列表模式）时粘贴普通关键词（例如 `vim`）。预期焦点留在列表且不写入搜索框。
4. 先有一条历史会话（例如包含 `帮我重构登录模块`），打开 `/resume`，按 `/` 进入搜索模式，先粘贴多行文本（预期被忽略），再粘贴单行关键词 `登录`。预期搜索框显示 `登录` 并过滤出匹配会话；在 `/resume` 列表模式粘贴关键词则仍不进入搜索模式。

### 验证证据（修复前 vs 修复后）

Windows 11 真终端 A/B 实测（使用 ConPTY 真终端测试框架配合本地 mock OpenAI 服务端，中文界面、默认设置）：

| 场景 | 修复前（`18ac669a3a`） | 修复后（`febba8d63e`） |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 对照组（`/settings` 直接输入 `语言`） | 显示 `⌕ 语言` 并过滤设置列表 | 显示 `⌕ 语言` 并过滤设置列表 |
| `/settings` 搜索框多行粘贴（`line1\nline2`） | 拒绝；搜索框保持空白 | 拒绝；搜索框保持空白 |
| `/settings` 搜索框单行粘贴（`语言`） | 忽略；仍显示占位符 `⌕ Search settings…` | 显示 `⌕ 语言` 并过滤设置列表 |
| `/resume` 搜索框多行粘贴（`line1\nline2`） | 拒绝；搜索框保持空白 | 拒绝；搜索框保持空白 |
| `/resume` 搜索框单行粘贴（`登录`） | 忽略；`Search: ▌` 保持空白 | 显示 `Search: 登录▌` 并展示匹配会话 |

单元测试与组件测试（修复前后运行完全相同的 3 个完整测试文件）：

- 修复前（基线 `18ac669a3a` 运行新增回归测试）：3 个测试文件失败（9 项失败，114 项通过，共 123 项）。
- 修复后（`febba8d63e`）：3 个测试文件全部通过（123 项通过，共 123 项），`npm run build` 与 `tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli` 退出码均为 0，ESLint 与 Prettier 0 告警通过。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### 测试环境（可选）

Windows 11（`win32`），Node.js v24.20.0，基线提交 `18ac669a3a`，修复提交 `febba8d63e`。通过 `npm run build`、`tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli`、3 个完整搜索/会话选择/设置对话框 Vitest 测试套件及 ConPTY 交互式 A/B 实测验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：改动限定在 Ink CLI 共用搜索输入 hook 与 Ink 设置对话框聚焦搜索框分支（含测试共改 5 个文件，不涉及 `packages/core`）。列表模式隐式字符搜索入口保持拒绝 bracketed paste，多行粘贴在聚焦搜索框中仍被拒绝。需说明的行为变化：此前在聚焦搜索框中粘贴裸 DEL 字节（`\x7f`）会落入退格字节回退分支并删掉一个字符（在 `/resume` 中若删空还会触发退出搜索模式）；改为优先处理粘贴事件后，纯控制字符粘贴会被忽略而不再修改已有搜索词。经 `git merge-tree --write-tree` 核实，本分支与开放的兄弟 PR #18142、#18145、#18153 均可干净合并。
- 未验证与范围外事项：未在 macOS/Linux 真机上运行终端测试（粘贴文本净化为纯字符串逻辑，无操作系统分支）。OpenTUI 对话框通过独立的渲染器粘贴 hook 接收粘贴而非键盘事件，`/permissions` 维护独立搜索状态，且 `main` 上列表模式若干单键分支（`/resume` 的 `/`、`/settings` 的数字键与退格字节分支）原本未拦截 `key.paste`；以上均留在本 PR 范围之外。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #18160

</details>

prs.title: feat(generated-ui): let a click copy or download through the host
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Lets a Generated UI card copy text and download a small text file from a click, with Web Shell performing both outside the card. This is step 1 of the copy and download half of stage 8 in #14019; step 2 teaches the skill and flips the two acceptance checks.

- **Card API.** Cards gain `ui.copy(text)` and `ui.download(filename, mimeType, text)`. They work only while a click handler runs (its promise chain included), once per round. A wrong type, an empty value or an unsupported MIME type throws a `TypeError`, a value over its limit a `RangeError`, and a call outside a click or a second one in the round an `Error`; like saved state, the card can catch all of them. A call during initialization therefore throws, and the pre-display check reports an uncaught one as `VIEW_ERROR`.
- **Which clicks run.** The App performs a round's effect only when its own request for that round was a click and the round applied to the current input values. A round with no patches counts, which is the usual case for a copy or export button. When the values changed while the round ran, nothing is copied or downloaded and the card says so and asks for another click. This differs from saved state on purpose: a copy or export of values the user no longer sees would be wrong.
- **Host.** Web Shell performs both for the bundled card only, never in the transcript view, and never for a hidden card. It validates every request itself. Copy is a private request with at most 16 KiB of text. Download is the standard MCP Apps download request with exactly one embedded text resource of at most 64 KiB, one of CSV, plain text, JSON and Markdown; links and binary content are refused, and the file name is sanitized and given the extension of its type. The App adds that extension too, so another host that implements the standard request cannot save the text under a different type. One effect runs at a time per card.
- **Outcome and fallback.** The bar above the card shows each outcome (copied, download started, not copied) on its own attribute with an increasing count, so a repeated outcome is still a new observation and the save status is unaffected. When the browser refuses the clipboard write, for example because the click's activation expired while the round was queued, the bar keeps the text and shows its own Copy button, which copies on its own click.
- **Design.** A new design document in English and Chinese covers the API, the round rule, the wire contract, host validation, limits, risks and the rollout.

## Why it's needed

The #14019 acceptance evaluation (#16811) fails `bill.copies-current` and `comparator.exports-current-csv` with both the reference documents and the gating model: a card's JavaScript runs in a Worker without clipboard or download access, and its frame's sandbox allows neither. After persistent view state (#17448, #17522, #17922), these two and extending an earlier card are the only checks that still fail, and all three belong to stage 8. Copy and download come first; card revisions follow.

Design: [English](https://github.com/qqqys/qwen-code/blob/feat/generated-ui-copy-download/docs/design/generated-ui-copy-download.md) · [中文](https://github.com/qqqys/qwen-code/blob/feat/generated-ui-copy-download/docs/design/generated-ui-copy-download.zh-CN.md)

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- In Web Shell with Generated UI enabled, show a card whose button calls `ui.copy` with a value from an input. Click it: the bar above the card says the text was copied, and pasting gives the current value. Change the input and click again: the new value is copied and the bar shows a fresh outcome.
- Show a card whose button calls `ui.download('plans', 'text/csv', …)`. Click it: a `plans.csv` download starts and the bar names it.
- Block clipboard writes for the page (for example revoke the site's clipboard permission) and click copy: the bar says the browser blocked the copy and offers Copy. Allow writes and click it: the text is copied and the button goes away.
- Call `ui.copy` during initialization: the tool returns a `VIEW_ERROR` naming the call. Call it from an input handler inside `try`: the card catches an error and nothing is copied.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The bar above the card after a copy, next to the save status, and after the browser refused the write, with the bar's own Copy button (real daemon, Chromium):

![Copied](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/b0a4ff099e7e4eed7d5e565ae2c63135d7b19a69/copied.png)

![Copy blocked, with the bar's Copy button](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/b0a4ff099e7e4eed7d5e565ae2c63135d7b19a69/copy-pending.png)

Browser check on a real daemon with a hand-written card, Chromium, through the bundled CLI:

| Step | Outcome shown | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Copy with the initial value | `copied`, count 1 | clipboard `Total: 12.30` |
| Edit the value, copy again | `copied`, count 2 | clipboard `Total: 15.00` |
| Export | `downloaded`, count 3, "Download started: plans.csv" | `plans.csv` with the current value |
| Clipboard permission revoked, copy | `copy-pending`, count 4, Copy button shown | nothing copied |
| Permission granted, the bar's Copy | `copied`, count 5, button gone | clipboard `Total: 16.00` |

A separate experiment with the same frame nesting across three origins measured the click's activation: WebKit allowed the clipboard write after a click with a 300 ms relay delay and refused it after 1.2 s or without a click, which is why the bar offers its own Copy button. Headless Chromium refuses writes without a granted permission, so its activation rule was not measured.

Locally: all generated-ui App tests plus the pre-display check, contract and packed MCP tests 300/300; Web Shell host module, card, retained runtime, transcript, artifact and i18n tests 307/307; both packages typecheck clean; the opt-in acceptance replay passes 4/4 with every pin unchanged. The App bundle is 976,762 bytes, under its 1 MiB limit.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux, Node 22, bundled CLI, real daemon, Playwright Chromium; WebKit for the activation experiment.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: generated code can now replace the user's clipboard and start downloads. Only a click can, once per click, with text from the card's current values, text-only files with a forced extension and size caps, and the host shows every outcome.
- Not validated / out of scope: whether a real Chrome needs the bar's Copy button (headless Chromium refused the write without a granted permission even after a real click, so the activation rule there is unmeasured); WebKit on the real daemon, where Playwright input reached neither the view nor the App, so only the activation experiment covers WebKit; Firefox, Safari and the desktop app; macOS and Windows; the skill, the reference documents and the two acceptance pins (step 2); copy or download for other MCP Apps.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The bundled card now advertises the standard download capability and a private copy capability.

## Linked Issues

Part of #14019.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

让 Generated UI 卡片在点击时复制文本、下载小的文本文件，由 Web Shell 在卡片外执行这两个动作。这是 #14019 阶段 8 中复制与下载这一半的第 1 步；第 2 步会在 skill 里教这两个调用，并翻转两项验收检查。

- **卡片 API。** 卡片新增 `ui.copy(text)` 和 `ui.download(filename, mimeType, text)`。它们只在点击处理函数运行期间可用（包括它返回的 promise 链），每轮一次。类型错误、空值或不支持的 MIME 类型抛出 `TypeError`，超过限制抛出 `RangeError`，不在点击中调用或同一轮第二次调用抛出 `Error`；和保存的状态一样，卡片都可以捕获。因此初始化时调用会抛错，显示前检查会把未捕获的调用报告为 `VIEW_ERROR`。
- **哪些点击会执行。** 只有当 App 为这一轮发出的请求是点击、并且这一轮应用在当前输入值上时，App 才执行这一轮的动作。没有补丁的轮次也算，复制或导出按钮通常就是这样。如果这一轮运行期间值变了，就不复制也不下载，卡片会说明原因并请用户再点一次。这和保存的状态有意不同：复制或导出用户已经看不到的值是错的。
- **宿主。** Web Shell 只为内置卡片执行这两个动作，转录视图和隐藏的卡片都不行。它自己校验每个请求。复制是一个私有请求，文本最多 16 KiB。下载是标准 MCP Apps 下载请求，只能带一个最多 64 KiB 的内嵌文本资源，类型只能是 CSV、纯文本、JSON 或 Markdown；链接和二进制内容会被拒绝，文件名会被清理并按类型设置扩展名。App 也会加上这个扩展名，所以其他实现了标准请求的宿主也无法把文本存成别的类型。每张卡片同一时间只执行一个动作。
- **结果与兜底。** 卡片上方的栏在独立的属性上显示每次结果（已复制、已开始下载、未复制），并带一个递增的计数，所以重复的结果也是一次新的观测，保存状态不受影响。当浏览器拒绝写剪贴板时（例如轮次排队期间点击带来的激活已经过期），宿主栏保留这段文本并显示自己的“复制”按钮，点击它时在这次点击里完成复制。
- **设计。** 新增中英文设计文档，覆盖 API、轮次规则、线路契约、宿主校验、限制、风险和推进步骤。

## 为什么需要

#14019 的验收评测（#16811）中，`bill.copies-current` 和 `comparator.exports-current-csv` 在参考文档和 gating 模型下都失败：卡片的 JavaScript 运行在没有剪贴板和下载能力的 Worker 里，卡片帧的 sandbox 也不允许这两者。持久视图状态（#17448、#17522、#17922）完成后，只剩这两项和扩展前一张卡片还失败，三项都属于阶段 8。先做复制和下载，卡片修订随后。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/qqqys/qwen-code/blob/feat/generated-ui-copy-download/docs/design/generated-ui-copy-download.md) · [中文](https://github.com/qqqys/qwen-code/blob/feat/generated-ui-copy-download/docs/design/generated-ui-copy-download.zh-CN.md)

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 在开启 Generated UI 的 Web Shell 中显示一张卡片，它的按钮用 `ui.copy` 复制一个输入框里的值。点击后，卡片上方的栏显示已复制，粘贴得到当前值。修改输入后再点一次：复制的是新值，栏里显示一次新的结果。
- 显示一张按钮调用 `ui.download('plans', 'text/csv', …)` 的卡片。点击后开始下载 `plans.csv`，栏里显示文件名。
- 禁止页面写剪贴板（例如撤销站点的剪贴板权限）后点击复制：栏里显示浏览器阻止了复制，并提供“复制”按钮。允许写入后点击它：文本被复制，按钮消失。
- 在初始化时调用 `ui.copy`：工具返回指明这个调用的 `VIEW_ERROR`。在 input 处理函数里用 `try` 调用：卡片捕获到错误，什么都没有复制。

### 证据

复制后的宿主栏（与保存状态并排），以及浏览器拒绝写入后带“复制”按钮的宿主栏（真实 daemon，Chromium）：

![已复制](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/b0a4ff099e7e4eed7d5e565ae2c63135d7b19a69/copied.png)

![复制被阻止，宿主栏提供复制按钮](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/b0a4ff099e7e4eed7d5e565ae2c63135d7b19a69/copy-pending.png)

在真实 daemon 上用手写卡片做的浏览器检查，Chromium，通过打包的 CLI：

| 步骤 | 显示的结果 | 实际效果 |
|---|---|---|
| 用初始值复制 | `copied`，计数 1 | 剪贴板 `Total: 12.30` |
| 修改值后再复制 | `copied`，计数 2 | 剪贴板 `Total: 15.00` |
| 导出 | `downloaded`，计数 3，“Download started: plans.csv” | 带当前值的 `plans.csv` |
| 撤销剪贴板权限后复制 | `copy-pending`，计数 4，显示“复制”按钮 | 没有复制 |
| 授予权限后点宿主栏的“复制” | `copied`，计数 5，按钮消失 | 剪贴板 `Total: 16.00` |

另一个实验用同样的帧嵌套、跨三个 origin，测量了点击带来的激活：WebKit 在点击后经过 300 ms 的中转延迟仍允许写剪贴板，延迟 1.2 s 或没有点击时则拒绝，所以宿主栏提供了自己的“复制”按钮。无头 Chromium 在没有授予权限时拒绝写入，所以没有测出它的激活规则。

本地：generated-ui 全部 App 测试以及显示前检查、契约和打包后的 MCP 测试 300/300；Web Shell 的宿主模块、卡片、保留运行时、转录、产物和 i18n 测试 307/307；两个包类型检查都通过；需手动开启的验收 replay 4/4 通过，所有固定项不变。App 包体积 976,762 字节，低于 1 MiB 上限。

### 测试平台

Linux ✅；macOS、Windows ⚠️ 未测试。

### 环境

Linux、Node 22、打包的 CLI、真实 daemon、Playwright Chromium；激活实验用了 WebKit。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：生成的代码现在可以替换用户的剪贴板并开始下载。只有点击能触发，每次点击一次，内容来自卡片当前的值；文件只能是文本，扩展名被强制设置，大小有上限；宿主显示每次结果。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：真实 Chrome 是否需要宿主栏的“复制”按钮（无头 Chromium 在没有授予权限时，即使真实点击也拒绝写入，所以那里的激活规则没有测出）；真实 daemon 上的 WebKit，那里 Playwright 的输入既没有到达视图也没有到达 App，所以 WebKit 只由激活实验覆盖；Firefox、Safari 和桌面应用；macOS 和 Windows；skill、参考文档和两项验收固定项（第 2 步）；其他 MCP App 的复制或下载。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。内置卡片现在会声明标准下载 capability 和一个私有复制 capability。

## 关联 Issue

Part of #14019.

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): prevent iOS focus zoom in portaled inputs
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Moves the 16px focus-zoom rule for Safari on coarse-pointer devices into the shared Web Shell stylesheet. The rule covers text inputs (including inputs without an explicit type), textareas, editable content, and the composer. It applies inside the shell and its dialog portal, including a Shadow DOM portal. The model picker keeps its explicit touch sizing for non-WebKit browsers.

## Why it's needed

At landscape tablet widths, responsive input styles can drop to 14px. Safari can zoom the page when such an input gets focus. The previous fix lived in standalone CSS and only matched descendants of `#root`, so it missed dialogs portaled outside that root and did not load in an embedded shell. #17892 fixed one model-picker field, not the shared case.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

From the repository root, run `npm run test:e2e --workspace=packages/web-shell -- web-shell.touch-input-font.mobile.spec.ts --project=mobile-webkit --project=mobile-chromium` with Playwright browsers installed. At 1024×768, the test exercises Skill Install and Add Runtime fields in standalone-style and embedded-style fixtures, with both document and Shadow DOM portals. Expect 16px for covered touch fields and the existing 14px size for desktop or host-page controls. If a runner browser lacks Safari’s specific feature gate (including Linux Playwright WebKit), the test annotates that case and emulates only the feature gate, leaving the pointer media query, selectors and declarations unchanged. The desktop control explicitly disables mobile and touch emulation.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The issue records 14px computed text inputs before the fix in Chromium touch emulation. Locally, the Vite transcript and focused fixture builds passed. The generated CSS contract passed with the rule present and failed when the rule was removed from the built artifact. Targeted ESLint, Prettier and `git diff --check` passed. No before/after browser recording is available.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Build, generated CSS contract and mutation check; browser not verified |

### Environment (optional)

Local Linux with Vite and the package test tools. Chromium could not open a required socket on the host; WebKit was not available locally.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: The rule intentionally overrides compact text sizing only inside Web Shell roots in the guarded touch scenario. Host inputs, desktop sizing, and the model picker’s non-WebKit sizing are preserved.
- Not validated / out of scope: Local browser computed-style cases and native iOS Safari focus zoom have not been verified. No physical device or software keyboard test was run.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None expected; no API or configuration changes.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17933.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

把粗指针设备上 Safari 防止聚焦缩放的 16px 规则移到 Web Shell 共享样式。规则覆盖文本输入框（包括未声明 type 的输入框）、多行文本框、可编辑内容和编辑器，作用于 Shell 本体及弹窗 Portal，包括 Shadow DOM 中的 Portal。模型选择器保留了非 WebKit 浏览器上的显式触控字号。

## 为什么需要

平板横屏宽度可能触发字号降到 14px 的响应式样式，Safari 在这些输入框聚焦时可能放大页面。原规则只在独立入口加载，也只匹配 `#root` 的后代，因此会漏掉根节点外的弹窗，也不会在嵌入版加载。#17892 只修了模型选择器的一个输入框，没有修通用场景。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

安装 Playwright 浏览器后，在仓库根目录运行 `npm run test:e2e --workspace=packages/web-shell -- web-shell.touch-input-font.mobile.spec.ts --project=mobile-webkit --project=mobile-chromium`。用例以 1024×768 覆盖「安装技能」「添加运行时」弹窗，分别使用独立版和嵌入版的样式，并覆盖文档 Portal 和 Shadow DOM Portal。受保护的触屏输入应显示为 16px；桌面或宿主页面上的输入框应仍是 14px。当运行环境缺少 Safari 专属特性（包括 Linux 上的 Playwright WebKit）时，用例会注明并仅模拟该特性检查，不改指针媒体条件、选择器或声明。桌面对照组明确关闭移动与触控模拟。

### 证据（修改前 / 修改后）

Issue 记录了修复前在 Chromium 触控模拟下的 14px 计算字号。本地 Vite 转录构建和针对性测试页面构建通过。产物样式检查在规则存在时通过，删除构建产物中的规则后按预期失败。受影响文件的 ESLint、Prettier 和 `git diff --check` 通过。尚无浏览器修改前后录像。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 构建、产物样式和删除规则变异检查通过；未验证浏览器 |

### 环境（可选）

本地 Linux、Vite 和仓库测试工具。主机禁止 Chromium 打开所需的 socket，本地无可用 WebKit。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：规则只在指定触控场景下覆盖 Web Shell 根内的紧凑字号；宿主输入框、桌面样式和模型选择器在非 WebKit 上的字号保留。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：尚未在本地浏览器验证计算字号，也尚未验证原生 iOS Safari 的聚焦缩放。未跑真机或软键盘测试。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：预计没有；无 API 或配置修改。

## 关联 Issue

修复 #17933。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): surface and control session scheduled tasks in-session
prs.body:
## TLDR

Surface both session-bound durable scheduled tasks and live in-memory session schedules (recurring cron jobs and self-paced loop wakeups) directly inside the Web Shell conversation view, with inline pause, run-now, delete, and stop controls.

## Dive Deeper

Previously, once a conversation had a bound durable scheduled task or created an in-session cron job or self-paced loop wakeup, Web Shell gave no persistent in-conversation indicator that the session would keep waking up, and no direct way to inspect or stop session-scoped schedules without scrolling back to an older creation turn or typing a slash command.

This change closes both the protocol gap and the in-session UI gap in one pass:

- **Live session-scoped schedule status and cancellation**: The daemon's existing session tasks status snapshot now carries active in-memory session-scoped cron jobs and pending loop wakeups (including projected next-fire timestamps, expiry, and optional gate info) without mixing them into the background process list or exposing durable tasks there. The existing session task cancel endpoint now accepts cancelling session-scoped cron/wakeup entries while explicitly refusing durable tasks so persistent schedules stay managed through their dedicated routes.
- **Persistent conversation header entry**: Whenever the active conversation has at least one bound durable task or active session-scoped schedule, a calendar-clock entry appears in the conversation header showing either the next-fire countdown (for a single active schedule) or the count, styled muted when all schedules are paused. Clicking it opens the right-hand environment panel directly to the scheduled tasks section.
- **Inline Environment Panel management**: A dedicated Scheduled Tasks section in the environment panel lists all schedules attached to the conversation, clearly tagged as Persistent, Session, or Loop, with human-readable cadence, live next-run countdowns, and inline actions to enable/disable, run now, delete, stop session-scoped schedules, open the detail panel, or jump to the full Scheduled Tasks page. Durable queries remain strictly scoped to the active workspace without falling back to the primary workspace.
- **Composer activity chip & turn/detail sync**: Active session-scoped schedules surface as a compact chip above the composer (matching the existing background task chips) so users immediately know the session is still armed to wake up. Historical creation cards in the transcript reflect live active, paused, or cancelled status, and the detail panel now lets users stop active session-scoped tasks directly instead of showing a read-only snapshot.

### Dark Theme

![Web Shell session scheduled tasks in dark theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/session-scheduled-tasks/assets/session-scheduled-tasks/session-scheduled-tasks-dark.png)

### Light Theme

![Web Shell session scheduled tasks in light theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/session-scheduled-tasks/assets/session-scheduled-tasks/session-scheduled-tasks-light.png)

### Narrow Chromium Viewport (430 px)

The scheduled entry stays reachable as the environment layout folds; clicking it opens the floating scheduled-tasks section.

![Session scheduled tasks in a narrow Chromium viewport](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/session-scheduled-tasks/assets/session-scheduled-tasks/session-scheduled-tasks-narrow-chromium.png)

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 概要

在 Web Shell 对话界面内直接展示并控制当前会话的定时任务，统一覆盖绑定到当前会话的持久化定时任务与会话内存中运行的临时 cron / 自驱循环唤醒任务。

### 改动说明

此前，当会话绑定了持久化定时任务或通过工具创建了会话级 cron / 循环唤醒后，Web Shell 对话界面没有常驻状态提示，用户既不容易察觉会话还会继续自动唤醒，也无法就地停掉会话级循环。

本次改动同步补齐了协议能力与会话内界面展示：

- **会话级定时任务状态与取消接口**：复用现有会话任务快照接口返回当前会话内存中活跃的会话级 cron 与待触发循环唤醒（含下次触发时间投影、过期时间与可选 Gate），不混入原有后台任务列表，也不掺杂持久化任务；复用现有会话任务取消接口支持按 `cron` 类型取消会话级任务，并明确拒绝通过该接口取消持久化任务。
- **会话顶部栏常驻入口**：当当前会话存在至少一条关联定时任务时，顶部栏显示日历时钟入口；单条活跃任务展示下次触发倒计时，多条展示总数，全部暂停时置灰；点击后打开右侧环境面板并定位到定时任务分区。
- **右侧环境面板「定时任务」分区**：区分标注「持久化」「仅当前会话」「循环唤醒」，展示人类可读频率、实时倒计时与就地操作（启停、立即运行、删除、停止会话任务、打开详情/编辑、跳转管理全部）。持久化任务查询严格限定在当前会话所属工作区，不会回退到主工作区。
- **输入框上方活跃芯片与详情同步**：当存在活跃会话级 cron 或循环唤醒时，在输入框上方任务芯片栏显示活跃定时任务芯片，提醒用户会话仍在等待自动唤醒；对话轮次里的创建卡片同步展示运行中/已暂停/已取消实时状态；右侧详情面板也支持直接停止活跃的会话级任务。

#### 暗色主题

![Web Shell 会话定时任务暗色主题截图](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/session-scheduled-tasks/assets/session-scheduled-tasks/session-scheduled-tasks-dark.png)

#### 亮色主题

![Web Shell 会话定时任务亮色主题截图](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/session-scheduled-tasks/assets/session-scheduled-tasks/session-scheduled-tasks-light.png)

#### 窄屏 Chromium 视口（430px）

窄屏下环境面板按响应式布局收起后，顶部定时任务入口仍然可达；点击入口即可打开浮层中的调度任务分区。

![Web Shell 窄屏定时任务浮层截图](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/session-scheduled-tasks/assets/session-scheduled-tasks/session-scheduled-tasks-narrow-chromium.png)

</details>

## Reviewer Test Plan

- **Header entry and Environment Panel listing**: Open a Web Shell conversation that has a bound persistent scheduled task and at least one in-session cron job or loop wakeup. Confirm the calendar-clock entry appears in the conversation header with the total count (or live countdown for a single active task), and clicking it opens the Environment Panel to the Scheduled Tasks section with Persistent, Session, and Loop tags.
- **Inline stop for session-scoped schedules**: Click the stop action on an active session-scoped cron job or loop wakeup from either the Environment Panel or the detail panel opened from a turn card. Confirm the task disappears from the list, the header count decrements, the composer scheduled chip updates or disappears, and the turn card updates to Cancelled.
- **Inline controls for persistent tasks**: Click pause/enable, run now, or delete on a session-bound persistent task in the Environment Panel. Confirm paused tasks dim immediately and the header entry switches to a muted paused state when no active schedules remain.
- **Safety boundary**: Attempt to cancel a durable scheduled task through the session-scoped cron cancel endpoint and verify it is refused rather than deleting the persistent schedule.

## Testing Matrix

|          | 🍏  | 🪟  | 🐧  |
| -------- | --- | --- | --- |
| npm run  | ❓  | ❓  | ✅  |
| npx      | ❓  | ❓  | ❓  |
| Docker   | ❓  | ❓  | ❓  |
| Podman   | ❓  | ❓  | ❓  |
| Seatbelt | ❓  | ❓  | ❓  |

## Linked issues / bugs

None.

prs.title: test(managed-agent): execute the loop classifier decision instead of scanning it
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Moves the whole managed-loop classifier side-query decision out of the two fake-model callbacks and into one top-level pure function that the fast meta-test executes directly. Each arm now delegates to it with its own call id and returns the result under an undefined guard, falling through exactly as before when the request is not a block-schema side query. The hand-rolled AST scanner that used to inventory the decision's shape — its bindings, gates, answer sites, allow constructions and every write form — is retired along with the hostile control that existed only to prove that scanner non-vacuous. In its place are an executed test that drives the decision against hostile request bodies and asserts the whole response, and one bounded structural pin on the delegation itself, judged by a single named-clause predicate that a hostile-source control exercises clause by clause. That pin now judges **placement only** — where the delegation sits and that nothing answers beside it. Three review rounds found 6, then 6, then 11 shapes, each round's fixes producing the next round's findings, and the undirected audit named the cause: recognising provenance, gates, rebindings and fall-through by AST is hand-written semantic analysis over an unbounded rewrite space, the same treadmill this change ends for the decision re-entered one level up. So the data-flow clauses are retired by decision, the design record enumerates every one of them with a measured example, and the packaged arms own that behaviour.

## Why it's needed

The seam used to be drawn at the schema properties, so the lookup, the narrowing, the gate and the answer site all stayed inline in each fake and the only thing a fast test could assert about them was their shape. That surface is unbounded by construction: any way of writing the same value or emitting the same answer without the spelling the scanner looks for defeats it. Fourteen review rounds on the preceding pin-closing work were largely spent extending the scanner after a newly measured sibling evaded it — a shorthand key, an allow whose value is a binding initialised to false, rest-destructuring writes, parenthesized and cast assignment targets, for-of and for-in initializers — and each closure was another inventory keyed on another spelling. The documented residual was that an allow computed as a negation or a boolean coercion spells no false at all, so no inventory of spellings can see it. Executing the decision ends that family instead of patching it again. Two smaller costs go with it: the two arms carried byte-identical decision blocks apart from the call id, so a fix could reach one arm and miss the other, and the scanner's own non-vacuity had to be proven by a fixture that had grown to twenty-one write shapes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the scripts meta suites and the core parity suite; both are green. Then confirm the placement pin is not vacuous: weakening any single clause — the id set, the distinct-callback count, either half of the arm scoping, the one-fake-per-arm count, the argument provenance, either answer-inventory clause or any of its disjuncts, the inventory's walk through nested functions, or any of the four function-boundary kinds — reddens the hostile-source control on exactly the clause weakened. The behaviour-preserving rewrites are positive controls: arm order, id exchange, every gate spelling, an arrow-const decision, a legitimate third fake and a legitimate cron answer must all stay green. On the decision itself, an additive fallback, a fabricated schema, a dropped gate or a hard-coded call id each redden the executed test, while a hand-built object of the same value deliberately does not — the executed test pins the response value, so an identical value is not a defect.

The strongest behaviour-preservation evidence is an equivalence A/B: each arm's pre-change inline decision was sliced from the base commit and driven over the same fourteen hostile bodies as the new function, for twenty-eight comparisons, all identical. A type A/B over the base and changed runner under one configuration gives the same error count with zero introduced and zero removed. Both packaged managed-loop arms were re-run after a full rebuild and are green, with the fire arm's scheduled/fired/completed witness and a fresh occurrence key.

Two reds appeared during verification and both were attributed to stale artifacts rather than to this change; neither failed run is counted as a pass. A build failure came from a dependency the base had added but this worktree had not installed, resolved by a frozen-lockfile reinstall. Both arms then failed on a storage-version mismatch because the server jar predated eight Java commits on the base — the carry-over decision had been made against this diff instead of against the base's commits, which is the wrong reference; rebuilding the jar turned both arms green and confirmed the attribution.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-user-visible test-infrastructure change. Commands and observed output: scripts meta suites `185 passed (185)` (89 in the changed file plus 96 in the hosted-process CI file), core parity `35 passed (35)`, core `tsc --build` clean, eslint and prettier clean, build and bundle rc=0 with the core/cli dist and the bundle asserted refreshed against the build's start timestamp, the server jar rebuilt because a merged base commit changed Java production sources, all four nested contract sidecars byte-equal to the committed files, `ManagedLoopSkillTest` 19/19, and both packaged arms rc=0 with the fire arm reporting scheduled/fired/completed. Mutation witnesses at the current head: 23 clause-level mutations of the placement predicate, all killed, plus 10 mutations of the real runner — seven killed and three surviving by design, those three being the retired data-flow behaviours the packaged arms own. Every mutation was restored byte-equal (`cp` + `cmp`). Two packaged-arm A/Bs settle behaviour the fast pin no longer judges: a bare direct return and a nullish fallback on one each fail the skill arm, and so do discarding the decision's result and swallowing the fall-through, while the committed delegation passes. CI at the two preceding heads settled 26 pass / 39 skipping / 0 fail.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Local real-environment rig: full workspace build, bundled CLI, a rebuilt server jar against local MySQL 8.4 and JDK 21, and the two packaged managed-loop arms. The new code is pure in-memory AST work and function execution with no shell, filesystem fixture or permission assumption, and its only new import resolves to a module that depends solely on Node builtins.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the fast pin is now a placement smoke check, not a behavioural guard. Three review rounds (6, 6 and 11 findings, each round's fixes generating the next round's) showed that judging the wiring's data flow by AST re-enters the unbounded-spelling treadmill this PR ends for the decision, so those clauses are retired by decision rather than left half-covering. The design record lists every retired check with a measured example — the result being returned, the gate's presence/spelling/polarity, rebindings including `delete` and in-place APIs, the fall-through, provenance beyond the parameter name, aliases, and answers built by a helper — and the packaged arms own them, which two arm A/Bs demonstrate. Size is quoted per revision because round 4 grew it back, on the caliber the design record states (the two helpers' full `const` statements, AST boundaries): 161 lines (141 non-comment) at the round-3 commit, 297 (254) and 312 (267) through round 4, 390 (356) at round 5, 403 (363) after round 6, and **523 lines (464 non-comment) as shipped** after round 8 — larger than the roughly 370-line scanner this PR deletes, so the reduction's original cost argument no longer holds. Scan time is not load-bearing — seven runs gave a 92.7 ms median with an 81.6–174.5 ms spread — so only the line count is quoted as a cost.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS and Windows were not run locally; the remaining hardening items tracked in the follow-up issue (derived degeneration threshold, cross-language fixture binding, shape-independent Java routing assertion, one exported Parsing grammar, machine-readable creator declaration) are untouched, as is the separate minted-id face and every non-classifier pin in the same test.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No production runtime module, contract, sidecar or Java file changes.

Design record: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/loop-classifier-executed-seam/docs/design/2026-11-20-managed-loop-classifier-executed-seam.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/loop-classifier-executed-seam/docs/design/2026-11-20-managed-loop-classifier-executed-seam.zh-CN.md) — both complete and synchronized, including the decisions, the disclosed limit, the verification ledger and the follow-up scope.

## Linked Issues

Addresses item 1 of #17673 (the root-cause item: execute the classifier decision instead of scanning for it). Items 2–6 remain open there.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

把 managed-loop 分类器侧查询的整个判定从两个 fake 模型回调里移出，放进一个顶层纯函数，由快速元测试直接执行。两条臂现各自带自己的 call id 委托给它，并在 undefined 门下返回结果；请求不是 block-schema 侧查询时，完全按原样继续往下。原先为判定形态做库存的手写 AST 扫描器——其绑定、门、answer 站点、allow 构造与各种写入形态——连同那份只为证明该扫描器非空转而存在的敌意控制一起退役。取代它们的是：一个用敌意请求 body 驱动判定并断言整个响应的被执行测试，以及一条针对委托本身的有界结构钉，由一个逐子句命名的判据裁定，并由一个敌意源控制逐子句执行见证。该钉现在只判**落位**——委托落在哪里、旁边没有别的东西在作答。三轮评审分别找出 6、6、11 种形状，每轮的修复都生出下一轮的发现，无方向审计点破成因：用 AST 识别 provenance、门、重写与 fall-through，就是对无界改写空间做手写语义分析，等于把本改动为判定终结的那台跑步机上移一层重新踏入。故数据流子句按决定退役，设计记录逐条列出并各附实测形状，那部分行为由打包臂承担。

## 为什么需要

接缝原先画在 schema properties 上，故查找、收窄、门与 answer 站点全部内联在每个 fake 里，快速测试唯一能断言的就是它们的形态。该面按构造就是无界的：任何「写同一个值或发同一个答案、但不按扫描器寻找的拼写来写」的方式都能击败它。前一个钉子收尾工作的十四轮评审大部分花在「新实测出一个兄弟形状绕过扫描器之后再扩展扫描器」上——shorthand 键、值为「曾初始化为 false 的绑定」的 allow、rest 解构写入、带括号与带类型转换的赋值目标、for-of 与 for-in 初始化器——每次关闭都是又一份以另一种拼写为键的库存。已记录的残留是：以取反或布尔强转算出的 allow 根本不拼写 false，任何拼写库存都看不见它。执行判定终结了这个家族，而不是再补一次。随之消除的还有两项较小代价：两条臂携带除 call id 外逐字节相同的判定块，故修复可能到达一条臂而漏掉另一条；而扫描器自身的非空转必须靠一份已长到二十一种写入形态的夹具来证明。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

跑 scripts 元套件与 core parity 套件，两者均绿。然后确认落位钉非空转：削弱任一子句——id 集合、互异回调计数、臂作用域的任一半、每臂一个 fake 的计数、实参来源、两条应答库存子句之一或其任一析取项、库存对嵌套函数的遍历、四类函数边界中的任意一类——都会让敌意源控制恰在被削弱的那个子句上打红。等价改写是正向对照：臂顺序、id 互换、各种门的拼写、箭头常量判定、合法的第三个 fake、合法的 cron 应答都必须保持绿。对判定本身，additive fallback、伪造 schema、去门、硬编码 call id 各自打红被执行测试，而同值的手搭对象刻意不打红——被执行测试钉的是响应值，同值不是缺陷。

最强的行为保持证据是等价 A/B：从 base 提交切出每条臂改动前的内联判定，与新函数在同一组十四个敌意 body 上驱动，共二十八次比对，全部相同。类型 A/B 在同一配置下对 base 与改动后的 runner 给出相同错误数，新增 0、移除 0。两条打包 managed-loop 臂在整栈重建后重跑均绿，fire 臂带 scheduled/fired/completed 见证与新的 occurrence key。

验证期间出现两条红，均归因为陈旧产物而非本改动，两次失败都不当作通过。一次构建失败来自 base 新增而本 worktree 未安装的依赖，frozen-lockfile 重装后解决。随后双臂因存储版本不匹配失败，原因是 server jar 早于 base 上的八个 Java 提交——承接判断当时参照的是本 diff 而非 base 的提交，这是错误的参照物；重建 jar 后双臂转绿，确证了该归因。

### 证据（前后对照）

N/A — 非用户可见的测试基础设施改动。命令与实测输出：scripts 元套件 `185 passed (185)`（改动文件 89 条加 hosted-process CI 文件 96 条）、core parity `35 passed (35)`、core `tsc --build` 净、eslint 与 prettier 净、build 与 bundle rc=0 且 core/cli dist 与 bundle 按构建起点时间戳断言已刷新、因合入的 base 提交改了 Java 生产源码而重建 server jar、四个嵌套契约 sidecar 与已提交文件逐字节相等、`ManagedLoopSkillTest` 19/19、两条打包臂 rc=0 且 fire 臂报 scheduled/fired/completed。当前 head 的变异见证：对落位判据的 23 条子句级变异全部 killed，另对真实 runner 的 10 条变异——7 条 killed、3 条按设计存活，那 3 条正是由打包臂承担的已退役数据流行为。每条变异均字节级还原（`cp` + `cmp`）。两次打包臂 A/B 裁决了快速钉不再判定的行为：裸直接返回、其上的 nullish 兜底、丢弃判定结果、吞掉 fall-through，四者各自让 skill 臂失败，而已提交的委托通过。前两个 head 的 CI 终态均为 26 pass / 39 skipping / 0 fail。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测 |

### 环境（可选）

本地真实环境 rig：全 workspace 构建、打包 CLI、针对本地 MySQL 8.4 与 JDK 21 重建的 server jar，以及两条打包 managed-loop 臂。新增代码是纯内存 AST 工作与函数执行，无 shell、文件系统夹具或权限假设，唯一新增导入解析到仅依赖 Node 内置模块的模块。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：快速钉现在是对落位的冒烟检查，不是行为守卫。三轮评审（分别 6、6、11 条，每轮修复生出下一轮发现）表明：用 AST 判接线的数据流，等于重新踏入本 PR 为判定终结的无界拼写跑步机，故那些子句按决定退役，而不是留着半覆盖。设计记录逐条列出已退役检查并各附实测形状——结果是否被返回、门的存在/拼写/极性、含 `delete` 与原地 API 的重写、fall-through、超出参数名的来源、别名、由 helper 构造的应答——这些由打包臂承担，两次臂 A/B 已证明。行数按版本标注，因为第 4 轮又撑回去了；口径与设计记录一致（两个 helper 各自整条 `const` 语句，边界取自 AST）：第 3 轮提交 161 行（141 非注释），第 4 轮期间 297（254）与 312（267），第 5 轮 390（356），第 6 轮后 403（363），第 8 轮后**交付版 523 行（464 非注释）**——比本 PR 删掉的约 370 行扫描器更大，故缩减最初的成本论据已不成立。扫描耗时不承重——七次运行中位 92.7 ms、区间 81.6–174.5 ms——故只把行数当成本引用。
- 未验证 / 范围外：macOS 与 Windows 未本地跑；跟进 issue 中其余加固项（派生退化阈值、跨语言 fixture 绑定、形态无关的 Java 路由断言、唯一导出的 Parsing 语法、机读 creator 声明）不动，独立的 minted-id 面与同一测试里所有非分类器钉也不动。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。不改任何生产运行时模块、契约、sidecar 或 Java 文件。

设计记录：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/loop-classifier-executed-seam/docs/design/2026-11-20-managed-loop-classifier-executed-seam.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/loop-classifier-executed-seam/docs/design/2026-11-20-managed-loop-classifier-executed-seam.zh-CN.md) — 两版完整同步，含决策、已披露限度、验证账本与后续范围。

## 关联 Issue

处理 #17673 的第 1 项（根因项：执行分类器判定而非扫描它）。第 2–6 项仍在该 issue 中开放。

</details>
