prs.title: fix(web-shell): prevent narrow actions from covering metadata
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This is a small follow-up to #18011 for the remaining crowded state in narrow touch-session rows. It lets matching session rows wrap auxiliary status metadata instead of squeezing the title and controls into the More area, and keeps the 26px More hit area clear of wrapped metadata. While a session or group menu is open, it also closes or cancels hover details so those details do not become a competing dismissal layer.

PR state icons, numbers, counts and links, Goal markers, and legal running/attention/continuation indicators stay visible. Existing Pin/Archive, grouping and rename handlers, capability and busy restrictions, keyboard focus ownership, and desktop or wide-touch layouts remain in place. No information is hidden to gain title space.

The accompanying regression coverage includes the 200px two-PR fixture, row-contained pairwise geometry with More, real right-edge PR-link hit-testing, and full Sidebar-level session/group menu wiring. Other cases retain Pin, Group, Rename, title-right navigation and dismissal focus. The English and Chinese design notes are updated together.

## Why it's needed

On an already crowded narrow row, combining the title with PR metadata, a Goal and a running, attention or continuation marker could overwhelm the intended inline action area. This remained after the first density pass: status could extend outside its row and an action layer could intercept clicks that were meant for the session.

The fix is deliberately scoped to narrow touch rows with the reserved action metadata. It does not trade away the user's PR status, Goal, enabled row actions or larger-screen layouts merely to make the title readable.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Use a Recent row carrying PR metadata, a Goal and running, waiting-input, waiting-approval or continuation state. All applicable indicators should remain visible inside the row, without pairwise overlap, while the title retains a usable click target and More remains 26px.

Click the blank row area below More and the title's right edge. Both should open the intended session rather than open a menu or do nothing. More should still open its permitted actions, including Pin, and Escape should restore focus to More instead of borrowing focus from the Rename input or outside editor.

Resize the actual embedded host to 200px and compare it with a wide coarse-pointer viewport. The narrow crowded host should wrap its metadata; the wide case should retain nowrap. On a normal desktop, verify PR status/number/count/link and Goal, and check More → Group/Rename plus dismissal focus behavior. Input/Approval rows retain both their attention indicator and running spinner; idle continuation is not fabricated as running plus continuation.

### Evidence (Before & After)

For this historical A/B pair, Chromium used matched session data, viewport, dark theme, coarse pointer, BODY focus, closed menu, no draft, and the same read-only CJK font setup on both arms.

**Before — parent `42b62e9a9e`:** the title measured 0px, while continuation extended beyond the row.

![Before: narrow crowded session list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/crowded-session-metadata-e5efc0e667/narrow-crowded-before.png)

**After — `e5efc0e667`:** the same fixture retained a 103px title area and kept PR, Goal, continuation and More distinct inside the row.

![After: narrow crowded session list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/crowded-session-metadata-e5efc0e667/narrow-crowded-after.png)

The pair uses idle continuation only. Its old action layer was 22px, not 66px, so these images do not claim a 66px-to-26px overlap example. The separate status-row E2E covers real below-More hit-testing and navigation. An off-row point was retained as a negative control rather than presented as a product bug. A/B fonts were also checked by comparing actual CJK and private-use glyph pixels, not by trusting `document.fonts.check`.

A separate current-head capture at `e40228ee636b` uses the **200px two-PR fixture**, not that historical A/B fixture. It preserves the title, source marker, PR number/count/link, Goal, attention and running markers, while keeping the 26px More clear of the wrapped lines. Its pointer check also hits the actual PR link at the right-middle of the capsule rather than an inert rounded corner.

![Current head: two-PR crowded session row at a 200px host](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/crowded-session-metadata-e40228ee636b/embedded-200-crowded.png)

The desktop screenshot below comes from a real isolated daemon at the verified HEAD. The mobile fixture has an active Goal (blue), while the actual daemon's unreachable-provider turn subsequently settles to `paused` (yellow) and retains it through reload and restart. That is a runtime-state distinction, not a different theme or a removed Goal. Desktop outside-dismissal focus is intentional; both mobile captures retain the same body-focus and closed-menu state.

![Desktop session list through the real isolated daemon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/crowded-session-metadata-e40228ee636b/desktop-initial.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested — no local macOS or native Safari/VoiceOver run; the corresponding CI job was skipped when this section was written. |
|  🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested — no local Windows run; the corresponding CI job was skipped when this section was written. |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested locally with Node 24, matching A/B on the exact commits, 144 focused unit tests, 3 mobile Chromium smokes, and 25 real isolated-daemon verification groups. Public Linux CI at Node 22 was still running while this section was being updated. |

### Environment (optional)

Local verification used Node 24 and `node dist/cli.js` built from `e40228ee636ba5d7fe78c844f3fc24cda054270c`. `npm run build`, `npm run bundle` and `npm run typecheck` all exited 0. ESLint passed for every changed TS/TSX file, and all 11 changed files passed Prettier checks.

The 144 focused tests comprise 13 sidebar stylesheet contracts, 33 Tooltip cases, 93 full-Sidebar cases and 5 rectangle-geometry cases. The three mobile smoke cases passed on this tree. One selected touch-row menu scenario additionally returned 12/12 passes with `--workers=2 --repeat-each=12 --retries=0` (about 3.7 minutes), preserving the existing 60s test and 20s expect limits. The historical A/B against `42b62e9a9eb6b8354d0487fa705dba900095373b` used independent trees with the same fixture and passed on both the parent and the first proposed commit; current-head verification is independent of that pair.

The real daemon run used a separate HOME/runtime/workspace, owner-only temporary permissions, a random bearer token, random loopback ports and an intentionally unreachable provider. It checked HTTP session creation, title and PR bindings, Goal readback and catalog projection, real browser focus, Pin/Unpin, transcript/organization persistence, reload/restart, and JS/CSS bytes matching the current assets. All 25 recorded harness groups passed; these groups contain multiple assertions and are not 25 official test cases.

The daemon-created Goal initially reported `active`, then the unreachable-provider turn settled to `paused`, which persisted through reload and restart. No real model request or shared user daemon/session was used. Screenshots are Linux Chromium emulation, not physical-device photographs.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: crowded narrow rows may take more vertical space so that PR/Goal/status information remains visible instead of being hidden. This is limited to matching narrow touch rows with reserved action metadata; archived and wider layouts are not intentionally changed. More keeps its 26px hit area rather than sacrificing usability for title space.
- Not validated / out of scope: physical iPhone hardware, native iOS Safari, VoiceOver and a real embedded navigation-rail host. The 200px harness covers embedded-host sizing, but is not an attestation of every production embedding mode. Further title-flex balancing is an optional refinement deferred from this minimal fix. A/B evidence here measures idle continuation, while broader state combinations are covered in the mobile E2E harness rather than being claimed as simultaneous real daemon state.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no API, storage, schema, provider, permission or action-handler migration is intended. Existing busy/running/current/standalone capability checks and desktop inline behavior keep their shared handlers. There is no new dependency.
- Test-suite residual: an earlier exploratory full Web Shell run was red with 2 failing files, 95 failing tests and 3 unhandled errors (623 files, 17,638 tests total). Both affected files then passed separately on the patched tree and independently prepared base tree: 587 tests each. That is not a fully green run or a completed full-suite baseline comparison, and it is not being called generic flakiness. On this head, a first-attempt browser-shard failure ([job log](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/45044779562/job/137278966336)) was a CDN `fetch` error (`ETIMEDOUT`/`ENETUNREACH`) while downloading the two immutable unpkg renderer resources, before the byte/SRI assertions rather than a sidebar-geometry assertion. It is not counted as passed here; the latest PR CI is evaluated from its own logs.
- Local review scope: the R1/R2 suggestions were addressed, including 200px coverage, reserve-only wrapping documentation, shared geometry testing and real menu wiring. The strengthened 200px case exposed a real 4px PR/More overlap that is now fixed. Independent geometry and menu audits on the exact merged head found no further verified issues in their stated scopes. This is local evidence, not maintainer approval or physical-device certification.

Design documentation is paired and synchronized: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/web-shell-crowded-session-metadata/docs/design/web-shell-session-list-density.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/web-shell-crowded-session-metadata/docs/design/web-shell-session-list-density.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #18011, without a closing keyword.

<details><summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

本次是 #18011 的后续小修复，处理窄触屏会话行中剩余的拥挤状态。让符合条件的会话行换行展示辅助状态元数据，不再把标题和操作挤到 More 所在区域；同时保留 26px More 点击区域与换行元数据之间的间隙。会话或分组菜单打开时，还会关闭或取消 hover 详情，避免它变成第二个关闭层级。

PR 状态图标、编号、计数、链接、Goal 以及合法的 running/attention/continuation 标记继续完整可见。既有 Pin/Archive、分组、重命名处理器、能力与忙碌限制、键盘焦点所有权以及桌面和宽触屏布局均保持不变。不会为了腾出标题空间隐藏任何信息。

相应的回归覆盖包括 200px 双 PR 夹具、行内的元数据/More 两两几何边界、PR 徽章右缘的真实链接命中，以及真实侧栏的会话/分组菜单接线。其他用例继续保留 Pin、Group、Rename、标题右缘导航与取消后的焦点行为。英文和中文设计文档也同步更新。

## Why it's needed

在已经拥挤的窄行内，如果标题同时带有 PR 元数据、Goal 和 running、attention 或 continuation 标记，原本预留给行内动作的空间就可能无法容纳这些信息。首轮密度优化后仍可能出现状态越过行边界、以及动作层截获本应用于打开会话的点击的问题。

修复有意限定在带预留动作元数据的窄触屏行，不会仅为了让标题可读，就牺牲用户的 PR 状态、Goal、可用的行操作或更大屏幕的布局。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

使用带有 PR 元数据、Goal，以及 running、等待输入、等待审批或 continuation 状态的 Recent 行。所有适用的状态标记都应在行内保持可见、互不重叠，标题保留可点击区域，More 仍为 26px。

点击 More 下方的行空白区域和标题右缘，均应进入对应会话，而不是打开菜单或无响应。More 仍应能打开允许的 Pin 等操作，Escape 后焦点回到 More，而不是抢走 Rename 输入框或外部编辑器的焦点。

把真实嵌入宿主宽度调整为 200px，并与宽粗指针视口对照：窄宿主的拥挤元数据应换行，宽宿主应保持 nowrap。普通桌面下，应验证 PR 状态/编号/计数/链接与 Goal，并检查 More → Group/Rename 以及取消后的焦点行为。Input/Approval 行应同时保留 attention 标记和运行中 spinner；idle continuation 不应伪装成 running 与 continuation 共存。

### Evidence (Before & After)

这组历史 A/B 对照使用 Chromium 真实截图，两臂的会话数据、viewport、暗色主题、粗指针、BODY 焦点、关闭菜单、无草稿状态，以及相同的只读 CJK 字体配置均一致。

**修复前——父提交 `42b62e9a9e`：** 标题实测宽度为 0px，且 continuation 超出所在行。

![修复前的窄屏会话列表](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/crowded-session-metadata-e5efc0e667/narrow-crowded-before.png)

**修复后——`e5efc0e667`：** 同一夹具保留 103px 的标题区域，PR、Goal、continuation 与 More 均保留在行内且彼此分离。

![修复后的窄屏会话列表](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/crowded-session-metadata-e5efc0e667/narrow-crowded-after.png)

这组对照仅使用 idle continuation。其旧动作层是 22px，而非 66px，不能据此声称这里是 66px 到 26px 的重叠示例。另一个状态行 E2E 才负责验证 More 下方的真实命中与导航。落到下一行的点保留为负向控制，不被包装成产品缺陷。A/B 的字体也通过比较真实汉字与私用区字形的像素来检查，而不是相信 `document.fonts.check`。

下面这张当前头 `e40228ee636b` 的截图使用独立的 **200px 双 PR 夹具**，不是上面的历史 A/B 场景。标题、来源标记、PR 编号/计数/链接、Goal、attention 和运行中标记均保留，26px More 与换行元数据之间保持分离。命中检查选在胶囊右缘的垂直中心，而不是圆角外部，验证真正的 PR 链接可命中。

![当前头：200px 宿主中的双 PR 拥挤会话行](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/crowded-session-metadata-e40228ee636b/embedded-200-crowded.png)

下面的桌面截图来自验证 HEAD 上的真实隔离 daemon。移动夹具中的 Goal 为 active（蓝色），真实 daemon 在不可达 provider 的回合结算后变为 `paused`（黄色），并在 reload/restart 后保持。这是运行时状态的区别，不是更换主题或删除 Goal。桌面截图保留的是预期的外侧取消焦点行为；两张移动截图则使用相同的 body 焦点与关闭菜单状态。

![真实隔离 daemon 对应的桌面会话列表](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/crowded-session-metadata-e40228ee636b/desktop-initial.png)

### Tested on

|     操作系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试——未运行本地 macOS 或原生 Safari/VoiceOver；撰写本节时对应 CI 作业为 skipped。 |
|  🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试——未运行本地 Windows；撰写本节时对应 CI 作业为 skipped。 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已使用 Node 24 在本地完成精确提交的匹配 A/B、144 项相关单测、3 条移动 Chromium smoke，以及 25 组真实隔离 daemon 验证。更新本节时，公开 Linux Node 22 CI 仍在运行。 |

### Environment (optional)

本地验证使用 Node 24 和本次提交 `e40228ee636ba5d7fe78c844f3fc24cda054270c` 构建的 `node dist/cli.js`。`npm run build`、`npm run bundle`、`npm run typecheck` 的退出码均为 0；变更的 TS/TSX 文件 ESLint 通过，全部 11 个变更文件 Prettier 检查通过。

144 项相关单测包括 13 项侧栏样式契约、33 项 Tooltip 用例、93 项完整侧栏用例和 5 项矩形几何用例；3 条移动 smoke 在当前代码树通过。一个指定的触摸行菜单场景另外以 `--workers=2 --repeat-each=12 --retries=0` 完成 12/12 通过（约 3.7 分钟），保留原有 60 秒单测与 20 秒 expect 限制。与 `42b62e9a9eb6b8354d0487fa705dba900095373b` 的历史 A/B 使用独立代码树及相同的夹具，父提交与首个候选提交均通过；当前头的验证独立于该组对照。

真实 daemon 验收使用独立 HOME/runtime/workspace、owner-only 临时权限、随机 bearer token、随机回环端口和显式不可达 provider。它验证了真实 HTTP 会话创建、标题与 PR 绑定、Goal 读回与 catalog 投影、浏览器真实焦点、Pin/Unpin、transcript/组织信息持久化、reload/restart，以及 JS/CSS 响应字节与当前资产的匹配。全部 25 个记录 harness 分组均通过；每个分组含多个断言，不代表 25 个官方测试用例。

daemon 创建的 Goal 最初为 `active`；随后不可达 provider 的回合结算为 `paused`，并通过 reload/restart 保持。没有调用真实模型，也没有使用用户共享 daemon/会话。截图来自 Linux Chromium 模拟，不是物理设备照片。

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: 拥挤的窄行可能需要更多纵向空间，以便 PR/Goal/状态信息保持可见，而不是被隐藏。该取舍仅影响带预留动作元数据的窄触屏行；归档行和更宽的布局没有刻意变更。More 保留 26px 点击区域，不会以牺牲可用性来为标题换取空间。
- Not validated / out of scope: 未认证物理 iPhone、原生 iOS Safari、VoiceOver 或真实 embedded navigation-rail 宿主。200px harness 验证了嵌入宿主宽度行为，但不代表所有生产嵌入模式都已认证。进一步 title-flex 平衡是可延期的布局精修，不纳入此最小修复。这里的 A/B 测量 idle continuation；更广的状态组合由移动 E2E harness 覆盖，不声称它们同时出现在真实 daemon 行中。
- Breaking changes / migration notes: 不计划迁移 API、存储、schema、provider、权限或动作处理器。既有 busy/running/current/standalone 能力检查和桌面 inline 行为继续复用现有处理器，没有新增依赖。
- 全量测试残余：早期一次探索性 Web Shell 全套运行出现 2 个失败文件、95 项失败测试和 3 个未处理错误（共 623 个文件、17,638 项测试）。随后两个受影响文件在补丁树与独立准备的基线树上分别单跑，各有 587 项通过。这不等于全套通过，也不等于完成全量基线复绿对照，不能泛称为 flake。本头另一浏览器分片的首轮失败（[作业日志](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/45044779562/job/137278966336)）是在下载两个固定的 unpkg 渲染资源时发生 `fetch` 错误（`ETIMEDOUT`/`ENETUNREACH`），位于字节与完整性断言之前，而不是侧栏几何断言失败；此处没有把它计为通过。最新 PR CI 仍按各自原始日志归属，不由这些定向检查推断。
- 本地审查范围：已处理 R1/R2 建议，包括 200px 覆盖、限定预留槽的换行文档、统一几何测试和真实菜单接线。加强后的 200px 用例发现并协助修复了真实的 4px PR/More 重叠。独立几何与菜单审计在精确合并头上，就其声明的范围未再发现可验证的问题。这些是本地证据，不等于 maintainer 审批或物理设备认证。

配套设计文档已同步：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/web-shell-crowded-session-metadata/docs/design/web-shell-session-list-density.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/web-shell-crowded-session-metadata/docs/design/web-shell-session-list-density.zh-CN.md)。

## Linked Issues

作为 #18011 的后续修复，不使用关闭 issue 的关键字。

</details>

prs.title: feat(core): add bundled Bash search tools
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR moves filename and content search onto the Shell tool whenever a Bash-compatible search surface is available. It unregisters `glob` and `grep_search` on macOS and Linux; Windows deliberately keeps the existing dedicated tools.

Qwen Code now ships ripgrep 15.0.0, bfs 4.1.4, and ugrep 7.8.4 and exposes them inside Shell calls as `rg`, `find`, and `grep`. The wrappers preserve the configured Git, Qwen, and custom ignore behavior, and the system, agent, memory, team, and bundled-skill prompts consistently direct ignore-aware filename discovery to `rg --files`.

The packaging path copies the new binaries into CLI bundles, makes them executable after installation, and includes the macOS binaries in desktop release signing. A checksum-pinned maintainer script documents and reproduces the vendored builds.

## Why it's needed

The dedicated search tools duplicate capabilities that Bash-capable environments already provide and consume model tool-surface budget. Moving search through Shell aligns Qwen Code with the current Claude Code command surface while keeping deterministic search binaries and Qwen Code's ignore configuration instead of depending on whichever utilities happen to be installed on the host.

Windows is deliberately out of scope because hosting every Shell command in Git Bash is a separate behavior change; all Windows hosts retain the current dedicated search tools.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. On macOS or Linux, start the built CLI and confirm the advertised tools omit `glob` and `grep_search`; inside a Shell call, `rg`, `grep`, and `find` should resolve to the injected command surface.
2. In a temporary project, add visible files plus files excluded by a root or nested `.gitignore`, `.agentignore`, `.aiignore`, `.qwenignore`, and a configured custom ignore file. `rg --files` and recursive `grep` should return visible matches and omit the ignored fixtures, including outside a Git repository.
3. Disable Git-ignore or Qwen-ignore handling in configuration and confirm the corresponding files become searchable while the other configured ignore sources remain effective.
4. On Windows, confirm `glob` and `grep_search` remain registered and no Bash search prelude is injected, regardless of whether Git Bash is installed.
5. Build and bundle the CLI and confirm all platform-specific ripgrep, bfs, and ugrep assets are present. For a macOS desktop release, confirm all three Darwin binaries are included in the signing inputs.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A. This changes the model tool surface and Shell command behavior, not the visual TUI. Automated assertions cover both registration branches, generated prompts, command injection, ignore behavior, asset copying, installation, and release signing inputs.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64 with Node.js 24.18.0, using the source worktree and generated CLI bundle. Windows and Linux branches were covered by deterministic unit tests and binary/package inspection, but were not executed on native hosts.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Native ripgrep, ugrep, and the dedicated parser now apply last-match precedence across the same ordered ignore files. Custom ignore files are applied first and `.qwenignore` last so Qwen rules win conflicts. Explicit positive `--glob`/`-g` filters can override ignore matches, as they do in native ripgrep.
- Not validated / out of scope: Native Windows and Linux runtime execution, hosting the Shell tool in Git Bash on Windows, interactive model quality comparisons, and ignore-aware behavior for `find`. Ignore-aware filename discovery intentionally uses `rg --files`.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: No configuration migration is required. Bash-capable macOS and Linux sessions expose fewer dedicated tools and use the Shell search surface; Windows retains the previous tools.

## Linked Issues

N/A.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

当环境具备兼容 Bash 的搜索能力时，这个 PR 会把文件名搜索和内容搜索迁移到 Shell 工具。在 macOS 和 Linux 上，`glob` 和 `grep_search` 将不再注册；Windows 会明确保留现有的专用工具。

Qwen Code 现在会随包附带 ripgrep 15.0.0、bfs 4.1.4 和 ugrep 7.8.4，并在 Shell 调用中以 `rg`、`find` 和 `grep` 的形式暴露。包装函数会保留已配置的 Git、Qwen 和自定义 ignore 行为；系统、agent、memory、team 以及内置 skill 的提示词也统一引导模型使用 `rg --files` 进行遵循 ignore 的文件名发现。

打包流程会把新增二进制复制进 CLI bundle，安装后赋予可执行权限，并将 macOS 二进制加入桌面发布签名。另有一个固定源码校验和的维护者脚本，用于记录并复现这些 vendor 构建。

## 为什么需要

专用搜索工具与支持 Bash 的环境中已有的能力重复，也会占用模型的工具面预算。通过 Shell 执行搜索，可以让 Qwen Code 与当前 Claude Code 的命令面保持一致；同时仍然提供确定版本的搜索二进制和 Qwen Code 的 ignore 配置，而不是依赖主机上碰巧安装的工具。

Windows 明确不在本次范围内，因为让所有 Shell 命令统一由 Git Bash 承载是另一项行为变更；所有 Windows 主机都会保留当前的专用搜索工具。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在 macOS 或 Linux 上启动构建后的 CLI，确认公布的工具中没有 `glob` 和 `grep_search`；在一次 Shell 调用中，`rg`、`grep` 和 `find` 应解析到注入的命令面。
2. 在临时项目中创建可见文件，以及分别被根目录或嵌套 `.gitignore`、`.agentignore`、`.aiignore`、`.qwenignore` 和已配置的自定义 ignore 文件排除的文件。`rg --files` 和递归 `grep` 应返回可见匹配并排除这些 ignore fixture，在非 Git 仓库中也应如此。
3. 在配置中关闭 Git ignore 或 Qwen ignore，确认对应文件恢复为可搜索，同时其他已配置的 ignore 来源仍然生效。
4. 在 Windows 上确认 `glob` 和 `grep_search` 仍会注册，且无论是否安装 Git Bash 都不会注入 Bash 搜索前导代码。
5. 构建并打包 CLI，确认所有平台对应的 ripgrep、bfs 和 ugrep 资源均存在。对于 macOS 桌面发布，确认三个 Darwin 二进制都包含在签名输入中。

### 证据（之前与之后）

不适用。这个改动影响的是模型工具面和 Shell 命令行为，而不是可视化 TUI。自动化断言覆盖了两条注册分支、生成的提示词、命令注入、ignore 行为、资源复制、安装以及发布签名输入。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

macOS arm64、Node.js 24.18.0，使用源码 worktree 和生成的 CLI bundle。Windows 与 Linux 分支通过确定性的单元测试和二进制/包检查覆盖，但没有在原生主机上执行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：原生 ripgrep、ugrep 和专用解析器现在会按相同的 ignore 文件顺序应用最后匹配优先级。自定义 ignore 文件先应用，`.qwenignore` 最后应用，因此冲突时 Qwen 规则优先。显式的正向 `--glob`/`-g` 过滤可能覆盖 ignore 匹配，这与原生 ripgrep 的行为一致。
- 未验证或不在范围内：Windows 和 Linux 原生运行、在 Windows 上由 Git Bash 承载 Shell 工具、交互式模型质量对比，以及 `find` 的 ignore 感知行为。需要遵循 ignore 的文件名发现会明确使用 `rg --files`。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：不需要迁移配置。支持 Bash 的 macOS 和 Linux 会话会减少专用工具，并改用 Shell 搜索命令面；Windows 会保留原有工具。

## 关联 Issue

无。

</details>

prs.title: feat(core): add local notes compaction with a strategy selector
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an opt-in local notes compaction strategy. Users can select **Summary** or **Notes and History** under **Chat Compression Strategy** in `/settings`, or set `model.chatCompression.strategy` to `summary` or `notes` in `settings.json`. Summary remains the default; changing the selection requires restarting Qwen Code.

Eligible main sessions gain `session_notes`, `session_history`, `get_context_remaining`, and `new_context`. The model can persist a bounded working checkpoint, start a smaller context from that checkpoint and the latest consumed user request, and recover omitted evidence from the active branch of its local session log. Successful notes rollovers make no summarization request. Notes revisions live in the existing JSONL transcript, with a generated Markdown projection for inspection; checkpoint persistence must succeed before active history changes. Resume, fork, rewind, archive, and deletion handle the matching notes state.

Missing, stale, or unusable notes fall back to summary for automatic and ordinary manual compression. An explicit `new_context` requires a fresh revision and reports an error if it cannot commit. `/compress <instructions>` continues to summarize, and `/compress-fast` keeps its existing behavior. The notes tool bundle respects recording availability and tool policy and is excluded from subagents, teammates, and nested code-mode calls. Ink and OpenTUI display a notes-specific transition notice.

## Why it's needed

Repeated full-history summaries can lose constraints, decisions, and tool evidence that a long task needs later. A local working checkpoint plus bounded history retrieval gives the model a way to carry forward its current state and recover details on demand. Storage and retrieval use the existing session log and require no additional memory backend. Selected notes and retrieved history still go to the configured model provider as normal inference input. Real-model quality, total token cost, and latency remain to be measured before considering a default change.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start the local build with no strategy configured and confirm summary behavior. Open `/settings`, search for `compression`, switch to **Notes and History**, and confirm the saved value is `model.chatCompression.strategy: "notes"` and the restart notice appears. Restart and check that the four notes tools are available. Repeat with `summary`, including activation through `settings.json`.
2. In an isolated recorded session, have the model write notes and request a new context in separate tool-only responses using the returned revision. Repeat three times. Each new context should retain the checkpoint and current user constraints, with no summarizer request. Deliberately omit an earlier identifier from the notes, then recover it through history search/read. Resume the session and check that its latest notes revision and old history reference still work.
3. Check that missing/stale revisions, oversized notes, and notes/reset calls mixed with ordinary text or tools cannot install a new context. Disabling recording or denying a required notes tool should disable the complete bundle. After switching to a smaller model window, existing bounded notes should remain readable, while an oversized checkpoint must be shortened before it can authorize a reset.
4. Compare compression commands: `/compress` with fresh notes should use notes; missing/stale notes should fall back to summary; `/compress <instructions>` should forward those instructions to the summarizer even with fresh notes; `/compress-fast` should retain its current tool-output clearing behavior. Check that the next model request uses the committed context and that notes transitions show the notes-specific notice.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Actual tmux captures of `/settings`, with the search set to `compression`:

**Before — global `qwen` `0.23.3-nightly.20260913.faa395885e`:**

```text
No settings match your search.
```

**After — local bundle `0.24.1`:**

```text
Chat Compression Strategy                                                   Notes and History*
Choose summary compression or local notes with history recovery. Restart Qwen Code to apply.
To see changes, Qwen Code must be restarted. Press r to exit and apply changes now.
```

The fresh-notes `/compress` case displayed `Started a new context from local notes` in the actual TUI. The complete deterministic headless/tmux run passed settings persistence, tool availability, history recovery/resume, six rejection cases, and all six manual-compression cases. After the final fixes, the rebuilt handoff rerun again committed **three distinct notes windows in 15 main requests with zero summarizer requests**; resume took three requests and restored the same notes revision and historical reference.

`npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run bundle` passed. Relevant core, ACP, settings/schema/i18n, and Ink/OpenTUI regression tests passed. The final focused rerun passed 23 core tests and 54 event-adapter tests; the commit hook also passed formatting and ESLint. A separate comment contains the E2E matrix and coverage limits.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, Node.js `v26.8.2`; local bundled CLI `0.24.1`; isolated temporary settings and runtime directories; deterministic localhost OpenAI-compatible provider; headless CLI and real tmux interaction. The user's normal settings and sessions were not modified by the tests.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: This changes core recording, compaction, and replay paths. Correctness depends on fresh notes, successful checkpoint persistence, and branch-correct recovery; note completeness still depends on the model. The Markdown file is a generated view, so editing it directly does not update canonical notes.
- Not validated / out of scope: Real-model task quality, token/cost/latency comparisons, full ACP/Web Shell E2E, other provider wire protocols, process-crash/disk/lease fault injection, and Windows/Linux execution. The deterministic E2E suite does not cover automatic/hard-overflow triggers, nested code mode, or fork/rewind/archive lifecycle operations; focused regression tests cover relevant runtime paths, without claiming end-to-end coverage. Cross-session memory, multi-file notes, and a notes editor are out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: No settings migration is required. `summary` remains the default, existing transcripts remain supported, and enabling or disabling `notes` requires a restart. Ordinary compression can use summary fallback; an explicit `new_context` never silently summarizes.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized, including decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria, and follow-up validation.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12257

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的内容

增加可选的本地 notes 压缩策略。用户可以在 `/settings` 的 **上下文压缩方式** 中选择 **摘要** 或 **笔记与历史**，也可以在 `settings.json` 中把 `model.chatCompression.strategy` 设为 `summary` 或 `notes`。默认仍为摘要；修改选项后需要重启 Qwen Code。

符合条件的主会话获得 `session_notes`、`session_history`、`get_context_remaining` 和 `new_context` 四个工具。模型可以保存有大小限制的工作笔记，从笔记和最近已消费的用户请求启动更小的上下文，再从本地 session log 的有效分支找回遗漏证据。成功的 notes 换窗口不发起摘要请求。笔记版本保存在现有 JSONL transcript 中，并生成方便查看的 Markdown 文件；只有恢复 checkpoint 持久化成功后才替换当前历史。恢复、分叉、回退、归档和删除操作会处理对应的笔记状态。

自动压缩和普通手动压缩在笔记缺失、过期或不可用时回退到摘要。显式调用 `new_context` 必须提供新鲜的笔记版本，无法提交时返回错误。`/compress <instructions>` 继续生成摘要，`/compress-fast` 保持现有行为。笔记工具组遵循录制可用性及工具策略，并对 subagent、teammate 和嵌套 code-mode 调用关闭。Ink 和 OpenTUI 会显示专门的 notes 换窗口提示。

## 为什么需要

反复生成全历史摘要可能丢失长任务后续需要的约束、决策和工具证据。本地工作笔记加上有界历史检索，使模型能够保留当前工作状态并按需找回细节。存储和检索复用现有 session log，不需要新增 memory 后端。选中的笔记和检索出的历史仍会作为正常推理输入发送给配置的模型 provider。在考虑修改默认策略前，仍需评估真实模型的任务质量、总 token 成本和延迟。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 使用本地构建启动，不配置策略时确认仍使用摘要。打开 `/settings`，搜索 `compression`，切换到 **Notes and History**，确认保存的值为 `model.chatCompression.strategy: "notes"` 并显示重启提示。重启后检查四个笔记工具可用。再切回 `summary`，并验证通过 `settings.json` 启用的行为一致。
2. 在隔离且开启录制的会话中，让模型先写笔记，再用返回的 revision 请求新上下文；两次调用分别放在独立且只含该工具的回复中。重复三次。每个新上下文都应保留 checkpoint 和当前用户约束，且不发起摘要请求。故意不把某个早期标识符写入笔记，再通过历史搜索和读取找回。恢复会话后，检查最新笔记版本和旧历史引用仍可用。
3. 检查缺失或过期的 revision、超限笔记，以及混入普通文本或其他工具的笔记/换窗口调用，都不能安装新上下文。关闭录制或拒绝任一必需工具后，整个笔记工具组应被关闭。切换到窗口更小的模型后，已有且满足固定大小上限的笔记仍应可读，但超过当前模型预算的 checkpoint 必须缩短后才能用于换窗口。
4. 对比压缩命令：笔记新鲜时 `/compress` 应使用笔记；笔记缺失或过期时应回退到摘要；即使有新鲜笔记，`/compress <instructions>` 也应把指定要求转交摘要模型；`/compress-fast` 应保留现有清理工具输出的行为。检查下一次模型请求使用已提交的上下文，且 notes 换窗口显示对应提示。

### 证据（前后对比）

以下为真实 tmux 捕获的 `/settings` 画面节选，搜索词为 `compression`：

**修改前：全局 `qwen` `0.23.3-nightly.20260913.faa395885e`：**

```text
No settings match your search.
```

**修改后：本地 bundle `0.24.1`：**

```text
Chat Compression Strategy                                                   Notes and History*
Choose summary compression or local notes with history recovery. Restart Qwen Code to apply.
To see changes, Qwen Code must be restarted. Press r to exit and apply changes now.
```

使用新鲜笔记执行 `/compress` 时，真实 TUI 显示 `Started a new context from local notes`。完整的确定性 headless/tmux 测试通过了设置持久化、工具可用性、历史找回与会话恢复、六项拒绝场景以及全部六项手动压缩场景。最终修复后重新构建并复测交接，再次在 **15 次主模型请求中提交了三个不同的 notes 窗口，摘要请求为零**；恢复过程使用三次请求，恢复了相同的笔记版本和历史引用。

`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck` 和 `npm run bundle` 均通过。相关 core、ACP、设置/schema/国际化、Ink/OpenTUI 回归测试均通过。最后的针对性复测通过了 23 个 core 测试和 54 个 event-adapter 测试；提交钩子的格式和 ESLint 检查也通过。另附评论列出 E2E 场景矩阵和覆盖范围。

### 测试平台

| 平台 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS arm64、Node.js `v26.8.2`、本地 CLI bundle `0.24.1`；使用隔离的临时设置和 runtime 目录、确定性的 localhost OpenAI 兼容模型服务、headless CLI 和真实 tmux 交互。测试未修改用户日常使用的设置和会话。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：涉及 core 的录制、压缩和回放路径。正确性依赖笔记新鲜度、checkpoint 成功持久化以及有效分支恢复；笔记内容是否完整仍依赖模型。Markdown 文件只是生成视图，直接编辑不会更新权威笔记。
- 未验证或不在范围内：真实模型任务质量、token/成本/延迟对比、完整 ACP/Web Shell E2E、其他 provider 的通信协议、进程崩溃/磁盘/写入租约故障注入，以及 Windows/Linux 运行。确定性 E2E 未覆盖自动/硬溢出触发、嵌套 code mode 或分叉/回退/归档生命周期操作；针对性回归测试覆盖了相关运行时路径，但不代表完成了这些场景的端到端验证。跨会话记忆、多文件笔记和笔记编辑器不在本次范围内。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无需迁移设置。默认仍为 `summary`，继续支持已有 transcript；开启或关闭 `notes` 需要重启。普通压缩可以回退到摘要；显式 `new_context` 绝不会悄悄改用摘要。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.zh-CN.md)。两个版本完整同步，包括决策、约束、验收标准和后续验证。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #12257

</details>

prs.title: feat: add hybrid code mode
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Codex-aligned `tools.mode` enum with `direct`, `code_mode`, and `code_mode_only`. `code_mode` keeps ordinary tools directly callable while also exposing the isolated `exec` JavaScript tool; each visible ordinary tool carries its nested JavaScript declaration, while `exec` retains compact `ALL_TOOLS` metadata. `code_mode_only` preserves the strict exec-only ordinary-tool surface, and `direct` remains the default.

Updates filtered subagent tool surfaces so direct declarations and nested exec bindings honor the same allowlists, exposes the enum in Settings as Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only, regenerates the settings JSON schema, and removes the former `tools.codeModeOnly` boolean setting entirely.

Adds synchronized [English](docs/design/code-mode.md) and [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md) design documents, and brings the existing CodeModeOnly design up to the repository's bilingual documentation standard ([English](docs/design/code-mode-only.md), [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)).

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code previously offered only the default direct tool surface or the strict CodeModeOnly surface. Models could not combine direct calls for simple operations with `exec` orchestration for multi-tool workflows. A three-value enum matches Codex's `ToolMode` naming and gives users one explicit setting for all supported exposure modes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Leave `tools.mode` unset or set it to `direct`, restart Qwen Code, and confirm ordinary tools remain available while `exec` is absent.
2. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode`, restart, and confirm both ordinary tools and `exec` are available. Confirm ordinary tool descriptions include their `tools.<name>(args)` declaration and deferred tools remain discoverable through `tool_search`.
3. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode_only`, restart, and confirm ordinary tools are available through `exec` rather than as top-level calls, while direct control tools remain available.
4. Open Settings and confirm Tool Mode cycles among Default, Code Mode, and Code Mode Only. Confirm `tools.codeModeOnly` is no longer present in the settings schema.
5. Start with `--safe-mode` or `--bare` while either code mode is configured and confirm the effective mode is `direct`.

Automated verification completed: focused Core tests (121 tests), focused CLI tests (585 tests), a repeated settings-schema regression run (60 tests), full build, full typecheck, full lint, and both installed and branch-built CLI version smoke checks.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: Settings exposed `Code Mode Only (Experimental)` as a boolean with `false` / `true`.

After: Settings exposes `Tool Mode (Experimental)` as an enum displaying Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only. Updated TUI snapshots cover the default display.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node.js v24.18.0; local source build and package-level Vitest suites.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Hybrid mode adds a short nested-call declaration to each ordinary tool description, increasing prompt size slightly; complete schemas are not duplicated in the `exec` description.
- Not validated / out of scope: Live-provider interactive runs and Windows/Linux local execution were not tested; CI covers supported platforms.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: `tools.codeModeOnly` is removed. Replace `{ "tools": { "codeModeOnly": true } }` with `{ "tools": { "mode": "code_mode_only" } }`.

## Linked Issues

Related to #10377.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增与 Codex 对齐的 `tools.mode` 枚举，支持 `direct`、`code_mode` 和 `code_mode_only`。`code_mode` 在保留普通工具直接调用能力的同时提供隔离的 `exec` JavaScript 工具；每个可见普通工具会携带自己的嵌套 JavaScript 声明，而 `exec` 保留精简的 `ALL_TOOLS` 元数据。`code_mode_only` 保持严格的普通工具仅经 `exec` 调用模式，`direct` 仍为默认值。

更新经过过滤的子智能体工具面，使直接声明和 `exec` 嵌套 binding 遵守同一组 allowlist；在设置界面中将该枚举显示为 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only；重新生成 settings JSON schema；并彻底移除原来的 `tools.codeModeOnly` 布尔设置。

新增同步的[英文](docs/design/code-mode.md)和[中文](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md)设计文档，并将现有 CodeModeOnly 设计补齐为仓库要求的双语文档（[英文](docs/design/code-mode-only.md)、[中文](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)）。

## 为什么需要

Qwen Code 此前只提供默认的直接工具面或严格的 CodeModeOnly 工具面。模型无法在简单操作中使用直接调用，同时在多工具工作流中使用 `exec` 编排。三值枚举与 Codex 的 `ToolMode` 命名一致，并为所有支持的暴露模式提供一个明确的统一设置项。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 不设置 `tools.mode` 或将其设为 `direct`，重启 Qwen Code，确认普通工具仍可用且不存在 `exec`。
2. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode` 并重启，确认普通工具和 `exec` 同时可用；确认普通工具描述包含各自的 `tools.<name>(args)` 声明，延迟工具仍可通过 `tool_search` 发现。
3. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode_only` 并重启，确认普通工具通过 `exec` 而不是顶层调用使用，同时直接控制工具仍然可用。
4. 打开设置界面，确认 Tool Mode 可在 Default、Code Mode 和 Code Mode Only 之间切换，并确认 settings schema 中不再存在 `tools.codeModeOnly`。
5. 配置任一 code mode 后用 `--safe-mode` 或 `--bare` 启动，确认有效模式为 `direct`。

已完成自动化验证：Core 相关测试（121 个）、CLI 相关测试（585 个）、再次运行的 settings schema 回归测试（60 个）、完整 build、完整 typecheck、完整 lint，以及已安装版本和分支构建版本的 CLI 版本 smoke 检查。

### 前后对比证据

之前：设置界面以 `false` / `true` 布尔值展示 `Code Mode Only (Experimental)`。

之后：设置界面以枚举展示 `Tool Mode (Experimental)`，可选 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only。更新后的 TUI snapshot 覆盖默认显示。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

macOS、Node.js v24.18.0；本地源码构建和 package 级 Vitest 测试套件。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：混合模式会在每个普通工具描述中增加一段简短的嵌套调用声明，使 prompt 略微增大；完整 schema 不会在 `exec` 描述中重复。
- 未验证 / 范围外：未进行真实 provider 的交互式运行，也未在 Windows/Linux 本地执行；支持平台由 CI 覆盖。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：`tools.codeModeOnly` 已移除。请将 `{ "tools": { "codeModeOnly": true } }` 替换为 `{ "tools": { "mode": "code_mode_only" } }`。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #10377。

</details>

prs.title: refactor(acp)!: remove MessageRewriteMiddleware
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Removes `MessageRewriteMiddleware`, the stopgap that rewrote ACP replies with an extra model call. Mods now rewrite how reply blocks and thoughts read in the Ink and OpenTUI terminals and the Web Shell (#17718, #17920), through the hook-based route the middleware's own README asked for, so the middleware has no remaining job.

- **Removed:** the middleware, its settings reader and its model-call rewriter, with their tests; every optional call in the ACP session, the message emitters and the history replayer; and the channel bridges' skip of messages marked `_meta.rewritten`. The bridges run with the CLI of the same install (one spawns its own child, the other talks to the daemon of the same install), so that marker can no longer reach them. The lint allowlist entries for the deleted files go too.
- **Kept:** the VS Code companion's handling of the marker, since the companion ships separately and may talk to an older CLI. Only its comments change, to say that older CLIs emit it.
- **Renamed:** the session's `installRewriter` only loads Mods now, so it becomes `installMods`, including the older design and plan notes that name it.
- **Tests:** five session tests used the middleware's wait as a pause point to land a cancellation or a newer prompt at the end of a turn. Each now pauses at the next real step on the same path, either the history write that keeps the ended tool batch or stop message, or the end of the model's response stream. Each still fails when the check it guards is removed. One test that only covered the middleware is deleted, and four more drop their dependence on it and keep their other assertions.

Design doc: [English](docs/design/2026-11-23-remove-message-rewrite-middleware.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-23-remove-message-rewrite-middleware.zh-CN.md). The earlier Mod designs that listed the removal as a later step now point to it.

## Why it's needed

The middleware was added as a temporary way to rewrite what users see, and its README asked for a hook-based replacement. The Mod `ui.render` sites are that replacement and do more: they rewrite each block for display only, spend a model call only on what someone sees, answer reloads from a cache, and work in every Qwen Code interface. The middleware reached only clients that understood its marker (the Web Shell and the SDK never did), yet it cost every ACP turn: optional calls in more than ten places, awaits on the default path even when it was off, and a setting outside the settings schema.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run an ACP session (the Web Shell, or `qwen --acp` from an ACP client) with and without a `messageRewrite` object in settings: the two behave the same, no message carries `_meta.rewritten`, and the debug log reports the key as an unknown setting.
- In the Web Shell, Mod rewrites of replies and thoughts keep working as before.

Checks run locally:

- The full ACP session test file (1,619 tests), the ACP agent, worktree, emitter and history replayer tests (1,155 + 1), and the channel bridge tests (248) pass.
- The five re-gated race tests each fail under a mutation of their guard: the cancellation check before the loop-protection error, the clearing of the tool phase, the abort-aware stop reason, the cancellation check when the Stop loop starts, and the ownership check before resetting the newer prompt's state.
- CLI and channel typecheck, lint and formatting pass. A whole-tree search finds no reference to the middleware, its settings reader or `installRewriter` outside historical design notes and the companion's comments.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A: no user-visible change in the terminals or the Web Shell. The behaviour change is limited to sessions that set the undocumented `messageRewrite` key, described under Risk & Scope.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux, Node 22, targeted vitest runs.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the five awaits removed from the default path yielded on every ACP turn even with the middleware off, so turn timing shifts slightly for all ACP sessions; the full session and agent test files cover it.
- Not validated / out of scope: a replacement in the VS Code companion, which draws no Mod rows; migrating `messageRewrite` settings to a Mod; macOS and Windows.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the undocumented `messageRewrite` setting is now ignored. VS Code companion users who set it lose the rewritten summaries, with no replacement in that client. In the terminals and the Web Shell, a Mod's `ui.render` hook on `AssistantMessage` and `Thinking` replaces it; the Mods guide has a worked example (#18150).

Design doc: [English](docs/design/2026-11-23-remove-message-rewrite-middleware.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-23-remove-message-rewrite-middleware.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Part of #13749

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

移除 `MessageRewriteMiddleware`，即用一次额外模型调用改写 ACP 回复的临时方案。Mod 现在能在 Ink、OpenTUI 终端和 Web Shell 中改写回复块和思考的显示（#17718、#17920），走的正是这个中间件自己的 README 所期望的基于 hook 的方案，所以它已经没有用处了。

- **移除：** 中间件、它的设置读取和调用模型的改写器，以及它们的测试；ACP 会话、消息 emitter 和历史回放器中所有可选调用；channel 桥对带 `_meta.rewritten` 标记消息的跳过。channel 桥与同一安装的 CLI 一起运行（一个拉起自己的子进程，另一个连接同一安装的 daemon），这个标记再也到不了它们。被删文件在 lint 白名单中的条目也一并删除。
- **保留：** VS Code companion 对这个标记的处理，因为 companion 单独发布，可能连接较旧的 CLI。只修改了它的注释，说明是较旧的 CLI 才会发出这个标记。
- **改名：** 会话的 `installRewriter` 现在只加载 Mod，因此改名为 `installMods`，提到它的旧设计和计划文档也一起更新。
- **测试：** 有五个会话测试曾把中间件的等待当作暂停点，在回合结束时插入取消或更新的 prompt。现在每个测试都改为在同一路径的下一个真实步骤暂停：保存已结束工具批次或停止提示的历史写入，或模型回复流的结束。去掉各自保护的检查后，这些测试仍会失败。只覆盖中间件的一个测试被删除，另外四个去掉了对中间件的依赖，保留了其余断言。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-11-23-remove-message-rewrite-middleware.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-23-remove-message-rewrite-middleware.zh-CN.md)。之前把移除列为后续步骤的 Mod 设计文档现在都指向它。

## 为什么需要

这个中间件是作为改写用户所见内容的临时方案加入的，它的 README 希望换成基于 hook 的方案。Mod 的 `ui.render` 站点就是那个替代方案，而且做得更多：按块只改显示、只为有人看到的内容花模型调用、刷新时由缓存作答，并在 Qwen Code 的各个界面中都能用。这个中间件只对认识它标记的客户端有效（Web Shell 和 SDK 从来不认），却让每个 ACP 回合付出代价：十多处可选调用、即使关闭时默认路径上也有 `await`，以及一个不在设置 schema 中的设置。

## 审查测试计划

### 如何验证

- 分别在设置中有和没有 `messageRewrite` 对象的情况下运行 ACP 会话（Web Shell，或由 ACP 客户端启动的 `qwen --acp`）：两者表现一致，没有消息带 `_meta.rewritten`，debug 日志把这个键报告为未知设置。
- 在 Web Shell 中，Mod 对回复和思考的改写照常工作。

本地运行的检查：

- 完整的 ACP 会话测试文件（1,619 个测试）、ACP agent、worktree、emitter 和历史回放器测试（1,155 + 1 个），以及 channel 桥测试（248 个）全部通过。
- 重新设置暂停点的五个竞态测试，在各自保护的检查被变异后都会失败：抛出循环保护错误前的取消检查、工具阶段的清除、感知中止的停止原因、Stop 循环开始时的取消检查，以及重置较新 prompt 状态前的归属检查。
- CLI 和 channel 的类型检查、lint 和格式检查通过。全仓库搜索确认，除历史设计记录和 companion 的注释外，不再有对中间件、它的设置读取或 `installRewriter` 的引用。

### 证据（改动前后）

N/A：终端和 Web Shell 中没有用户可见的变化。行为变化只影响设置了未写入文档的 `messageRewrite` 键的会话，见"风险与范围"。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

Linux，Node 22，定向 vitest 运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：从默认路径上移除的五处 `await` 即使中间件关闭也会在每个 ACP 回合让出一次，所以所有 ACP 会话的回合时序会略有变化；完整的会话和 agent 测试文件覆盖了这一点。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：VS Code companion 中的替代方案（它不绘制 Mod 行）；把 `messageRewrite` 设置迁移成 Mod；macOS 和 Windows。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：未写入文档的 `messageRewrite` 设置现在被忽略。设置了它的 VS Code companion 用户会失去改写摘要，在该客户端中没有替代。在终端和 Web Shell 中，用一个在 `AssistantMessage` 和 `Thinking` 上的 Mod `ui.render` hook 代替；Mods 指南中有完整示例（#18150）。

## 关联 Issue

Part of #13749

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): confine selected Hosted Workspace Shell
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an opt-in foreground Shell profile for built-in Hosted Agent Sessions bound to the root of a registered Workspace on durable, Session-exclusive Linux local Runtimes. Bubblewrap gives each command a read-only private image, the selected Workspace at `/workspace`, private temporary storage, and closed networking. The Broker and worker reject unsupported tools or contexts with typed errors. Failed confinement qualification blocks execution.

The Broker persists the original Runtime's cgroup v2 identity before the worker can run tools. Normal handback checks that the worker closed the Session's execution gates and is the original cgroup's sole member. Terminal drain can stop the original cgroup after the worker dies and clears Workspace ownership only after it records matching stop evidence.

## Why it's needed

The existing Bubblewrap profile permits some reads from the host filesystem. Proving that a worker PID exited also leaves open whether its descendants can still write to the Workspace. Hosted needs a private execution boundary and a stop proof the Broker can verify independently, so it can safely return Workspace ownership after a worker failure.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Configure `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.provider-options.private-rootfs` with a trusted read-only image containing `/bin/sh` and set `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.provider-options.cgroup-root` to a dedicated, writable cgroup v2 delegation. Use an unprivileged service account, a durable Session-exclusive Linux local Runtime, and verified Workspace storage. Confirm that a new root-bound Session advertises foreground Shell only and that two successive Shell turns can each release their Workspace claim.
2. Confirm that Shell can write its own Workspace and cannot see a host sentinel. Try a subdirectory Session and verify `managed_runtime_confinement_denied`. With confinement enabled, verify that an existing ordinary Session on a covered local placement can complete cleanup and is refused new Runtime work.
3. Kill the original worker while a test-owned process remains in its cgroup. Verify that early handback retains ownership, then close the Session. The Broker should stop the remaining process, persist a receipt for the original cgroup, and clear the holder. Check that a same-name replacement cgroup supplies neither stop authority nor stop evidence.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before, the earlier Linux qualification run confirmed that the existing Bubblewrap adapter could read a test-owned sentinel outside the Workspace. The private-root adapter blocked access to that sentinel and the sibling Workspace, and the fixture observed closed networking.
- After, the public Hosted Linux test completed two Shell turns, rejected a subdirectory Session, and closed the Session after stopping the original cgroup with the worker already gone. Maven reported one passing Hosted end-to-end case and three passing Linux cgroup regression cases, including replacement-identity refusal. The Hosted test reactor reported zero Checkstyle violations.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Linux ARM64 with Node.js 22, Temurin JDK 21, Bubblewrap 0.8.0, delegated cgroup v2, and MySQL 8.4.11. The public API test ran a real Broker, packaged Harness and worker, with a fixture model. On macOS ARM64, the repository build, typecheck, bundle and scoped lint passed, and focused Vitest runs reported 1,888 passes and 14 platform skips.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff** Missing or conflicting stop evidence keeps the Workspace holder in place. An already LOST binding with a populated cgroup requires operator recovery before ownership can be released.
- **Not validated / out of scope** Full CI and cold recovery after removing the opt-in settings were outside the final local run. The confined profile is limited to foreground Shell. Native file tools, MCP, hooks, executable extensions, and background processes remain outside this profile.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes** Confinement is off by default. Drain affected local leases before enabling it or changing the image. Existing ordinary Sessions on covered placements can complete cleanup and cannot start new Runtime work while confinement is enabled. The shared V1 baseline now indexes version-3 local recovery candidates. Recreate earlier development catalogs under the existing V1 policy.
- **Design documents** Private root [English](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/2cccc3c85497c756fd03762e01985642dc5ff42d/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-21-managed-private-root-bwrap.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/2cccc3c85497c756fd03762e01985642dc5ff42d/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-21-managed-private-root-bwrap.zh-CN.md), stop proof [English](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/2cccc3c85497c756fd03762e01985642dc5ff42d/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-21-managed-local-cgroup-stop-proof.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/2cccc3c85497c756fd03762e01985642dc5ff42d/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-21-managed-local-cgroup-stop-proof.zh-CN.md), Hosted integration [简体中文](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/2cccc3c85497c756fd03762e01985642dc5ff42d/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-21-managed-hosted-confinement.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Refs #15081, #14667, and #12380.

---


<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

新增显式启用的 Hosted 前台 Shell 档案，适用于绑定到已注册 Workspace 根目录的内置 Agent Session，要求 Linux 本地 Runtime 支持持久化并由 Session 独占。Bubblewrap 为每条命令提供只读私有镜像、挂载到 `/workspace` 的选定 Workspace、私有临时目录和关闭的网络。Broker 与 Worker 对不支持的工具或上下文返回类型化错误。隔离资格校验失败时拒绝执行。

Broker 在 Worker 获准执行工具前，持久化原 Runtime 的 cgroup v2 身份。正常交还会验证 Worker 已关闭该 Session 的执行准入，且原 cgroup 中只剩原 Worker。Worker 死亡后，终态排空仍可停止原 cgroup，Broker 在记录匹配的停止证据后才释放 Workspace 所有权。

## Why it's needed

现有 Bubblewrap 档案允许读取部分宿主文件。仅证明 Worker PID 已退出，仍无法确定它的后代是否可以继续写入 Workspace。Hosted 需要私有执行边界和 Broker 可独立验证的停止证明，才能在 Worker 故障后安全交还 Workspace 所有权。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. 将 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.provider-options.private-rootfs` 设置为包含 `/bin/sh` 的受信只读镜像，将 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.provider-options.cgroup-root` 设置为专用、可写的 cgroup v2 委派目录。使用非特权服务账号、持久化且由 Session 独占的 Linux 本地 Runtime，以及身份经过验证的 Workspace 存储。确认新的根目录 Session 只声明前台 Shell，连续两个 Shell 回合各自都能交还 Workspace 占用。
2. 确认 Shell 可以写入自己的 Workspace，且无法看到宿主哨兵文件。尝试创建绑定到子目录的 Session，确认收到 `managed_runtime_confinement_denied`。启用隔离后，验证受覆盖位置上的已有普通 Session 能完成清理，并被拒绝发起新的 Runtime 工作。
3. 在原 cgroup 内保留一个测试进程，然后杀掉原 Worker。确认提前交还仍保留所有权，再关闭 Session。Broker 应停止剩余进程，为原 cgroup 持久化回执，并清除 holder。检查同名替换 cgroup 既无法作为停止操作的授权目标，也不能作为停止证据。

### Evidence (Before & After)

- 变更前，早期 Linux 资格测试确认现有 Bubblewrap 适配器能读取 Workspace 之外的测试哨兵文件。私有根适配器阻断了对该文件和相邻 Workspace 的访问，测试也确认网络关闭。
- 变更后，公开 Hosted API 的 Linux 测试完成两个 Shell 回合，拒绝了子目录 Session，并在 Worker 已死亡的情况下停止原 cgroup、关闭 Session。Maven 报告 1 项 Hosted 端到端用例和 3 项 Linux cgroup 回归通过，包括拒绝替换身份的用例。Hosted 测试的 Maven reactor 报告 Checkstyle 零违规。

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Linux ARM64、Node.js 22、Temurin JDK 21、Bubblewrap 0.8.0、委派的 cgroup v2 和 MySQL 8.4.11。公开 API 测试使用真实 Broker、打包后的 Harness 与 Worker，并使用测试模型桩。在 macOS ARM64 上，仓库构建、类型检查、打包和针对性 lint 均通过。针对性的 Vitest 共通过 1,888 项，另有 14 项因平台条件跳过。

## Risk & Scope

- **主要风险或取舍** 停止证据缺失或冲突时保留 Workspace holder。已处于 LOST 状态且 cgroup 仍有进程的绑定，需要先经过运维恢复才能释放所有权。
- **未验证或不在范围内** 最终本地验证未覆盖全量 CI 或移除启用配置后的冷恢复。隔离档案仅支持前台 Shell。原生文件工具、MCP、Hook、可执行扩展和后台进程均不在此档案范围内。
- **不兼容变更与迁移说明** 隔离默认关闭。启用隔离或更换镜像前，先排空受影响的本地租约。启用期间，受覆盖位置上的已有普通 Session 可完成清理，新的 Runtime 工作会被拒绝。共享 V1 基线已将版本 3 本地 Runtime 纳入恢复候选索引，按现有 V1 策略重建早期开发库。
- **设计文档** 私有根 [English](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/2cccc3c85497c756fd03762e01985642dc5ff42d/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-21-managed-private-root-bwrap.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/2cccc3c85497c756fd03762e01985642dc5ff42d/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-21-managed-private-root-bwrap.zh-CN.md)，停止证明 [English](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/2cccc3c85497c756fd03762e01985642dc5ff42d/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-21-managed-local-cgroup-stop-proof.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/2cccc3c85497c756fd03762e01985642dc5ff42d/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-21-managed-local-cgroup-stop-proof.zh-CN.md)，Hosted 接入 [简体中文](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/2cccc3c85497c756fd03762e01985642dc5ff42d/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-21-managed-hosted-confinement.zh-CN.md)。

prs.title: fix(cli): resolve escaped @-paths from completion and drag-and-drop on Windows
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Fixes Windows handling of backslash-escaped `@` file references emitted by `@` autocomplete and drag-and-drop so files and directories containing spaces or shell metacharacters (such as parentheses or leading `#`) resolve reliably across prompt submission, nested `@` completion, pasted-path detection, ACP image path extraction, and input highlighting.

On Windows, each `@` consumer tries the literal path first and only falls back when the literal path does not exist (`ENOENT`). A single-pass O(n) unescaper preserves drive roots and UNC prefixes without full unescaping, adds a fully unescaped candidate for bare leading-backslash relative paths (such as `\#notes.md` or `\(v2\)/a.md`) while keeping drive-relative candidates intact, tries separator-preserving candidates first (so paths like `C:\Users\John\ Doe\Docs\(draft\)\a.txt` resolve `Docs\(draft)\a.txt` ahead of any `Docs(draft)\a.txt` sibling), and only offers folded interior candidates when every shell metacharacter in the token is escaped. TUI prompt resolution and ACP text image extraction share the same `lstat`-based selector semantics (async and sync), skipping probe targets lexically outside each caller's allowed roots (via `isSubpath`, without calling `realpathSync`, so drive-root entries like `$RECYCLE.BIN` cannot shadow workspace-relative files while denied or dangling links inside the workspace still reach `lstat`) and returning the current candidate immediately on non-`ENOENT` errors (such as `EACCES`/`EPERM`) so existing per-path error/skip reporting runs instead of silently reading a sibling. Input highlighting mirrors the parser's backslash-escape rule so escaped metacharacters and Windows path separators remain inside one file token.

## Why it's needed

`@` autocomplete and drag-and-drop escape spaces and shell metacharacters with backslashes on all platforms, whereas the shared Windows path unescaper intentionally leaves backslashes untouched so literal paths do not lose their directory separators. Because downstream consumers only looked up the raw string containing backslashes, selecting a file like `测试 文档.md`, `设计稿 (终版).md`, or `#notes.md` from `@` autocomplete on Windows silently dropped the file on submit, continuing to type after completing a spaced directory returned zero nested suggestions, pasting an already-escaped path was ignored, and input highlighting broke mid-token on Windows separators and escaped parentheses.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In a workspace on Windows, create `测试 文档.md`, `设计稿 (终版).md`, `#notes.md`, `(v2)/a.md`, `report (1).md`, and `带空格 目录/笔记.md` alongside a plain `README.md`.
2. Start the interactive CLI, type `@测试` and accept the completion (`@测试\ 文档.md`), add a short prompt, and submit. Expect a `Read @测试 文档.md` card and the file contents attached to the request.
3. Repeat with `@设计稿` (`@设计稿\ \(终版\).md`), `@#notes` (`@\#notes.md`), and `@(v2)` (`@\(v2\)/a.md`) and submit. Expect each file to be read and attached to the request.
4. Type `@report\ \(1\).md` and `@C:\Users\demo\my\ file.txt` in the input box. Expect each entire path token to stay highlighted as a single file reference rather than splitting at `\` or `\(`.
5. Type `@带空格` and accept the directory completion (`@带空格\ 目录/`), then type `笔记`. Expect `带空格 目录/笔记.md` to appear in the completion dropdown.
6. Verify a literal folder whose name starts with a shell metacharacter (e.g. `dir\#v2\file.txt`) still resolves to `dir/#v2/file.txt` even when a sibling `dir#v2/file.txt` exists, that `C:\Users\John\ Doe\Docs\(draft\)\a.txt` resolves `Docs\(draft)\a.txt` ahead of a `Docs(draft)\a.txt` sibling and non-escaped forms like `C:\Users\John\ Doe\Docs\(draft)\a.txt` never fold into `Docs(draft)`, that an ignored literal file or a literal path whose probe fails with `EACCES`/`EPERM` never falls back to a sibling, and that an escaped path where neither candidate exists is skipped without error.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Real-terminal A/B verification on Windows 11 (ConPTY real-terminal harness against a local mock OpenAI server, checking both UI read cards and wire-level file payloads):

| Scenario | Before (`18ac669a3a`) | After (`6a80efe059`) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Control (`@README.md`) | File content received, `✓ Read` card shown | File content received, `✓ Read` card shown |
| Spaced Chinese file (`@测试\ 文档.md`) | File silently dropped (`received: false`, no read card) | File content received, `✓ Read @测试 文档.md` shown |
| Parenthesized file (`@设计稿\ \(终版\).md`) | File silently dropped (`received: false`, no read card) | File content received, `✓ Read @设计稿 (终版).md` shown |
| Nested completion (`@带空格\ 目录/笔记`) | No suggestions shown | Dropdown suggests `带空格 目录/笔记.md` |

Screenshots (the title bar shows the commit each build came from):

| | Before (`18ac669a3a`) | After (`6a80efe059`) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Spaced Chinese file | ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Plastic-time/qwen-code/rrfz/pr-assets-at-space-win/before-01-space-file-18ac669a3a.png) | ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Plastic-time/qwen-code/rrfz/pr-assets-at-space-win/after-01-space-file-6a80efe059.png) |
| Parenthesized file | ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Plastic-time/qwen-code/rrfz/pr-assets-at-space-win/before-02-parens-file-18ac669a3a.png) | ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Plastic-time/qwen-code/rrfz/pr-assets-at-space-win/after-02-parens-file-6a80efe059.png) |
| Nested completion | ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Plastic-time/qwen-code/rrfz/pr-assets-at-space-win/before-03-nested-dir-completion-18ac669a3a.png) | ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Plastic-time/qwen-code/rrfz/pr-assets-at-space-win/after-03-nested-dir-completion-6a80efe059.png) |

Unit tests (run from `packages/cli`, the same six full test files on both commits):

```
npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts src/ui/components/shared/text-buffer.test.ts src/ui/hooks/atCommandProcessor.test.ts src/ui/hooks/useAtCompletion.test.ts src/ui/utils/at-path-candidates.test.ts src/ui/utils/highlight.test.ts
```

- Base `18ac669a3a` with this PR's test files: all 6 files fail, 16 failed / 1923 passed / 14 skipped. `at-path-candidates.test.ts` cannot load because the helper does not exist on base, so its cases are not counted.
- This PR `6a80efe059`: 6 files pass, 1952 passed / 14 skipped.
- `ab-call` against base's built `highlight.js` splits `@report\ \(1\)\[v2\]\&final.md`, `@C:\Users\demo\my\ file.txt` and `@\\server\share\my\ file.txt` mid-token.
- `npm run build` and `tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli` exited 0, ESLint/Prettier passed with 0 warnings, and `mutate_lines --base 18ac669a3a` generated 87 statement-level mutants across the six touched production files (76 in `at-path-candidates.ts`, 5 in `useAtCompletion.ts`, 6 in `text-buffer.ts`; the remaining three production files have only import/expression edits) with 87/87 caught. All consumer suites inject multi-candidate sets in cross-platform cases so literal-first precedence, fallback, quoted paste, ignore preservation, abort, and `EACCES`/`EPERM` invariants also run and fail on regression on Linux PR CI.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Windows 11 (`win32`), Node.js v24.20.0, base commit `18ac669a3a`, fix commit `6a80efe059`. Verified via `npm run build`, `tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli`, targeted Vitest suites, mutation testing (`mutate_lines`), and interactive ConPTY A/B capture.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Scoped strictly to `packages/cli` with no changes to `packages/core` or the shared path unescaper. On non-Windows platforms, candidate resolution returns only the input path with zero behavioral change. On Windows, existing literal paths and separator-preserving candidates are checked via shared `lstat`/`lstatSync` selection within each caller's allowed workspace boundary before workspace, ignore, and media re-anchor checks run unchanged, and non-`ENOENT` errors stop fallback immediately so ignore rules, workspace boundaries, and per-path error reporting cannot be bypassed.
- Not validated / out of scope: Native macOS/Linux terminal runs were not executed (POSIX single-candidate behavior and consumer multi-candidate selection invariants are covered by platform-independent unit tests). OpenTUI was not run interactively (it shares the same `@` command resolution pipeline). Non-ASCII path highlighting in the input box remains unchanged and out of scope for this PR. Non-recursive directory search (`path.dirname` in `packages/core`'s `DirectoryFileSearch`) is unchanged and out of scope here (CLI completion relies on multi-candidate fallback when the literal search returns no results). When a literal path whose segment starts with a shell metacharacter does not exist on disk and a folded sibling does exist (for example `@C:\work\Docs\#v2\a.txt` when only `Docs#v2\a.txt` exists), the folded candidate can still match because core's `escapePath` encodes `Docs#v2\a.txt` identically to `Docs\#v2\a.txt`; existing literal paths and separator-preserving nested folders are always preferred first.
- Overlap with my other open PRs: #18145 touches the same import block in `atCommandProcessor.ts` and appends tests to `atCommandProcessor.test.ts`; #18153 edits the pasted-path block in `text-buffer.ts` and its tests. Whichever merges later gets a textual conflict in those spots. The logic changes do not overlap.

## 本次 PR 做了什么

修复 Windows 下 `@` 自动补全和文件拖放产生的反斜杠转义路径无法生效的问题，使包含空格或 shell 元字符（如括号、首段 `#`）的文件与目录在消息提交、嵌套 `@` 补全、已转义路径粘贴识别、ACP 图片 `@` 路径提取以及输入框高亮中都能正确解析。

在 Windows 上，各 `@` 消费端会优先按字面路径查找，仅在字面路径不存在（`ENOENT`）时才回退。新增的单遍 O(n) 反转义逻辑会保留盘符根和 UNC 前缀不做完全反转义；对以裸反斜杠开头的相对路径（例如 `\#notes.md`、`\(v2\)/a.md`）额外提供完全反转义候选且保留驱动器相对路径候选；优先生成保留中间目录分隔符的候选（使 `C:\Users\John\ Doe\Docs\(draft\)\a.txt` 优先命中 `Docs\(draft)\a.txt` 而非兄弟目录 `Docs(draft)\a.txt`），并仅在 token 中全部 shell 元字符均被转义时才补充折叠候选。TUI 提示解析与 ACP 文本图片提取共用同一套基于 `lstat`/`lstatSync` 的异步与同步选择器，通过纯词法 `isSubpath`（不调用 `realpathSync`）跳过落在各自允许根目录之外的探测目标（既防止盘符根目录同名条目如 `$RECYCLE.BIN` 遮蔽工作区相对文件，也确保工作区内的拒绝 ACL 或悬空链接照常进入 `lstat`），并在遇到非 `ENOENT` 错误（如 `EACCES`/`EPERM`）时立即返回当前候选，交给各自原有的报错/跳过逻辑，避免静默误读兄弟文件。输入框高亮也改为镜像解析器的反斜杠转义规则，使转义元字符与 Windows 路径分隔符保持在同一文件引用 span 内。

## 为什么需要这个改动

`@` 自动补全和拖放会在所有平台上用反斜杠转义空格与 shell 元字符，但共享的 Windows 路径反转义逻辑为了避免破坏字面路径分隔符特意保留反斜杠。由于下游消费端只拿包含反斜杠的原始字符串去查文件，用户在 Windows 上通过 `@` 选中 `测试 文档.md`、`设计稿 (终版).md` 或 `#notes.md` 提交后文件会被静默丢弃，补全带空格目录后继续输入查不到子文件，粘贴已转义的路径无法识别，且带 Windows 分隔符或转义括号的路径在输入框中高亮会中途断裂。

## 评审测试方案

### 如何验证

1. 在 Windows 工作区中创建 `测试 文档.md`、`设计稿 (终版).md`、`#notes.md`、`(v2)/a.md`、`report (1).md`、`带空格 目录/笔记.md` 以及普通文件 `README.md`。
2. 启动交互式 CLI，输入 `@测试` 并接受补全（`@测试\ 文档.md`），附带一句简短提示后提交。预期显示 `Read @测试 文档.md` 卡片，且请求中附带该文件内容。
3. 对 `@设计稿`（`@设计稿\ \(终版\).md`）、`@#notes`（`@\#notes.md`）和 `@(v2)`（`@\(v2\)/a.md`）重复上述步骤并提交。预期每个文件都能正确读取并附带到请求中。
4. 在输入框中输入 `@report\ \(1\).md` 和 `@C:\Users\demo\my\ file.txt`。预期整段路径保持为一个完整的文件引用高亮，不再在 `\` 或 `\(` 处断开。

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): name why a waiting Turn cannot park
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This is Stage 0 of the proposal in #18149. It makes Action parking say why a waiting Turn stays resident, and it puts the Session-shape conditions that parking and cold recovery must agree on into one place.

Cold recovery checks the same three Session-shape conditions before it resumes an approval continuation: the Session has no Hooks, has no MCP, and has a tool owner. These conditions are now one shared function, called by park eligibility and by both cold-recovery entry points (the takeover load and the resident redrive). Journal-state conditions, such as finding the saved continuation and the original Prompt, were already shared helpers. The conditions under which parking is stricter than recovery stay specific to parking: child Sessions, wake-started Turns, command-step approvals and the grant capabilities. Later stages remove them one at a time.

Park eligibility now returns a typed reason for every waiting Turn it refuses, and the Harness counts those reasons per suspension attempt in its suspension stats, next to the existing Phase 1 counters.

Previously, a wait whose recovery plan was never captured did not register at all, so eligibility could not see it. This covered Hooks, MCP, a Shell profile, an unsupported tool and an oversize plan. Now the plan producer reports why it declined, and every durable wait registers. A wait that can never park registers with that reason and a freeze that always refuses. An extension command-step wait registers as a command-step refusal.

## Why it's needed

Every later stage of #18149 relaxes one eligibility condition. With two copies of those conditions, each relaxation was another chance for parking and recovery to disagree. Parking a wait that recovery then refuses is worse than staying resident.

The stage order in #18149 is also only a code-level estimate. The refusal counts are the data needed to reorder it by real-load share and to answer that issue's open question about Shell-before-dispatch and oversize plans. Before this change, the most common reasons were not countable at all.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Park and recovery decisions are unchanged:

- With parking not advertised, an approval wait stays resident, and the counts record the missing capability.
- A Prompt with no text stays resident, and the counts record the missing Prompt text.
- A write approval on a Shell profile stays resident, and the counts record only the Shell-profile reason.
- Every existing park, resume, deny, expiry and re-park case still passes.

The rewritten eligibility check splits one compound condition into ordered checks. Ordering decides only which reason is reported, never whether the wait parks.

The one place to scrutinize is a new condition: park eligibility now also requires a tool owner, which cold recovery already required. Any path that can register a parkable wait already has a tool owner, because capturing a continuation needs a runtime from the Broker or a memory-only batch. And if the condition ever did fire, recovery would have refused that park anyway.

Locally green on Linux:

- the full `hosted-harness-session` suite (885 cases), with its idle-suspension group re-run on the final code;
- the 25 other test files that exercise the changed tool-turn and parking code (1899 cases);
- the approval, question-wait, suspension and turn-cleanup suites (107 cases);
- the new unit test for the shared function;
- ESLint and Prettier on the changed files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change (Harness eligibility and counters).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit and integration tests only, no live deployment.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff:** more waits now register with the park registry. A wait that can never park registers with a refusal and a freeze that always refuses, and is unregistered in its own cleanup, so it can never be frozen or sealed.
- **Not validated / out of scope:**
  - The full workspace typecheck could not run on the test machine: the CLI package's typecheck ran out of memory at a 3.5 GB heap. A narrower typecheck rooted at the changed files reports the same 14 errors as the unmodified baseline, all in unrelated files and apparently from stale built workspace packages; no error is in a changed file. CI's typecheck is the authoritative check.
  - The suspension stats are still read only in process, by tests. Exposing them to operators is a separate prerequisite shared by every Phase 1 measurement, so this PR does not do it.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** none. No wire, schema or configuration change.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

这是 #18149 提案的阶段 0。它让审批停靠能说明一个等待中的 Turn 为什么保持常驻，并把停靠与冷恢复必须一致的 Session 形态条件放到一处。

冷恢复在恢复审批 continuation 之前，会检查同样三项 Session 形态条件：Session 没有 Hooks、没有 MCP、有工具 owner。这三项现在合成一个共享函数，由停靠资格和两个冷恢复入口（接管加载与常驻 redrive）共同调用。journal 状态条件，比如找到保存的 continuation 和原始 Prompt，本来就是共享的辅助函数。停靠比恢复更严的条件仍然只属于停靠：子 Session、wake 启动的 Turn、command-step 审批，以及 grant 能力位。后续阶段会逐项删掉它们。

停靠资格现在会为每个被拒的等待中 Turn 返回带类型的原因，Harness 按每次挂起尝试把这些原因计入挂起统计，与第一阶段已有的计数放在一起。

以前，恢复计划没被捕获的等待根本不会登记，资格判断看不到它们。这包括 Hooks、MCP、Shell profile、不支持的工具和超大计划。现在计划生产者会报告拒绝原因，每个持久化等待都会登记。永远不能停靠的等待带着这个原因登记，它的 freeze 总是拒绝。extension command-step 等待以 command-step 原因登记。

## 为什么需要

#18149 的每个后续阶段都要放宽一项资格条件。条件存在两份时，每次放宽都可能让停靠和恢复的判断不一致。停靠了一个恢复会拒绝的等待，比保持常驻更糟。

#18149 中的阶段顺序也只是代码级估算。按真实负载占比调整顺序，以及回答该 issue 关于派发前 Shell 和超大计划的开放问题，都需要这份拒绝计数。在这次改动之前，最常见的几种原因根本无法计数。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

停靠与恢复的判断都没有改变：

- 未公告停靠能力时，审批等待保持常驻，计数记下缺少能力位。
- 没有文字的 Prompt 保持常驻，计数记下缺少 Prompt 文字。
- Shell profile 下的写入审批保持常驻，计数只记下 Shell profile 这一个原因。
- 既有的停靠、恢复、拒绝、到期和再次停靠用例都照常通过。

重写后的资格检查把一个复合条件拆成了按顺序的检查。顺序只决定报告哪个原因，不影响等待是否停靠。

唯一需要仔细审查的是一个新条件：停靠资格现在也要求有工具 owner，这一项冷恢复本来就要求。任何能登记可停靠等待的路径都已经有工具 owner，因为捕获 continuation 需要来自 Broker 的 runtime，或者一个仅含 memory 的批次。即使这个条件真的被触发，恢复那边本来也会拒绝这次停靠。

本地在 Linux 上通过：

- `hosted-harness-session` 全套（885 例），其中 idle-suspension 组在最终代码上又跑了一遍；
- 覆盖改动的工具 Turn 与停靠代码的另外 25 个测试文件（1899 例）；
- 审批、提问等待、挂起与 Turn 清理测试（107 例）；
- 共享函数的新单元测试；
- 改动文件上的 ESLint 和 Prettier。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A —— 非 UI 改动（Harness 资格判断与计数）。

### 测试平台

🍏 macOS ⚠️ 未测；🪟 Windows ⚠️ 未测；🐧 Linux ✅。

### 环境

仅单元与集成测试，没有在实际部署中运行。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险/取舍：** 现在有更多等待会登记到停靠注册表。永远不能停靠的等待带着拒绝原因登记，它的 freeze 总是拒绝，并在自身清理时注销，因此它永远不会被冻结或盖 seal。
- **未验证/范围外：**
  - 测试机器上没能跑完整的 workspace 类型检查：CLI 包的类型检查在 3.5 GB 堆下内存溢出。以改动文件为入口的窄范围类型检查报出 14 个错误，与未改动的基线完全相同，都在无关文件里，看起来来自过期的已构建 workspace 包；改动文件中没有错误。以 CI 的类型检查为准。
  - 挂起统计仍然只在进程内由测试读取。把它暴露给运维是第一阶段所有测量共有的前置工作，本 PR 不做。
- **破坏性改动/迁移：** 无。没有 wire、schema 或配置改动。

设计：#18151 中覆盖面设计的阶段 0（P0），中英两版。

prs.title: refactor(managed-agent): de-hash identity columns with bounded VARCHAR and canonical refs
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR replaces the managed-agent identity-hash key layer with bounded text identities and reversible canonical references. Tenant and Session identity columns become budgeted `VARCHAR` columns with an explicit NO PAD collation, while overly wide or polymorphic cross-table identities use versioned, length-prefixed, ASCII-readable references instead of SHA-256 coordination keys. Admission, production SQL, row mappers, projections, schema-shape gates, and verification fixtures are migrated together so uniqueness, tenant isolation, idempotency, cursor order, and lock order remain explicit. Receipt minting, workspace/storage generated identities, extension/automation/CSI protocol IDs, content/commit/token digests, and binary payloads are preserved.

## Why it's needed

The previous schema stored many identity tuples as opaque hashes. That made tenant/session isolation and idempotency harder to audit, duplicated derivations across tables, and pushed several composite indexes toward InnoDB's key-width limit. The maintainer-approved design chooses a mixed representation: simple identities are readable bounded text, and wide/polymorphic references are reversible canonical tuples with fail-closed byte budgets. Every index is accepted at <= 3072 bytes. This keeps the coordination semantics while removing the identity-hash layer rather than merely renaming it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Reviewers should confirm that the de-hashed schema preserves the old coordination outcomes: registered-Session publication retention still restricts joins through the new monotonic marker; tenant-addressed operation retries still resolve to one operation; resource/operation/runtime references still enforce the same uniqueness; storage release still refuses a tampered alias scope; and identity equality remains case/trailing-space exact. The focused H2 suites below exercise schema/catalog/projection drift, core managed stores, runtime broker repositories, child-session admission, canonical reference encoding, and the storage-release fail-closed probe. MySQL-specific type/collation/index-width gates and race suites are included but require the CI MySQL lane because no local MySQL instance was available.

Local commands used JDK 21 and Maven 3.9.9 with an isolated repository:

`mvn -Dmaven.repo.local=/tmp/qwen-managed-dehash-m2 -Dtest=ManagedSchemaTest,ManagedSchemaCatalogTest,ManagedSchemaProjectionTest,ManagedSchemaBusinessStoreTest,ManagedSchemaSessionStoreTest,ToolPublicationRetentionStoreTest,ManagedSideQueryStoreTest,SessionResourceCollectionCollectorTest,ToolPublicationCollectorTest,ManagedExtensionRecordStoreTest,AutomationLedgerStoreTest,WorkspaceRecoveryStoreTest,WorkspaceCreationStoreTest,SshWorkspaceStoreTest,ChildResultRelayStoreTest,ManagedIdentityRefTest,ChildActorIdTest test`

Result: 420 tests, 0 failures, 4 errors, 4 skipped. The 4 errors are native-media tests that cannot spawn `node` in this environment; the skipped cases are MySQL-only witnesses.

Additional affected sweep:

`mvn -Dmaven.repo.local=/tmp/qwen-managed-dehash-m2 -Dtest=ToolPublicationStoreTest,ManagedArtifactReadIntegrationTest,ManagedMcpSettingsStoreTest,ManagedCwdChangeOperationTest,WorkspaceSessionRetentionTest,ManagedSchemaPublicationStoreTest,ManagedTurnQueryTest,ManagedApprovalChangeTest,SurfaceAdmissionAcceptanceTest,ManagedAgentApiContractTest,JdbcRepositoryTest,RuntimeBrokerFlywaySchemaTest,Issue13183RegressionTest,RuntimeExtensionMetadataControlTest,RuntimeExternalWorkspaceDrainTest test`

Result after fixes: 878 tests, 0 failures, 3 errors, 5 skipped. Two artifact fixture errors were fixed and re-verified green. The remaining local error is `ToolPublicationStoreTest.renewsTheOriginalClaimWhileScanningSlowObjectBytes`, a timing-sensitive claim-renewal probe that failed locally with the operation still PENDING; it needs CI confirmation and is not claimed as locally passed.

Final static gate:

`mvn -Dmaven.repo.local=/tmp/qwen-managed-dehash-m2 checkstyle:check checkstyle:check@runtime-broker-checkstyle`

Result: BUILD SUCCESS, 0 violations in both executions across all modules. Full production and verification test sources compile.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — persistence/schema refactor, no TUI change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅ focused H2 + dual Checkstyle; ⚠️ full H2/MySQL pending CI   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️ not tested   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️ not tested   |

### Environment (optional)

JDK 21.0.12.1, Maven 3.9.9 downloaded to a task-owned `/tmp` directory, isolated Maven repository cloned from the local cache. No local MySQL/Docker; native-media tests require `node` and built `packages/core/dist`, which are absent in this worktree.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: this is a large join-connected persistence refactor. Canonical reference tuples replace hash chains, so reviewers should focus on uniqueness preservation, cursor/lock-order equivalence, and fail-closed identity probes rather than only column renames.
- Not validated / out of scope: full H2 suite did not finish within the local 10-minute tool budget; MySQL 8.4 type/collation/index-width gates, race suites, and `ManagedSqlPerformanceMySqlIT` are pending CI. One timing-sensitive publication claim probe failed locally and is flagged above. TypeScript consumers that derive preserved protocol IDs were not changed.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: shared managed catalogs are expected to be recreated from V1; no V2+ migration is introduced. Over-budget identities now fail closed at admission or encode time. The synthetic child-Session actor is a bounded derived ID (`c:` + 32 hex) to stay inside the 36-character actor budget.

Design documents: [English](docs/design/2026-11-20-managed-identity-varchar-dehash.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-20-managed-identity-varchar-dehash.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

References the managed identity VARCHAR/de-hash design and implementation plan under `docs/design/` and `docs/plans/`; no GitHub issue is auto-closed.

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

评审应确认去哈希后的 schema 保留旧协调结果：publication retention 仍通过新的单调标记限制已登记 Session；tenant-addressed operation 重试仍只解析到一个 operation；resource/operation/runtime 引用仍强制相同唯一性；storage release 仍拒绝被篡改的 alias scope；身份等值仍区分大小写与尾随空格。上述 focused H2 套件覆盖 schema/catalog/projection 漂移、核心 managed stores、runtime broker repositories、子 Session admission、canonical reference 编码与 storage-release fail-closed 探针。MySQL 类型/collation/索引宽度门与竞态套件已包含，但需要 CI MySQL lane，因为本地没有 MySQL 实例。

### 证据（Before & After）

## 风险与范围
