<summary>Earlier R8 and R7 changes and validation</summary>

## Preceding R8 restriction follow-up

R8 head: [`2ba4b49d88`](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/commit/2ba4b49d8894c561b3ae5456ecc45611f544ca71), a normal follow-up to `0263003726`.

This addresses the active restriction findings in [R8](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17372#pullrequestreview-5941855049):

| Review item | Change and boundary |
| --- | --- |
| R8-1: an expanded argument suppresses a redirect restriction | An unavailable static view keeps a potentially applicable redirect restriction unresolved and requires confirmation. A static view with a different known target remains unrelated. |
| R8-3: heredoc bodies lose their delimiter | Quoted heredoc bodies are stripped before executable continuations are joined. Continued delimiter headers and the different continuation behavior of unquoted bodies have separate regressions. The following executable command remains visible to the operation tracker. |
| R8-5: unresolved file arguments bypass Read/Edit | Explicit file restrictions trigger confirmation for expanded arguments, including supported nested shell wrappers, bare pathname/brace expansions and named-home prefixes. Unknown paths stay unattributed; the tracker does not guess environment values. Quoted and escaped literal controls remain supported. |
| R8-6: bare home redirects disagree with the tracker | Only bare `~`/ `~/...` targets use the tracker's home directory. Quoted, escaped and partially quoted tilde prefixes remain literal, including adjacent redirects. Named-home targets stay unresolved. |
| Carried R4-1: additional execution entries | `source`, `.`, `trap` and `parallel` join the unmodeled-execution veto. This does not change source/dot cwd classification. No persistent grant is suggested for these entries. |
| Home-directory environment | `HOME` changes join the execution-affecting environment guard. Prefixes that clear HOME carry that uncertainty into the existing child-shell recursion, including nested or encoded payloads; ordinary env commands, absolute targets and quoted literal tilde controls remain supported. |

The preceding fixes for cwd success/failure flow, wrapper payloads, empty arguments, parent components and scoped comment handling are retained. The English and Chinese design notes under `docs/design/2026-11-17-shell-permission-rule-coverage[.zh-CN].md` are synchronized.

## Validation recorded for the preceding R8 head

[Exact-commit hosted validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/anti-rea-forge/actions/runs/44152320048/job/134283682199) checked out `2ba4b49d8894c561b3ae5456ecc45611f544ca71` with Node 24.22.1:

- **4,044 tests passed in 30 complete core test files**, covering all permission suites plus affected shell utilities, permission helpers, Shell and Monitor.
- **Passed:** normal core workspace build and typecheck, changed-file ESLint with zero warnings, repository Prettier and a clean diff.
- Replacing only the changed production files with the preceding implementation `0263003726`, rebuilding normally and keeping the new tests produced **64 expected assertion failures and 551 passing controls** across the four regression files. The check required a failure in every reported restriction family; collection errors did not count.
- Restoring the exact candidate, verifying a clean tree and rebuilding produced **615 passing tests in all four regression files**.

The validation workflow lives only on an isolated validation branch; no workflow or build-configuration changes were added to this PR.

These checks use the normal workspace build, TypeScript configuration, Vitest configuration and global setup. Permission fixtures inspect parser/tracker decisions; they do not execute their protected-file or destructive sample commands. Two focused source-review passes found no additional Critical issue in this follow-up's scope; that is separate from the executed checks above.

The [upstream checks](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17372/checks) remain the full integration gate. Complete CLI compilation, cross-platform behavior and broader integration are not claimed by that focused R8 validation.

<details>
<summary>Validation recorded for the preceding R7 head only</summary>

The prior head `0263003726e9a34f617e725492d9a0bdbd01f3e5` recorded 4,507 passing tests in 42 complete core files; 692 passing tests in five affected CLI files, with two existing skips; and 147 fixed permission scenarios against source and freshly built core JavaScript. Its normal core build/typecheck, schema generation, bundle, four startup checks and changed-file lint/format checks passed.

Those counts belong to the preceding head and do not validate the new R8 commit. The prior full CLI workspace build ended with exit 137, and its separate 4 GiB CLI typecheck exhausted the heap with exit 134; neither was counted as passing.

</details>


</details>

## Scope

- Existing settings and saved rules are not rewritten. Prefix/glob and legacy `:*` parsing remain. Additional redirect equivalences apply only to deny/ask; allow matching is not broadened.
- Path handling does not collapse `..`, resolve symlinks or call `realpath`. Exactly two leading slashes and quoted wildcard literals remain distinct. Unknown cwd and unresolved paths remain conservative.
- Ordinary comments resume after parameter expansion closes. Monitor comment/newline cases and unsupported groups/heredocs may still return `[]` and require confirmation. This does not claim general interpretation of arbitrary scripts or executable side effects.
- The malformed `/tmp/prot"ected` example has an unclosed quote; valid quoted spellings remain covered. The broader heredoc splitting report / #16870 and findings explicitly deferred by the review stay outside this focused restriction follow-up.

Refs #17001.

prs.title: docs(mods): add an example Mod that shows output in Chinese
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a complete example Mod, zh-display, to the Mods user guide. It shows the model's replies and the thoughts a person opens in Simplified Chinese, in the Ink and OpenTUI terminals and the Web Shell, using the reply row and thinking row sites that #17718 and #17920 brought to the Web Shell.

- The example is three files: the plugin manifest, the hooks manifest and one hooks module. A single `ui.render` hook covers the `AssistantMessage` and `Thinking` sites and translates each block with `$.model.complete` on the session's fast model, asking the model to keep Markdown, code, file paths, URLs, commands and identifiers.
- Text that is already mostly Chinese, or a block of code alone, is left as it is, so it costs no model call. A call that fails or runs out of its 25 seconds leaves the original text, and the hook passes its `next.signal` so a cancelled render also cancels the call.
- The notes after the example say what the reader sees while a block streams, how to choose a fast model, what a session costs (one call per block and per opened thought, answered from the row cache afterwards), that a translated thought loses the Web Shell's built-in translate button, and how to switch to another language.

Only the drawing changes: the stored conversation, what the model reads and the copy actions keep the original. The example is documentation only; nothing ships with Qwen Code.

## Why it's needed

This is the last step of the zh-display line in #13749. Showing the model's English output in Chinese was the scenario that drove `$.model.complete`, the reply and thinking row sites, Mods in ACP sessions and the Web Shell projection. Those pieces are merged, but a user still has to assemble them. A tested, copyable Mod shows how they fit together and is a starting point for other display rewrites.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Copy the three files from the new "Example: show the model's output in Chinese" section of the Mods guide into a `zh-display` directory, run `qwen extensions install ./zh-display --consent`, and turn on `experimental.mods`.
2. Optionally configure a fast model without thinking; without one, the session's model translates.
3. Start `qwen serve`, open the Web Shell, start a new session and send an English prompt that reads a file before answering. Expect:
   - each reply block shows its original text while streaming, then Chinese once complete;
   - an expanded thought shows Chinese, and a thought that stays collapsed costs no call;
   - file names, inline code such as package names, and numbers keep their form;
   - a translated thought has no translate button;
   - the copy buttons copy the original English.

I ran this with the files extracted from the guide itself, so the run used exactly the documented code, against two real model setups on Bailian:

- Token Plan: `deepseek-v4.1-flash` for the session and `deepseek-v4-flash-0731` with thinking off as the fast model.
- Model Studio Standard (Beijing): `qwen3.7-plus` for the session and `qwen-flash` with thinking off as the fast model.

In both, the reply blocks and the opened thoughts were shown in Chinese, `left-pad` and the build numbers were kept, no translate button remained beside a translated thought, and copying gave the English original. The guide's links and formatting were checked.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the guide had no worked example of a display rewrite.

After, in the real Web Shell, Token Plan models:

![zh-display with deepseek-v4.1-flash](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/1a0a3456fbddc36f294291bec9ca1be5e6bc4f17/deepseek.png)

Model Studio Standard models:

![zh-display with qwen3.7-plus](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/1a0a3456fbddc36f294291bec9ca1be5e6bc4f17/qwen.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux, Node 22; `npm run build` and `npm run bundle`, `qwen serve` from the bundle with an isolated home, Playwright Chromium for the Web Shell, real Bailian endpoints.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: translation quality and latency depend on the model the reader picks; a slow model leaves a row in its original text once the 30-second render limit is reached.
- Not validated / out of scope: this exact Mod was not run in the Ink and OpenTUI terminals, whose reply and thinking row sites have their own tests; macOS and Windows; caching translations across sessions.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none, documentation only.

## Linked Issues

Part of #13749

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在 Mods 用户指南中加入一个完整的示例 Mod：zh-display。它在 Ink、OpenTUI 终端和 Web Shell 中，把模型的回复和用户打开的思考显示成简体中文，用到的是 #17718 和 #17920 带到 Web Shell 的回复行和思考行站点。

- 示例共三个文件：插件清单、hooks 清单和一个 hooks 模块。一个 `ui.render` hook 覆盖 `AssistantMessage` 和 `Thinking` 两个站点，用会话的 fast model 通过 `$.model.complete` 翻译每个块，并要求模型保留 Markdown、代码、文件路径、URL、命令和标识符。
- 已经以中文为主的文本，或只有代码的块，保持原样，不花模型调用。调用失败或超过 25 秒时保留原文；hook 传入 `next.signal`，渲染被取消时调用也随之取消。
- 示例后的说明讲了：块在流式输出时读者看到什么、如何选择 fast model、一个会话的成本（每个块、每段打开的思考各一次调用，之后由行缓存作答）、Web Shell 中翻译后的思考不再显示内置翻译按钮，以及如何换成别的语言。

只改变显示：存储的对话、模型读到的内容和复制操作都保持原文。这个示例只存在于文档中，不随 Qwen Code 发布。

## 为什么需要

这是 #13749 中 zh-display 这条线的最后一步。把模型的英文输出显示成中文，正是推动 `$.model.complete`、回复行和思考行站点、ACP 会话中的 Mod 以及 Web Shell 投影的场景。这些部分都已合入，但用户仍需要自己把它们拼起来。一个经过测试、可直接复制的 Mod 展示了它们如何配合，也可以作为其他显示改写的起点。

## 审查测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 把 Mods 指南新增的 "Example: show the model's output in Chinese" 一节中的三个文件复制到 `zh-display` 目录，运行 `qwen extensions install ./zh-display --consent`，并打开 `experimental.mods`。
2. 可选：配置一个不带思考的 fast model；不配置时由会话模型翻译。
3. 启动 `qwen serve`，打开 Web Shell，新建会话，发送一个先读取文件再回答的英文 prompt。预期：
   - 每个回复块在流式输出时显示原文，完成后显示中文；
   - 展开的思考显示中文，一直折叠的思考不花调用；
   - 文件名、包名之类的行内代码和数字保持原样；
   - 翻译后的思考没有翻译按钮；
   - 复制按钮复制的是英文原文。

我用直接从指南中提取的文件运行了这个检查，因此运行的正是文档里的代码，在百炼上使用了两套真实模型：

- Token Plan：会话用 `deepseek-v4.1-flash`，fast model 用关闭思考的 `deepseek-v4-flash-0731`。
- 百炼标准版（北京）：会话用 `qwen3.7-plus`，fast model 用关闭思考的 `qwen-flash`。

两次运行中，回复块和打开的思考都显示为中文，`left-pad` 和构建数字保持原样，翻译后的思考旁不再有翻译按钮，复制得到英文原文。指南的链接和格式也已检查。

### 证据（改动前后）

改动前：指南中没有显示改写的完整示例。

改动后，在真实 Web Shell 中，使用 Token Plan 模型：

![zh-display 与 deepseek-v4.1-flash](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/1a0a3456fbddc36f294291bec9ca1be5e6bc4f17/deepseek.png)

使用百炼标准版模型：

![zh-display 与 qwen3.7-plus](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/1a0a3456fbddc36f294291bec9ca1be5e6bc4f17/qwen.png)

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

Linux，Node 22；先 `npm run build` 和 `npm run bundle`，再用打包产物运行 `qwen serve`，使用隔离的 home，Web Shell 用 Playwright Chromium 驱动，连接真实的百炼端点。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：翻译质量和延迟取决于读者选择的模型；模型太慢时，达到 30 秒渲染上限的行保持原文。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：这个 Mod 没有在 Ink 和 OpenTUI 终端中实际运行（终端的回复行和思考行站点有各自的测试）；macOS 和 Windows；跨会话缓存翻译。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无，仅文档。

## 关联 Issue

Part of #13749

prs.title: fix(cli): recognize double-quoted file paths when pasting from Windows Explorer
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Extends pasted-path extraction in the input text buffer to recognize matching double-quoted file paths (such as `"E:\project\说明.md"`, `"./my file.md"`, and `"~/my file.md"`) alongside the existing single-quoted path handling.

Single-line pastes, space-separated pastes, and multi-line CRLF pastes copied via Windows 11 File Explorer's "Copy as path" (`Ctrl+Shift+C`) now strip the matching double quotes and convert into `@`-prefixed file references. To keep pasted-text handling aligned with the existing pasted-image security guard and avoid redundant filesystem probing, UNC share paths (`\\host\share` and `//host/share`) are skipped before path validation so pasting network paths cannot trigger Windows SMB/NTLM authentication, and quoted-path scanning short-circuits immediately once any non-path token is encountered on a line (such as pasted prose or single-line JSON). Existing safeguards from #4544 remain intact: non-path prose containing quotes, invalid double-quoted paths, mismatched quote pairs (`"path'`), and shell mode (`!`) pastes are preserved verbatim without silent data loss.

## Why it's needed

On Windows 11, File Explorer's "Copy as path" (`Ctrl+Shift+C`) wraps copied paths in double quotes, and multi-selecting files copies one double-quoted path per CRLF line. Because #4544 only matched single-quoted (`'...'`) paths (to avoid English contractions like `"don't"`), Windows users pasting copied file paths got literal `"E:\project\说明.md"` text instead of `@E:\project\说明.md `, so submitting the prompt never read or attached the files. Matching double quotes strictly when the quoted text starts with a local path prefix (or as a validated standalone filename), skipping UNC shares before probing the filesystem, and short-circuiting on the first non-path token preserve #4544's contraction and mixed-prose protection while natively supporting Windows Explorer copy-paste.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In a Windows workspace, create `README.md` and `说明.md` (space-free paths for end-to-end submission verification).
2. Start the interactive CLI and paste `"<workspace>\说明.md"` via bracketed paste (matching Windows Explorer "Copy as path"), add a short prompt, and submit. Expect the input to convert to `@<workspace>\说明.md `, show a `✓ Read` card, and attach the file contents.
3. Paste two CRLF-separated double-quoted paths `"<workspace>\说明.md"\r\n"<workspace>\README.md"` (matching Windows Explorer multi-select "Copy as path"), add a prompt, and submit. Expect both paths to convert to `@<workspace>\说明.md @<workspace>\README.md ` and both files to be attached.
4. Verify that pasting invalid double-quoted paths (`"E:\project\missing.md"`), prose mixed with a valid double-quoted path (`Check "E:\project\README.md" please`), single-line JSON containing path-like values, mismatched quotes (`"E:\project\README.md'`), UNC paths (`"\\host\share\file.png"` / `"//host/share/file.png"`), or paths in shell mode (`!`) leaves the pasted text completely unchanged without probing UNC shares or trailing quoted tokens.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Real-terminal A/B verification on Windows 11 (ConPTY real-terminal harness against a local mock OpenAI server, using space-free paths so submission is isolated from #18142, verifying both input conversion to `@` and wire-level file payloads):

| Scenario | Before (`18ac669a3a`) | After (`4f673807aa`) |

Windows 11 (`win32`), Node.js v24.20.0, base commit `18ac669a3a`, fix commit `4f673807aa`. Verified via `npm run build`, `tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli`, full text-buffer Vitest suite, and interactive ConPTY A/B capture.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Scoped strictly to pasted-path extraction in the CLI input text buffer (2 files changed, no changes to `packages/core`). Preserves the #4544 invariant that pasted content is only rewritten when every non-whitespace token validates as a local path, skips UNC shares before filesystem validation to avoid Windows SMB/NTLM authentication (matching the pasted-image guard), and short-circuits quoted-path scanning on the first non-path token so mixed prose or single-line JSON does not trigger extra filesystem probes. In addition, downstream submission of Windows double-quoted paths that also contain spaces or other shell-escaped characters (such as parentheses, commas, or apostrophes) depends on #18142 rather than duplicating #18142's fix in this PR.

- Not validated / out of scope: Native macOS/Linux terminal runs were not executed (quote matching, stripping, and UNC checks are pure string/regex logic with no OS-specific branches). prs.title: feat(acp): move running shells to the background when queued input is sent now
prs.body:
## What this PR does Send now no longer stops a running shell command. When the user clicks Send now on a queued mid-turn message while a foreground shell command runs, the command moves to the background and keeps running, the same way it does when the user moves it there by hand, and its tool call settles at once. The tool result gives the model the background id, the output location and the status, and says the command moved without being interrupted so that a message from the user could reach it, and that the message follows. When the shell commands were the only work left in the tool batch, the batch ends and the message is answered in the same turn. When other tools remain, the turn ends as with the interrupt added in #17825 and the message is answered in the next turn, but only after the moved commands' results are recorded, so the model never loses track of a command that is still running and does not run it a second time. A moved command reports through the existing background task notification when it finishes. If the user presses Stop later in the same turn, the commands moved for the message are stopped too; from the next turn on they are ordinary background tasks. Both ACP loops (the shared loop, now the default, and the legacy loop) behave the same way. A shell that has not started its process yet, a shell nested in a code-mode call, a simulated `sed` edit and a Managed runtime call have nothing to move and are interrupted as before. The Web Shell tooltip now adds that running commands move to the background and keep running. The design and protocol docs describe the new behavior. Design (English): docs/design/2026-11-19-send-now-never-waits.md Design (中文): docs/design/2026-11-19-send-now-never-waits.zh-CN.md ## Why it's needed After #17825, Send now during a long command (a test run, a build) ended the turn and killed the command. Killing it throws away work that is expensive to redo and can leave half-done side effects, while the user only wanted to add a remark such as "only look at the failing cases". Moving the command to the background loses nothing, and when nothing else was pending the message is now answered at once in the same turn instead of after the command finishes. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify 1. Start `qwen serve`, open Web Shell, and ask for something that runs a long foreground command, e.g. `node -e "setTimeout(()=>require('fs').writeFileSync('late.txt','done'),20000)"`. 2. While it runs, type a follow-up and press Enter, then click Send now on the queued row. 3. Expected: within a second the message appears as a user message in the same turn and the model answers it; the footer shows one background shell running; about 20 s later `late.txt` exists and the background task reports it finished. 4. Repeat with a response that calls the command and another tool (e.g. `write_file`) in one batch: the command keeps running in the background, the other tool does not run, the turn ends and the message is answered as the next turn. 5. Repeat step 1–2, then press Stop while the model answers the message: the background command is cancelled and `late.txt` is never written. ### Evidence (Before & After) Click → first model request carrying the queued message, measured with `qwen serve` + Web Shell + a scripted provider (Playwright logs the click time, the provider logs each request). The legacy loop was run with `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_UNIFIED_AGENT_LOOP=acp=0`. | State at the click | Before (0.27.4) | After, shared loop (default) | After, legacy loop | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Only a shell command running | 17.3 s, waits for the command | 32–69 ms, same turn, command still runs and finishes | 64 ms, same turn, command finishes | | Shell command + `write_file` in one batch | — | 147–154 ms, next turn, file not written, command finishes | 54 ms, next turn, file not written, command finishes | | Stop while the message is answered | — | moved command cancelled, never finishes | moved command cancelled, never finishes | Before — 1.5 s after clicking Send now while the command runs: the row still reads "Queued..." and nothing happens until the command ends. After — 1.5 s after the same click: the message was answered in the same turn, and the footer shows the command still running in the background. ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ | ### Environment (optional) Linux, Node 22, `qwen serve` from the local bundle, Web Shell driven by Playwright, scripted OpenAI-compatible provider. Unit tests: `Session.test.ts`, `acp-tool-batch.test.ts`, `shell.test.ts`. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: a command moved for a message keeps running after the turn ends (unless the user presses Stop in that turn), so its side effects continue; the model is told it is running and can stop it with `task_stop`. In a mixed batch the turn ends only once the moved commands' tool calls settle, which includes their PostToolUse hooks, so a slow hook delays the interrupt. - Not validated / out of scope: moving subagents to the background; Windows and macOS process handling of the moved command (it uses the existing background promotion path). Shells that have not spawned yet, nested code-mode shells, simulated `sed` edits and Managed runtime calls are interrupted rather than moved. - Breaking changes / migration notes: none for the `send-now` route; SDK callers see a same-turn answer instead of a `cancelled` turn when only shell commands were running. ## Linked Issues Follows #17825.
中文说明 ## 这个 PR 做了什么 「立即发送」不再中止正在运行的 shell 命令。前台 shell 命令运行时，用户对排队消息点「立即发送」，命令会转到后台继续运行（和用户手动转后台一样），它的工具调用随即结算。工具结果给模型后台 id、输出位置和状态，并写明：命令在没有被中断的情况下转到后台，是为了让用户的消息送达，消息紧随其后。批次里只剩这些 shell 命令时，批次随即结束，消息在同一轮得到回应。还有其他工具时，按 #17825 加入的打断结束这一轮、下一轮回应消息，但要等转后台的命令的结果记下之后才结束，这样模型不会丢掉仍在运行的命令，也不会再跑一遍。转后台的命令结束时，走现有的后台任务通知。用户在同一轮里接着按停止时，为送达消息而转后台的命令一并停掉；从下一轮起它们就是普通的后台任务。 两条 ACP 循环（现在默认的 shared 循环和旧循环）行为一致。还没启动进程的 shell、嵌套在 code-mode 调用里的 shell、模拟执行的 `sed` 编辑和 Managed runtime 的调用没有可转的进程，仍按原来的方式打断。Web Shell 的悬停提示补充说明正在运行的命令会转到后台继续运行。设计文档和协议文档同步描述新行为。 设计文档（英文）：docs/design/2026-11-19-send-now-never-waits.md 设计文档（中文）：docs/design/2026-11-19-send-now-never-waits.zh-CN.md ## 为什么需要 #17825 之后，在长命令（跑测试、构建）运行时点立即发送，会结束这一轮并杀掉命令。杀掉命令会丢掉重做代价很高的工作，还可能留下做了一半的副作用，而用户只是想补一句「只看失败的用例」。转到后台不丢任何东西；没有其他工具在等时，消息现在在同一轮立刻得到回应，不用等命令跑完。 ## 审阅者测试计划 ### 如何验证 1. 启动 `qwen serve`，打开 Web Shell，让模型运行一个长的前台命令，例如 `node -e "setTimeout(()=>require('fs').writeFileSync('late.txt','done'),20000)"`。 2. 命令运行时输入一条补充并回车，然后在排队行上点「立即发送」。 3. 预期：1 秒内消息作为同一轮里的用户消息出现，模型回答它；底部显示有 1 个后台 shell 在运行；约 20 秒后 `late.txt` 生成，后台任务报告结束。 4. 让模型在同一批里同时调用这条命令和另一个工具（例如 `write_file`），重复上面的操作：命令在后台继续运行，另一个工具不执行，这一轮结束，消息作为下一轮得到回应。 5. 重复第 1–2 步，然后在模型回答消息时按停止：后台命令被取消，`late.txt` 不会生成。 ### 证据（前后对比） 点击到第一个携带排队消息的模型请求的时间，用 `qwen serve` + Web Shell + 脚本化 provider 测得（Playwright 记录点击时间，provider 记录每个请求）。旧循环用 `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_UNIFIED_AGENT_LOOP=acp=0` 运行。 | 点击时的状态 | 改动前（0.27.4） | 改动后，shared 循环（默认） | 改动后，旧循环 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 只有 shell 命令在运行 | 17.3 s，等命令结束 | 32–69 ms，同一轮，命令继续运行并跑完 | 64 ms，同一轮，命令跑完 | | 同一批里有 shell 命令和 `write_file` | — | 147–154 ms，下一轮，文件未写入，命令跑完 | 54 ms，下一轮，文件未写入，命令跑完 | | 回答消息时按停止 | — | 转后台的命令被取消，没有跑完 | 转后台的命令被取消，没有跑完 | 改动前：命令运行时点「立即发送」，1.5 秒后排队行仍是「排队中...」，直到命令结束都没有反应。 改动后：同样的点击，1.5 秒后消息已在同一轮得到回应，底部显示命令仍在后台运行。 ### 测试平台 | OS | 状态 | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ | ### 环境（可选） Linux，Node 22，用本地 bundle 跑 `qwen serve`，Playwright 驱动 Web Shell，脚本化的 OpenAI 兼容 provider。单测：`Session.test.ts`、`acp-tool-batch.test.ts`、`shell.test.ts`。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险或取舍：为送达消息而转后台的命令在这一轮结束后继续运行（除非用户在这一轮里按停止），它的副作用也会继续；模型知道它在运行，可以用 `task_stop` 停掉。混合批次里，要等转后台的命令的工具调用结算（包括 PostToolUse hook）才结束这一轮，hook 慢会推迟打断。 - 未验证 / 不在范围内：子代理转后台；Windows 和 macOS 上转后台命令的进程处理（走现有的转后台路径）。还没启动进程的 shell、嵌套在 code-mode 里的 shell、模拟执行的 `sed` 编辑和 Managed runtime 的调用会被打断而不是转后台。 - 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：`send-now` 路由不变；只有 shell 命令在运行时，SDK 调用方会看到同一轮内回应，而不是一个 `cancelled` 的回合。 ## 关联 Issue 接续 #17825。

prs.title: fix(agents): keep A2A tasks recoverable after transcript read errors
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Session-based A2A requests return the existing retryable JSON-RPC error `-32012` when a filesystem error prevents reply lookup in an active or archived transcript. The failing observation saves no task result. Once reads recover, the same task can report `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` with its original reply.

## Why it's needed

A transient read error could make a recorded reply appear absent and cause a completed task to be permanently saved as `TASK_STATE_FAILED`. A permissions check can still succeed when the actual read fails. The linked issue reproduces this with injected `EIO`. [Issue #13738](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13738), [earlier proposal and review](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13797).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

From `packages/cli`, run `npx --no-install vitest run --coverage.enabled=false src/serve/routes/a2a.test.ts -t 'after an EIO'`. The regression cases inject a stream read failure in each transcript location. Check that `GetTask`, `ListTasks`, `CancelTask`, and a replay of `SendMessage` return `-32012` with no internal path details and no saved task result. After restoring the stream, poll the same task with `GetTask` and check that it returns and saves `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` with the original reply. The cases also check the oversized archive and unexpected-error paths.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The local JSON-RPC daemon probe used the same recorded-reply fixtures for both versions. On installed Qwen Code 0.27.3, polling under `EIO` returned and saved `TASK_STATE_FAILED` for both transcript locations. Polling after recovery returned the same state. In the fixed bundle, polling under the same fault returned `-32012` and the task mappings contained no result. The next poll returned and saved `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` with the original reply. Healthy, missing-transcript, and mismatched-reply controls produced the expected results on both versions.

Build, bundle, typecheck, focused ESLint and Prettier checks, and the focused CLI and core suites passed. The suites ran 22 CLI tests and 391 core tests.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status        |
| :--------: | :------------ |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested     |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS 27.0 arm64 and Node 22.18.0 for the fixed bundle. The probe used a local `serve` daemon with experimental agent collaboration enabled and synthetic on-disk fixtures.

## Risk & Scope

- An unreadable active transcript takes precedence over the archived copy because the archive may hold a stale reply. The session loaders use strict reads by opt-in, with A2A as the sole caller that enables them.
- Previously saved failures, malformed reply records, and concurrent archive restoration are outside the fix. The existing cancellation decision and receipt behavior still depend on observing the task.
- The fix uses the existing task schema, storage format, and JSON-RPC code. It requires no data migration.

[Design document (Simplified Chinese)](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/350a7e3f7a3850d4f8bdb3b8b3784c897f832537/docs/design/managed-agents/a2a-transcript-read-recovery.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13738

构建、打包、类型检查、定向 ESLint 与 Prettier 检查，以及 CLI 和 core 定向测试均通过。两套测试分别运行了 22 项和 391 项。

prs.title: fix(core): prefer a healthy system rg over the bundled binary
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Grep now uses a healthy system `rg` when one is on PATH, and only then falls back to the bundled binary. `tools.useBuiltinRipgrep: false` still means system-only, with no vendor fallback.

## Why it's needed

Default Grep selected the vendored binary whenever it existed, even if PATH already had a working `rg`. On macOS that adhoc/linker-signed copy pays a first-launch AMFI/syspolicyd tax (measured 2–5× vs a Developer ID-signed PATH `rg` of the same search); Linux has no such tax, but still wants one `rg` for the host image and the CLI. Related to item 2 of #17682.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. With `rg` on PATH, start a session and run a Grep. Recovery/telemetry `selection_mode` should be `system`.
2. Hide PATH `rg` (`PATH=/usr/bin` or equivalent) and run Grep again. Search should still work via the bundled binary (`selection_mode: builtin`).
3. `tools.useBuiltinRipgrep: false` with no PATH `rg` should not use the vendor copy.
4. Unit coverage: `packages/core` `ripgrepUtils.test.ts` (PATH preferred, bundled fallback, both unhealthy, `useBuiltin: false`).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — selection-order change. macOS timing evidence is in #17682; Linux is expected to stay within normal 14.x/15.x noise once page cache is warm.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested (unit + real bundled `rg` probe) |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests in an isolated worktree. No TUI session.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: hosts with an old or wrapper `rg` on PATH now take that binary first. Health still requires `--version` to print `ripgrep`; a binary that fails that probe still falls back to bundled.
- Not validated / out of scope: Developer ID signing of the vendored darwin binary; `--threads 4`; non-UTF8 corpus paths and the absent-token fixture from #17682 items 1 and 3.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: default Grep may now follow the host `rg` version instead of always 15.0.0. Set `tools.useBuiltinRipgrep: false` only when bundled fallback must stay off.

## Linked Issues

Related to #17682 (item 2). Does not close the issue: items 1 and 3 remain.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

Grep 现在优先使用 PATH 上健康的系统 `rg`，只有系统 `rg` 缺失或无法运行时才用内置二进制。`tools.useBuiltinRipgrep: false` 仍然表示只用系统 `rg`，不回退到内置副本。

## 为什么需要

默认 Grep 只要内置二进制存在就会用它，即使 PATH 上已有可用的 `rg`。在 macOS 上，这份 adhoc/linker-signed 副本会吃到首次启动的 AMFI/syspolicyd 税（实测相对 Developer ID 签名的 PATH `rg` 慢 2–5 倍）；Linux 没有这套税，但镜像里已经装了系统 `rg`，希望 CLI 与宿主走同一条路径。对应 #17682 第 2 项。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. PATH 上有 `rg` 时开会话跑一次 Grep，`selection_mode` 应为 `system`。
2. 从 PATH 去掉 `rg` 再跑，搜索仍应成功，走内置二进制（`selection_mode: builtin`）。
3. `tools.useBuiltinRipgrep: false` 且没有系统 `rg` 时，不得使用内置副本。
4. 单测：`packages/core` 的 `ripgrepUtils.test.ts`（PATH 优先、内置回退、两者都不健康、`useBuiltin: false`）。

### 证据（修改前 / 修改后）

不适用 — 这是选择顺序变更。macOS 计时证据见 #17682；Linux 在页缓存热了之后应落在 14.x/15.x 的正常噪声范围内。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ 已测（单测 + 真实内置 `rg` 探测） |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ 未测 |

### 环境（可选）

隔离 worktree 中的单元测试。无 TUI 会话。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：PATH 上若是旧版或包装过的 `rg`，现在会优先用它。健康检查仍要求 `--version` 输出以 `ripgrep` 开头；探测失败会回退到内置副本。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：给 darwin 内置二进制做 Developer ID 签名；`--threads 4`；#17682 第 1 项非 UTF8 路径和第 3 项 absent 标记夹具。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：默认 Grep 可能跟随宿主 `rg` 版本，而不再固定 15.0.0。只有必须禁止内置回退时才设 `tools.useBuiltinRipgrep: false`。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #17682（第 2 项）。不关闭该 issue：第 1、3 项仍在。

</details>

releases.name: Release v0.28.4
releases.body:
<!-- qwen-release-notes:v2 -->

## Highlights

- Web Shell local daemon mode adds a workspace artifact library page with progressive scanning and streaming updates. ([#18071](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18071))
- Web Shell chat adds a shared ChatSurface, Continue badges, suggestion chips, and mobile layout fixes for sessions. ([#17952](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17952), [#18044](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18044), [#17918](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17918), [#17883](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17883), [#18011](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18011))
- Core adds built-in Gemini 4 reasoning defaults. ([#18039](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18039))
- Local Runtime now creates its state directory at process spawn with owner-private permissions. ([#17964](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17964))
- Command migration creates Markdown destinations exclusively and preserves the original TOML on destination conflicts. ([#17873](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17873))
- Extensions now load manifests saved with a UTF-8 BOM. ([#15786](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15786))

## Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

## Web Shell

Improves the Web Shell chat experience with session continuation, artifact browsing, mobile layout, suggestion chips, and clearer status cues.

- web-shell: keep mobile Send above software keyboard ([#17883](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17883))
- Adds a tappable suggestion chip in Web Shell composers so touch users can insert and edit follow-up suggestions before sending. ([#17918](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17918))
- Web Shell now renders Mod rewrites of expanded thinking rows while preserving the original stored thought and collapsed Done thinking line. ([#17920](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17920))
  ![All thoughts collapsed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/391247dcbc302013c0dd6938c0b15fa1f862efba/collapsed.png)
  ![Thoughts expanded and rewritten](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/391247dcbc302013c0dd6938c0b15fa1f862efba/folded.png)
- web-shell: update sidebar logo for dark theme ([#17935](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17935))
- Web Shell adds a shared ChatSurface chat column that renders transcript, approvals, questions, and composer from session state. ([#17952](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17952))
- web-shell: compact automatic trigger messages ([#17970](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17970))
- Gives session titles more space on mobile and desktop by moving optional row actions into the More menu. ([#18011](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18011))
- Web Shell sidebar now shows a Continue badge for sessions whose last turn was interrupted and needs continuation. ([#18044](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18044))
- web-shell: scope ChatSurface admission locks to the owning session and bind loadOlder ([#18066](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18066))
- web-shell: align session hover status with the row's status cues ([#18070](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18070))
- Adds the workspace artifact library page in Web Shell local daemon mode, with progressive scanning and streaming updates. ([#18071](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18071))
- web-shell: use running color for active work ([#18072](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18072))

## Managed Agent and Hosted Harness

Fixes hosted session races, preflight configuration, permissions, telemetry channels, and storage identifiers for Managed Agent environments.

- managed-agent: close over the resources a config_install record names ([#17468](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17468))
- Fixes a Hosted Harness race by using one lock when building, closing, and adopting the lazily built client. ([#17961](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17961))
- Managed-agent preflight now treats a blank workspace-cwd as unconfigured instead of using the current working directory, and docs now match shipped state-directory rules. ([#17965](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17965))
- Durable preflight fixtures now skip cleanly when nobody cannot be resolved, use explicit 0755 permissions, and docs clarify service-user ownership expectations. ([#18020](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18020))
- Adds a managed telemetry client-channel value so Managed Agent sessions can be distinguished from ordinary daemon traffic. ([#18022](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18022))
- Managed-agent OSS objects now use readable tenant, workspace, and session identifiers in keys, making bucket contents easier to inspect. ([#18048](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18048))

## Core runtime and models

Updates command migration, local Runtime state permissions, tool-output recovery, transcript performance, and Gemini 4 reasoning defaults.

- Command migration now creates Markdown destinations exclusively and preserves the original TOML when a destination conflict exists. ([#17873](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17873))
- core: protect persisted tool-output recovery ([#17875](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17875))
- Caches oversized transcript indexes in a separate bounded class so large indexes no longer block small-session hook retention. ([#17910](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17910))
- Creates the local Runtime state directory at process spawn with owner-private permissions instead of during provider creation. ([#17964](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17964))
- core: add built-in Gemini 4 reasoning defaults ([#18039](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18039))

## Extensions and channels

Improves extension manifest loading and ACP channel liveness handling for busy agents.

- extensions: load extension manifests saved with a UTF-8 BOM ([#15786](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15786))
- Lets ACP channel liveness treat busy agents as healthy longer and records evidence when channels are closed. ([#18028](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18028))

## Sessions and approvals

- Docs now state that running interactive sessions automatically pick up mcpServers changes, with restart kept only as a troubleshooting fallback. ([#17743](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17743))
- serve: refine create_sub_session workspace approvals ([#17863](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17863))

## Autofix evidence

Strips terminal control characters and Unicode Bidi overrides from Autofix failed-check evidence before display.

- Autofix failed-check evidence now strips terminal control characters and Unicode Bidi overrides from log excerpts before display. ([#16748](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16748))

## Other Changes

- ci: use live review bot for manual re-review ([#17848](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17848))
- Stabilizes the required Managed Agent check name as Managed Agent gate and prevents skipped or no-suite review runs from overwriting real results. ([#17865](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17865))
- Replaces the receipt-catalog SpotBugs exclusion with an explicit assertion while keeping the HTTP 400 contract for missing receipt bytes unchanged. ([#17919](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17919))
- Updates identity de-hash design docs to correct workspace and storage budgets and record duplicate-key constraints before VARCHAR conversion. ([#17960](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17960))
- Makes RocketMQ stop checks wait for listeners to clear instead of immediately rebinding ports, reducing flaky CI failures. ([#17967](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17967))
- Release retries can resume after a partial publish by reusing a matching release branch and publishing remaining packages; divergent same-version trees are still rejected. ([#17951](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17951))
- Managed-agent identity storage removes redundant same-row hash key columns and rebuilds affected unique keys and indexes on raw identity columns without changing column order. ([#18019](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18019))
- ci: isolate verify scratch in runner temp ([#17879](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17879))
- web-shell: deliver per-turn assistant feedback to telemetry ([#18021](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18021))
- refactor(managed-agent): drop dead and redundant schema objects ([#18041](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18041))
- test(channels): make four managed DingTalk witnesses exclude what they claim ([#17968](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17968))
- CI verification now fails clearly when the scratch directory is not prepared instead of silently using shared OS temp space. ([#18040](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18040))
- The DingTalk recent-window cap test timeout is raised to 120 seconds and pinned to reduce flaky CI failures. ([#17837](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17837))
- The CLI restart-recovery crash test now waits for transcript and partial-response state before killing the daemon. ([#18049](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18049))
- Documentation now proposes a read-only workspace artifact library page for Web Shell local daemon mode. ([#18036](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18036))
- Adds bilingual design documentation for managed-agent Action parking in stateless Hosted Harness Phase 4. ([#18047](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18047))
- Marks the workspace artifact library design as accepted but not yet implemented in bilingual documentation. ([#18063](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18063))
- Restores green CI builds by updating the document export renderer size budget for ChatSurface copy. ([#18067](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18067))
- Fixes nightly desktop release checks by re-pinning the RHEL 10 rpm build root to a current CentOS Stream 10 digest. ([#18069](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18069))
- Fixes macOS e2e tests for qwen serve assistant feedback telemetry by using real workspace transcript paths. ([#18074](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18074))
- test(managed-agent): gate the four durable existing-dir preflight tests to Linux ([#18076](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18076))
- refactor(managed-agent): move publication OSS scope naming to the contract ([#18085](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18085))
- test(integration): deflake the SIGKILL restart-recovery case (#18055) ([#18057](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18057))
- test(cli): deflake the admitted-mutation idle-timer case (#18053) ([#18056](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18056))
- Updates design docs to mark the automatic-trigger message as landed and align renderer-budget history with implemented behavior. ([#18080](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18080))
- Makes self-hosted Java CI jobs rebuild a writable job-local Maven repository and safely fall back when cache reuse fails. ([#18065](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18065))

---

## 中文摘要

### 亮点

- Web Shell 本地 daemon 模式新增 workspace artifact library 页面，支持渐进式扫描与流式更新。 ([#18071](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18071))
- Web Shell 新增共享 ChatSurface、Continue 标记、suggestion chips，并优化移动端布局。 ([#17952](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17952), [#18044](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18044), [#17918](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17918), [#17883](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17883), [#18011](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18011))
- Core 新增内置 Gemini 4 reasoning 默认设置。 ([#18039](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18039))
- 本地 Runtime 现在在进程启动时创建状态目录，并仅允许属主访问。 ([#17964](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17964))
- 命令迁移现在独占创建 Markdown 目标，冲突时保留原有 TOML。 ([#17873](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17873))
- Extensions 现在可加载保存为 UTF-8 BOM 的 manifest。 ([#15786](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15786))

### Web Shell

改进 Web Shell 聊天体验，新增会话继续、工件浏览、移动端布局、suggestion chips 和更清晰的状态提示。

- web-shell: keep mobile Send above software keyboard ([#17883](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17883))
- Web Shell 输入框新增可点按的 suggestion chip，触控用户可插入并编辑 follow-up suggestion 后再发送。 ([#17918](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17918))
- Web Shell 现在可渲染展开的 thinking 行的 Mod 重写，同时保留原始存储内容和折叠的 Done thinking 行。 ([#17920](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17920))
- web-shell: update sidebar logo for dark theme ([#17935](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17935))
- Web Shell 新增共享 ChatSurface 聊天列，可根据会话状态渲染转录、审批、提问和输入区。 ([#17952](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17952))
- web-shell: compact automatic trigger messages ([#17970](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17970))
- 在移动端和桌面端为会话标题留出更多空间，并将可选操作移入 More 菜单。 ([#18011](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18011))
- Web Shell 侧边栏会为上次回合被中断、需要继续的会话显示 Continue 标记。 ([#18044](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18044))
- web-shell: scope ChatSurface admission locks to the owning session and bind loadOlder ([#18066](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18066))
- web-shell: align session hover status with the row's status cues ([#18070](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18070))
- Web Shell 本地 daemon 模式新增 workspace artifact library 页面，支持渐进式扫描与流式更新。 ([#18071](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18071))
- web-shell: use running color for active work ([#18072](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18072))

### Managed Agent 与 Hosted Harness

修复托管会话竞态、预检配置、权限、遥测通道和存储标识，提升 Managed Agent 环境可靠性。

- managed-agent: close over the resources a config_install record names ([#17468](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17468))
- 修复 Hosted Harness 竞态，在构建、关闭和接管延迟创建的客户端时统一使用同一个锁。 ([#17961](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17961))
- managed-agent 将空白的 workspace-cwd 视为未配置，而不是使用当前工作目录，并同步预检文档。 ([#17965](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17965))
- 持久预检 fixture 在无法解析 nobody 时跳过，使用显式 0755 权限，并说明 service-user 的所有者期望。 ([#18020](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18020))
- 新增 managed 遥测 client-channel 值，以便区分 Managed Agent 会话与普通 daemon 流量。 ([#18022](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18022))
- Managed-agent 的 OSS 对象键改用可读的 tenant、workspace 和 session 标识，便于运维查看。 ([#18048](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18048))

### 核心运行时与模型

更新命令迁移、本地 Runtime 状态目录权限、工具输出恢复、转录性能以及 Gemini 4 推理默认值。

- 命令迁移现在独占创建 Markdown 目标文件，遇到目标冲突时保留原有 TOML。 ([#17873](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17873))
- core: protect persisted tool-output recovery ([#17875](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17875))
- 将超大 transcript index 放入独立受限缓存类，避免大索引阻塞小会话的 hook 保留。 ([#17910](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17910))
- 在本地 Runtime 进程启动时创建状态目录并使用仅属主可访问权限，而不是在 provider 创建时创建。 ([#17964](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17964))
- core: add built-in Gemini 4 reasoning defaults ([#18039](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18039))

### 扩展与通道

改进扩展清单加载，并优化繁忙 agent 的 ACP 通道存活检测。

- extensions: load extension manifests saved with a UTF-8 BOM ([#15786](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15786))
- 让 ACP 通道存活检测将繁忙 agent 视为暂时健康，并在关闭通道时记录证据。 ([#18028](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18028))

### 会话与审批

- 文档现在说明运行中的交互式会话会自动应用 mcpServers 更改，重启仅作为故障排查手段。 ([#17743](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17743))
- serve: refine create_sub_session workspace approvals ([#17863](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17863))

### Autofix 证据

Autofix 失败检查证据在展示前会移除终端控制字符和 Unicode Bidi 覆盖字符。

- Autofix 失败检查证据会在展示前移除日志摘录中的终端控制字符和 Unicode Bidi 覆盖字符。 ([#16748](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16748))

### 其他变更

- ci: use live review bot for manual re-review ([#17848](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17848))
- 将必需的 Managed Agent 检查名称稳定为 Managed Agent gate，并防止跳过或无套件的审查运行覆盖真实结果。 ([#17865](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17865))
- 用显式断言替代 receipt-catalog 的 SpotBugs 排除，同时保持缺少 receipt 字节时返回 HTTP 400 的行为不变。 ([#17919](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17919))
- 更新 identity de-hash 设计文档，修正 workspace 和 storage 预算，并记录 VARCHAR 转换前的重复键约束。 ([#17960](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17960))
- 让 RocketMQ 停止检查等待 listener 清理完成，而不是立即重新绑定端口，减少 CI 偶发失败。 ([#17967](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17967))
- 发布重试可在部分发布后恢复：匹配时复用现有 release branch 并发布剩余包；同版本内容不一致仍会被拒绝。 ([#17951](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17951))
- managed-agent 移除仅重复本行原始身份列的哈希键列，并在原始身份列上重建唯一键和索引，保持列顺序。 ([#18019](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18019))
- ci: isolate verify scratch in runner temp ([#17879](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17879))
- web-shell: deliver per-turn assistant feedback to telemetry ([#18021](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18021))

- test(channels): make four managed DingTalk witnesses exclude what they claim ([#17968](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17968))
- CI 校验在 scratch 目录未准备好时会明确失败，而不是静默使用共享 OS 临时空间。 ([#18040](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18040))
- DingTalk recent-window cap 测试超时被提高到 120 秒并固定，以减少 CI 偶发失败。 ([#17837](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17837))
- CLI 重启恢复崩溃测试现在会先等待会话记录和部分响应状态就绪，再终止 daemon。 ([#18049](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18049))
- 新增设计文档，提议在 Web Shell 本地 daemon 模式下提供只读的 workspace 工件库页面。 ([#18036](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18036))
- 新增 managed-agent 在 stateless Hosted Harness Phase 4 的 Action parking 双语设计文档。 ([#18047](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18047))
- 将 workspace artifact library 双语设计文档状态更新为 accepted 且尚未实现。 ([#18063](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18063))
- 恢复 CI 构建，更新文档导出渲染大小预算以适配 ChatSurface 复制。 ([#18067](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18067))
- 通过重新固定 RHEL 10 rpm 构建根镜像到当前 CentOS Stream 10 digest，修复桌面发布夜间检查。 ([#18069](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18069))

issues.body:
Refs #4785

A dead-code sweep found these items. Each one is either never produced or only reached from tests. They were not removed because each looks like the start of a feature, and someone needs to decide whether to finish it or delete it. Every claim below was checked with `grep -rn` across `crates/` on current `main`.

**1. `SidebarRowAction::PrefillCommand` is never created (crates/tui/src/tui/app.rs:1289)**
- What happens: the variant is matched in `mouse_ui.rs:898` and `mouse_ui.rs:1643`. The only constructor (`mouse_ui.rs:1650`) re-wraps a value that is already a `PrefillCommand`. No sidebar row ever starts out as one, so the destructive-command "prefill, then press Enter" path cannot be reached. The allow comment cites TUI-DOG-008, but that ID is about working/phase chrome (`docs/MOTION_CONTRACT.md:25`), not this path.
- Expected: either a destructive sidebar row produces `PrefillCommand`, or the variant and its two match arms are removed.

**2. `FleetListOutcome::OpenDetail` / `FleetListOutcome::None` are never created (crates/tui/src/tui/views/fleet_list.rs:46-55)**
- What happens: `select_highlighted` and `confirm_delete` only return `FleetListOutcome::Done`. `outcome_to_action` (line 602) maps `OpenDetail` to `ViewEvent::FleetListOpenDetailRequested`, and `ui/handlers.rs:2582` handles that event by opening `FleetDetailView`. That whole chain cannot run. The allow says it is "reserved for the qualified-name flow".
- Expected: wire the qualified-name flow so selecting a fleet can open its detail view, or remove `OpenDetail`, `None`, `ViewEvent::FleetListOpenDetailRequested` and its handler.

**3. `RunReceipt` / `VerificationReceipt` / `VerificationOutcome` are only used by tests (crates/engine/src/core/runtime_contract/termination.rs:111-165)**
- What happens: no non-test code outside `termination.rs` names these types. `RunReceipt::validate` and `RunReceipt::pass_at_one` run only in that file's tests. The removed module allow said that "stream JSON is the first consumer", but no stream JSON code builds a `RunReceipt`.
- Expected: emit a run receipt from the stream-JSON / exec surface, or delete the types and their tests.

**4. `SkillMutationReceipt.before_digest` / `after_digest` are written but never read (crates/skills/src/mutation.rs:113-116)**
- What happens: every mutation path fills both fields (mutation.rs:615-994), and a TUI test builds them as `None` (`tui/src/commands/contract.rs:7038`). No code reads either field. The allow says "reserved for digest-diff UI". `action` on the same struct has a similar "future receipt toast" allow.
- Expected: show the digest diff in the skills manager / receipt toast, or stop computing and storing the digests.

**5. Fleet ledger/scheduler/executor functions only reached from tests (crates/engine/src/fleet/)**
- `ledger.rs:1770 FleetLedger::claim_next`: only callers are tests (ledger.rs:3306, 3401)
- `ledger.rs:1533 FleetLedger::record_alert`: only caller is a test (ledger.rs:4453)
- `ledger.rs:788 FleetLedger::mark_task_terminal_status_if_unchanged`: only caller is a test (ledger.rs:3707)
- `scheduler.rs:107 FleetScheduler::cancel_run`: only caller is a test (scheduler.rs:1048)
- `executor.rs:1150 all_terminal`: only callers are tests (executor.rs:2016, 2303)
- `task_spec.rs:617 record_verification_receipt`: only caller is a test (task_spec.rs:1393)
- `roster.rs:729 shadowed_for`: only caller is a test (fleet/tests/roster_shadow_and_trust.rs:38)

What happens: `ledger.rs`, `scheduler.rs` and `executor.rs` have `#![allow(dead_code)]` for the whole module. `task_spec.rs` and `roster.rs` items are `pub`. In both cases the compiler does not flag these functions. Production code claims tasks, cancels runs and records verification some other way, or does not do it yet.
Expected: for each function, either route the production path through it (for example operator cancel → `cancel_run`, alert delivery → `record_alert`), or move it under `#[cfg(test)]` / delete it. Then drop the module-level allows so new dead code shows up again.

---
**Body:**

## What and why

This removes code that nothing calls and `dead_code` allows on items that are in use, which lowers the dead-code budget from 137 to 119.

- engine: drop the stale allows on `SubAgentManager.workspace`, `ProjectContext.project_root`, the four `McpConnection`/`McpPool` accessors, `UserInputProvenance`, the four `TokenEstimateCache` methods, and the module allows in `termination.rs` and `auto_review.rs`
- engine: remove unused `_assert_var_handle_shape`, `merge_contexts` (and its test), and the private `FleetManager::record_task_timeout`
- engine: delete `trailing_start_marker_prefix_len`; its caller now uses `trailing_marker_prefix_len(.., &TOOL_CALL_START_MARKERS)`, which checks the same 30 markers in the same order
- engine: the workflow tool reuses `cargo_failure_summary::truncate_chars` instead of keeping its own copy
- tui: drop the stale allows on `App::cell_at_virtual_index`, `AppAction::LoadSession` and `ActiveCell::revision` (all have live callers)
- runtime: reduce `resource_telemetry` to `estimate_output_tokens_from_text`, its only outside use; remove `SessionJournal::children_of`
- app-server: remove the unused `run_daemon_socket`, `run_stdio` and `daemon_client::forward_stdio` (all platform variants and the re-export)
- `scripts/dead-code-budget.json` regenerated

Items that need a decision instead of removal are listed in #ISSUE.

## Related issue (optional)

Refs #4785
Refs #ISSUE

## How I tested it

- `cargo check -p codewhale-engine` and `cargo check -p codewhale-engine --all-targets`: no warnings
- `cargo clippy -p codewhale-runtime -p codewhale-app-server -p codewhale-engine -p codewhale-tui --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings`: clean
- `cargo test -p codewhale-runtime --lib -- resource_telemetry session_tree`: 26 passed
- `cargo test -p codewhale-app-server --lib -- daemon_socket daemon_client`: 20 passed
- `cargo test -p codewhale-engine --lib -- tool_call marker cargo_failure_summary tools::workflow project_context`: 385 passed (with `RUST_MIN_STACK=16777216`)
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `python3 scripts/check-dead-code-budget.py`: pass

## Checklist

- [x] One focused change, started from current `main` (no need to rebase when `main` moves)
- [x] `cargo fmt --all` passes, and tests cover new or changed behavior

Also test-only after the cleanup PR (pub, so the lint never fires): `TokenEstimateCache::{bump_messages_revision, invalidate, stats, recent_audit}` (crates/engine/src/core/engine/token_estimate_cache.rs) and the `ProjectContext.project_root` field, read only in project_context_cache.rs tests.

issues.body:
0.10.4 is a small fix release for problems people hit right after 0.10.3. It takes no new work beyond the list below. Everything else is welcome in 0.10.5 (see #7486).

## What it fixes

- **Ctrl+V pastes text twice in Windows Terminal**, both in the composer and in the `/provider` API key field. This is the likely cause of #7485, where a valid key was rejected in `/provider`.
- **`codewhale update` refuses a release binary with a false "managed by cargo" message** when an unrelated `cargo install` record sits next to it, for example in `~/.local/bin`.
- **`/pet` shows the old whale** in every terminal but one.
- **The Underwater ocean animates only while you type.** It stays still while a model is working, which is the opposite of what it should do.
- **url 2.5.9** security update (RUSTSEC-2026-0592).
- **One retry when a model request gets no response headers**, so the turn does not hang.
- Already merged after the 0.10.3 tag: #7452 and #7455 by @SparkofSpike (reasoning cards stay in the right place, fixes #7454), #7479 and #7480 by @thejesh23 (Telegram poll loop no longer stops on one refused reply; code fences stay whole when a bridge reply is split), #7482 by @NieZhuZhu (the eight R20 audit fixes from #7476).

## Status

On `main`:
- Retry when no response headers arrive: 7b246b2de32
- url 2.5.9: 24bb155e3c6
- #7452, #7455, #7479, #7480, #7482 (merged)

In testing, on the `ci/cw-0.10.4-hotfix` branch, not on `main` yet:
- Paste once on Windows Terminal, and the install-ownership fix for `codewhale update`. The paste fix has **not** been reproduced or confirmed on a real Windows machine yet. That is the gap we most need help with.

Not written yet:
- `/pet` showing the old whale.
- Underwater ocean animating while a model works instead of while you type.

## Ways to help

### The one that matters most: try the candidate on real Windows Terminal (no Rust needed)

When a candidate build is posted in a comment here, or if you can build the `ci/cw-0.10.4-hotfix` branch yourself (`cargo build --locked -p codewhale-cli`), please try these in Windows Terminal and report exactly what happened:

1. Copy a line of text, then press Ctrl+V in the composer. Does it appear once or twice?
2. Run `/provider`, pick a provider, and paste your API key with Ctrl+V. Does it appear once? Is the key accepted? (Do not post the key.)
3. Copy an image and press Ctrl+V in the composer. Is it attached once?
4. If you type Chinese (or another IME language), type and commit a few words. Does the text arrive once and correctly?
5. Try right-click paste and Ctrl+Shift+V as well, and say whether they behave differently.

In your report, include: Windows version, Windows Terminal version, how you installed Codewhale (Scoop, npm, install script or other), the shell (PowerShell, cmd, WSL), and what you saw for each step. A precise report is credited like code.

If you reported #7485, the questions there are the same: did you paste with Ctrl+V, and does right-click paste work?

### Also useful once fixes are in the candidate

- Run `/pet` in your terminal and say which terminal it is and whether you see the current pet or the old whale.
- Switch to the Underwater theme, start a task that takes a while, and say whether the ocean moves while the model works.

## Being built by maintainers right now

- The paste and `codewhale update` fixes (on the hotfix branch, waiting for Windows confirmation).
- The `/pet` old-whale fix.
- The Underwater animation fix.
- Building and checking the release.

Please do not open code pull requests for these; post test reports instead.

## How to take a piece

Comment here with your test report. For anything not on this list, comment on #7486 or the issue for that area to claim it, then open a pull request that says `Refs #<issue>`.

milestone.title: v0.10.5
milestone.description:
Planned usability and observability release: clipboard-image retention/cleanup, running-command detail, pet qualification, Fleet save-in-role/model presentation, usage/tool diagnostics, per-call cache views and clickable file previews.

Undated planning target approved November 5, 2026. Scope and data-loss semantics must be resolved before implementation; preserve accessibility, explicit cleanup controls and authoritative accounting. This milestone does not create a published release.

issues.body:
0.10.5 makes Codewhale simpler. Every change in it **removes a path**: a duplicate implementation, a legacy mode, a redundant setting, or a second mechanism doing a job another one already does. It does not add new surface. Bug fixes belong here when removing or merging a path fixes them, or when they are reliability fixes in an area we are simplifying.

Why: three recent bugs came from two paths doing one job.
- **Windows paste.** The terminal pastes the text itself, and our key-release handler also read the clipboard and inserted the same text again (fixed in the 0.10.4 hotfix).
- **`codewhale update`.** The update command had its own check for "is this binary managed by cargo?", separate from the one `codewhale doctor` uses. The two disagreed, and update refused a release binary.
- **`/pet`.** The view showed the old whale in every terminal but one, because the default view did not take the same route to its picture everywhere.

The hotfix patches those. 0.10.5 removes the second path so they cannot come back.

## First areas

1. **One paste path in the terminal app.** Bracketed paste, the Ctrl+V key-release clipboard read and image attach all decide on their own whether to insert. Leave one decision point.
2. **One install-ownership check** shared by `codewhale update`, `codewhale doctor` and `codewhale uninstall`.
3. **The default `/pet` view needs no shared process.**
4. **The audit issues #7457 to #7478** (about 190 verified defects, reported by @7jrxt42BxFZo4iAnN4CX). Many cluster around hand-written copies of something the codebase already has once: atomic writes, bounded readers, grapheme-safe truncation, localized messages, status notices. Fixing them by switching to the shared helper and deleting the copy is the 0.10.5 way.

Candidates that need a maintainer decision before work starts (we will update this list when decided):
- One rollback path instead of `/undo`, `/restore` and conversation backtracking (#6970).
- One permission posture setting instead of `approval_policy`, `sandbox_mode`, `yolo` and `--full-access` overlapping (#6992, #4955).
- One command dispatch path: finish moving the core command group off the legacy `&mut App` handlers (#6145, #5316).
- One web UI: retire `crates/app-server/src/runtime_web/app.mjs` and serve the shared app web build (#7235, #7236, #7237).
- One provider tool-compatibility step instead of per-provider Moonshot and xAI branches (#5633).
- Fold the shadow Decision Gate into the `[auto.router] kind = "decision"` router, keeping @Andrea-Bruno's credit (#6603).
- Remove deferred-tool eviction and keep admission and revalidation (#6969).
- One credential resolver for the TUI and `auth get` (#6559, R01-06).
- One provider and model fact table (#7194, U4 and U3).
- Delete the remaining dead code (#5587, #7270).

## Status

On `main` already:
- Dead-code sweep: from 137 suppressions and 14 module blankets down to about 50 and 2, mostly by @luochen211 (#7149, #7272 as 4d3bd65eeed).
- R20 audit fixes by @NieZhuZhu (#7482, 7788c2484a0).
- Earlier audit fixes that shipped in 0.10.3: a2fd536f3f1, 8d7282a11ec (#6559), 9c53943a19b (#6558), b7803d86360 (#6557), cbde2c3f431 (#6560).

Open pull requests that already cover a piece (please do not duplicate them):
- #7481 by @NieZhuZhu: all six R15 config defects (#7471). In review.
- #7483 by @NieZhuZhu: the three R9 defects (#7465). A maintainer repair for its red checks (stale diagnostics fixtures) is ready to go onto the branch.
- #7484 by @NieZhuZhu: the four R11 extension-host defects (#7467). Review comments posted.
- #7451 by @Serendo: Runtime task store reopening on session switch. Review comments posted.

Missing: everything in "First areas" and the decided candidates.

## Ways to help

### No Rust needed

- **FreeBSD idle CPU (#6728).** Run the 0.10.3 release idle for ten minutes and report CPU use, with `top` output or a ktrace like the one @Gabriel-Degret sent.
- **Windows `/undo` (#6970).** On the 0.10.3 release in Windows Terminal, make a change with a tool, run `/undo`, and report what was restored and what was not.
- **Chinese localization (#6804).** `docs/zh_hans/` and `crates/localization/locales/`. Test: `cargo test -p codewhale-localization --locked`.
- **Chat bridges onto one shared core (#7477).** The DingTalk, Feishu and WeCom bridges each keep their own cursor, chunking and reply-limit code. Move them onto `integrations/bridge-core` and delete the copies. This is JavaScript. Test: `cd integrations/bridge-core && npm test`, plus each bridge's own tests. Done when the three bridges import cursor, splitting and bounded reading from bridge-core, the per-bridge copies are gone, and the R21 findings L6-01, L12-01/02, L3-01 and L1-01 are covered by tests.

### Rust

Each of these is sized for one pull request. File, test command and what done means:

- **#7474, R18-L12-01**: `crates/tui/src/tui/window_control.rs:309` compares against `"shell experience host.exe"`, which never matches the real process name `ShellExperienceHost.exe`. Test: `scripts/dev-test.sh tui window_control`. Done: the literal matches the real name the same way its neighbours do, with a test. R18-L10-01 (onboarding marker via `codewhale_util::utils::write_atomic`) can come in the same pull request.
- **#5587**: delete the dead items behind the last two `#![allow(dead_code)]` blankets in `crates/engine/src/core/protocol_parity.rs` and `crates/engine/src/llm_client/mock.rs`, plus item-level markers. Test: `scripts/dev-test.sh engine` and `python3 scripts/check-dead-code-budget.py`. Done: the blankets are gone, `scripts/dead-code-budget.json` is lowered to the new count, and platform-guarded allows stay unless you have Windows compiler evidence.
- **#7270**: once maintainers post keep-or-remove for each item, delete the ones marked remove (`SidebarRowAction::PrefillCommand` in `crates/tui/src/tui/app.rs:1320` and `mouse_ui.rs`, `FleetListOutcome::OpenDetail`, `RunReceipt`, the never-set digest fields in `crates/skills/src/mutation.rs`). Test: `scripts/dev-test.sh tui` and `scripts/dev-test.sh skills`. Done: the items and their match arms are gone and the tests pass.
- **#7459**: native search reads responses with unbounded `.json::<Value>()` at `crates/engine/src/client/provider_native_search.rs:246, 289, 311`. Route them through the existing `read_bounded_response_bytes` in `crates/engine/src/client/wire.rs`. Test: `scripts/dev-test.sh engine provider_native_search`. Done: no unbounded read is left in that file, and a test shows an oversized body is refused. R3-L8-01 (treat a missing or unknown status as an error, as `responses.rs:837` already does for one profile) is a good second pull request.
- **#7470 and #7469**: three separate character-count truncations split graphemes (session picker, transcript, context menu, dock tab). Replace them with `crates/tui-kit/src/ui_text.rs` and delete the copies. Also delete the six hardcoded tool-status strings near `crates/tui/src/tui/history.rs:1782` in favour of `tool_status_label`. Test: `scripts/dev-test.sh tui history` and `scripts/dev-test.sh tui-kit`. Done: one truncation helper is used at all those sites, with a test using an emoji or CJK string.
- **#7475 and #7472**: hand-written atomic writers that skip fsync (the release helper, the recovery manifest rewrite, the cloud-facts cache writers). Replace them with `write_atomic` and `sync_parent` from `crates/util`. Also stop ignoring the result at `crates/cli/src/update.rs:628`. Test: `scripts/dev-test.sh util`, `scripts/dev-test.sh release`, `scripts/dev-test.sh cli update`. Done: those writers are deleted and the shared helper is used.
- **#7432**: skills settings. `collect_companion_files` in `crates/engine/src/tools/skill.rs` skips subdirectories, and `split_trigger` in `crates/skills/src/lib.rs:1915` only understands English phrases. Test: `scripts/dev-test.sh engine skill` and `scripts/dev-test.sh skills split_trigger`. Done: subdirectory files are listed and a non-English trigger clause is recognised, each with a test. Removing the `listing_*` knobs and making `[skills]` reject unknown keys needs a maintainer decision on how existing configs with those keys are handled, so ask on the issue first.

The other audit issues (#7457 to #7478) each name a shared-helper fix in their triage. Pick one finding, comment on its issue, and go.

## Proposing a simplification of your own

Open an issue titled `simplify: <area>` that names:
- **What is removed**: the files, settings, modes or code paths that go away.
- **What stays**: the one path that remains and does the job.
- **The contract that must keep working**: what users and other code rely on, and the existing tests that prove it. If a setting or command goes away, say what happens to people who use it today.
- **Size**: roughly how much is deleted and how much is added. A proposal that adds a switch between the old and new behaviour adds a path, so it does not fit.

A maintainer will reply with yes, no or what would change the answer.

## Being built by maintainers right now

- The three first areas (one paste path, one install-ownership check, the `/pet` default view), because they follow directly from the 0.10.4 fixes. Review and testing are welcome.
- Reviews of #7481, #7483, #7484 and #7451.
- Decisions on the candidate list above.

## How to take a piece

Comment on the issue for that piece to claim it (or here, if it has no issue yet), then open a pull request that says `Refs #<issue>`. Your pull request merges as itself with you as the author. A red check you did not cause is ours to fix.

## Thanks

This release builds on work people already did: @7jrxt42BxFZo4iAnN4CX for the audit issues; @NieZhuZhu for the R20 fixes and the open R9, R11 and R15 pull requests; @luochen211 for most of the dead-code sweep and zh-Hans term consistency (#7150); @donglovejava for the paste regression tests (#7422, #7444), the late-usage ledger (#7449) and the ConPTY `/undo` run on #6970; @laozidabo for flushing sessions on SIGHUP, SIGINT and SIGTERM (#7122) and the missing error cause (#7353); @deosiree for carrying request transmission on the error envelope (#7448); @aboimpinto for the config command shapes (#6973); @Andrea-Bruno for the Decision Gate (#6604); @Aboysky for re-checking #7194 against `main`.

_Drafted by Claude Fable 5.2 (AI), working with Hmbown, from a triage of every open issue and pull request._

milestone.description:
Planned usability and observability release: clipboard-image retention/cleanup, running-command detail, pet qualification, Fleet save-in-role/model presentation, usage/tool diagnostics, per-call cache views and clickable file previews.

Undated planning target approved November 5, 2026. Scope and data-loss semantics must be resolved before implementation; preserve accessibility, explicit cleanup controls and authoritative accounting. This milestone does not create a published release.
